enUS_text: Maroro finds a metal fan pointing at his throat.
zhTW_text: 用鐵扇抵住了麻呂呂的喉頭。

jaJP_text: 그걸 보고, 오슈토르는 다시 칼을 고쳐 쥐었다.
enUS_text: Upon seeing that, Oshtor gets a better grip on the hilt of his sword.
zhTW_text: 看到我的動作，奧修特爾也重新握好了刀。

jaJP_text: 걸어도 걸어도 출구는 안 나오고, 슬슬 지쳤다구요 두령……
enUS_text: We've been walkin' and walkin' but there's no exit. Boss, I'm tired!
zhTW_text: 怎麼走都找不到出口，我實在是撐不下去了啦，老大。

jaJP_text: 어이 어이, 그 말은 정식으로 끝나는 때가 보이지 않는다는 거냐?
enUS_text: Does that mean there's no official end?
zhTW_text: 喂喂喂，意思是真正的終點根本無從得知嗎？

enUS_text: Vurai stops walking.
zhTW_text: 武賴停下腳步。

jaJP_text: 수는 제법 있지만, 한 명 한 명의 전투력은 결코 높지 않다.
enUS_text: Even though there were many of them, none of them posed a major problem individually.
zhTW_text: 數量不少，但每一個人的戰鬥能力都不高。

enUS_text: He fought with his full strength and lost.
zhTW_text: 賭上自己的全力並落敗了。

enUS_text: Heep?!
zhTW_text: 咦呃！？

jaJP_text: ……어쩔 수 없지. 상황이 어떻든, 몸도 풀 겸 우선 이 녀석들부터 해치우도록 할까.
enUS_text: I guess we have no choice... We'll beat these guys first as a warm-up exercise.
zhTW_text: ……沒辦法了。不管情況如何，首先就當成熱身，打倒這些傢伙吧。

jaJP_text: 어디 있지…… 내 금인은 어디 있는 거냐……
enUS_text: Where... Where is my golden seal?
zhTW_text: 在哪裡……我的金印在哪裡……

enUS_text: Yes, we definitely will. I promise you, Maro.
zhTW_text: 嗯，知道了。麻呂，我們說好了。

enUS_text: Heh... Hehehehe...
zhTW_text: 呵呵……呵呵呵……

enUS_text: Hahahahaha!
zhTW_text: 唔哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

jaJP_text: 오슈토르, 각오는 되었느냐. 그럼, 내가 먼저#@－－#
enUS_text: Brace yourself, Oshtor. Here I come—
zhTW_text: 奧修特爾，做好覺悟了嗎？那麼，由我先#@－－#

enUS_text: Dahahahaha!
zhTW_text: 啊哈哈哈！

enUS_text: Don't mind if I use my secret weapon!
zhTW_text: #@－－#我要用上殺手鐧了！

jaJP_text: 사, 살았다. 하지만 브라이는 대체 어디로 사라진 거지?
enUS_text: Th-Thanks... Where did Vurai go, though?
zhTW_text: 得、得救了。但武賴到底消失到哪裡去了？

jaJP_text:
무례하오나, 오슈토르 공께 부탁이 하나 있사옵니다.
들어 주시겠사옵니까?
enUS_text: Prithee, give ear to my preposterous plea.
zhTW_text:
我有不情之請想拜託奧修特爾大人。
你願意聽聽嗎？

enUS_text: Ugh...
It's good to see you, Haku.
zhTW_text: 你總算來了，哈克。

enUS_text: Die!
zhTW_text: 去死！

jaJP_text: 후훗, 그 말투. 제법 익숙해진 모양이군.
enUS_text: I see you've gotten quite used to my manner of speech.
zhTW_text: 呵呵，聽你這副口吻……看來你越來越有模有樣了。

jaJP_text:
하지만 뭐,
나도 내가 얼마나 강해졌는지 오슈토르 본인과 싸워 보며 시험해 보고 싶었거든.
enUS_text:
But you know what? I've been wanting to test out how far
I've come along by sparring with the real Oshtor himself.
zhTW_text:
不過，哎……
我也一直都很想和奧修特爾本人戰鬥，看看自己到底變強多少。

enUS_text: The seal, as in this seal here, right?
zhTW_text: 「那個」指的是這個沒錯吧。

jaJP_text: 어디선가 본 기억이…… 아, 노스리가 전에 손에 넣었던 금인이군.
enUS_text: Now, why does it look so familiar... Oh, right! It's the one Nosuri had before.
zhTW_text: 總覺得在哪看過……啊，是鵟之前持有的金印啊。

jaJP_text:
그리고 내가 생각한 대로, 가능하게 해 주었다.
하쿠, 참으로 고맙다.
enUS_text:
And you have proven me right, Haku.
For that, I cannot thank you enough.
zhTW_text:
而你也確實如鄙人所料，將其化為可能了。
哈克，鄙人實在是感激不盡。

enUS_text: That pesky part of you hasn't changed at all, huh...
zhTW_text: 你這種麻煩的性格還是沒變呢……

jaJP_text: 어떻게든 오슈토르에게 한 방 먹일 수는 있었나……
enUS_text: Finally managed to land a hit on Oshtor...
zhTW_text: 勉強算是擊中奧修特爾了，吧……

enUS_text: Another level.
zhTW_text: 其他階層。

enUS_text: Hah... Hahhh...!
zhTW_text: 喝啊啊啊……！

jaJP_text: 하지만 미안하네, 형씨. 여기까지 강하다면, 나도 더는 숨길 수가 없겠어.
enUS_text: But I'm gonna have to rain on your parade here. You can't expect me to hold back now after witnessing your abilities!
zhTW_text: 但不好意思啦，小哥。既然你這麼強，那我也無法再藏招了。

jaJP_text:
아아 아니, 다시 만나서 기쁘긴 하다만.
설마 그대가 있을 줄은 몰라서, 좀 놀라고 말았어.
enUS_text:
No, I am happy to see you again. It's just...I was not
expecting to see you here. I was caught off guard.
zhTW_text:
啊，不，能和你重逢當然是很高興。
但實在沒想到你會在這裡，所以有點不知所措。

jaJP_text: 안 준다고 한 적 없어! 기다려 기다려, 지금 꺼낼 테니까……
enUS_text: I didn't say that I wouldn't! Hold on, I'll give it to you now—
zhTW_text: 我沒說不交啊！　等我一下，我馬上拿出來……

enUS_text: Is this...a golden seal?
zhTW_text: 這是……金印？

jaJP_text: 하지만, 그대라면 불가능을 가능으로 만들 수 있으리라 믿고 있었다.
enUS_text: But I was confident that if anyone could make the impossible possible, it was you.
zhTW_text: 但鄙人也相信，如果是你，就能化不可能為可能。

jaJP_text: 오랜만에 만났는데도, 참 인사 한번 거칠구나.
enUS_text: Quite a greeting for a friend you haven't seen in a while.
zhTW_text: 明明這麼久沒見了，這種招呼方式也太過分了吧。

jaJP_text: 그게 없었다면, 그게 없었다면, 그게 없었다면……
enUS_text: Without the seal... Without it... I...
zhTW_text: 要是沒有那個、要是沒有那個、要是沒有那個……

enUS_text: Haku slowly raises his metal fan.
zhTW_text: 我緩緩持好鐵扇。

jaJP_text: 나한테 말하지 마! 전부 이 녀석 때문이잖아!
enUS_text: What're you tellin' me for?! It's all this guy's fault!
zhTW_text: 不准跟大爺我說這種事！　全都是這傢伙的錯啦！

enUS_text: Huh? Wait a minute...
And then...

jaJP_text: 여기서 첫 상대가 모즈누들이었던 건, 오히려 다행이었는지도 모르겠다.
enUS_text: It was perhaps a good thing Oshtor [Haku]'s first duel here was against Moznu and his men.
zhTW_text: 或許伯勞他們作為在這裡的初戰對手還不壞。

jaJP_text: 이럴 줄 알아서 만나고 싶지 않았던 건데……
enUS_text: This is why I didn't want to bump into him...
zhTW_text: 就是因為會有這種事，才不想碰上的……

jaJP_text: 꿈속이라 해도, 긴 수련을 각오해야 할지도 모르겠군.
enUS_text: I'd better be prepared for a long training session in this dream.
zhTW_text: 雖說是在夢中，但看來我得做好覺悟，這會是場漫長的鍛鍊。

jaJP_text: 두 사람의 말에 고개를 끄덕이고, 철선을 겨눈다.
enUS_text: He nods at the twins before taking out his metal fan.
zhTW_text: 我對兩人的話語點頭示意，持好鐵扇。

jaJP_text: 지금까지 중에 가장 성가신 적이었다…… 정신적으로.
enUS_text: He was the most difficult enemy I had to deal with so far...mentally, that is.
zhTW_text: 他是目前為止最難對付的敵人……從精神方面而言。

enUS_text: Maro...
zhTW_text: 麻呂……

jaJP_text: 그때까지 하쿠의 얼굴을 덮고 있던 가면이, 오슈토르의 손에 쥐여 있다.
enUS_text: The mask that had been on Haku's face is now in Oshtor's hand.
zhTW_text: 至今為止遮擋住哈克臉龐的假面，已經被奧修特爾拿在手裡。

jaJP_text: 앞으로의 싸움에 반드시 도움이 될 수련법입니다.
enUS_text: It will surely serve you well in the battles ahead.
zhTW_text: 這個鍛鍊法必定能為今後的戰鬥帶來優勢。

jaJP_text: 어이 어이, 형편이 좋아도 너무 좋잖아.
enUS_text: That's so convenient it's inconvenient.
zhTW_text: 喂喂喂，這設定也太方便了吧。

jaJP_text:
육체가 강화되지는 않지만,
잠들어 있는 동안에도 주인님의 지휘를 벼려낼 수 있습니다.
enUS_text:
While your physical body doesn't get stronger,
it will doubtlessly hone your leadership skills.
zhTW_text:
雖然肉體不會獲得強化，
但能在睡眠期間，磨練主人您的指揮技巧。

enUS_text: Wait, Maroro! We haven't...
zhTW_text: 等等，麻呂呂，鄙人還沒和你……

enUS_text: My seal! Finally...you have returned to meee!
zhTW_text: 金印！　終於、終於回到我身邊了！

jaJP_text: 키우루들에게도 부담은 가겠지만, 더 짧은 시간에, 더 효과적인 강화 방법을……
enUS_text: Something that can make them stronger in the quickest and most effective way possible, though that may put additional strain Kiwru and the others...
zhTW_text: 雖然也會對奇羽琉他們造成負擔，但必須追求能在短時間內帶來顯著成果的強化方式……

enUS_text: In the quickest...
zhTW_text: 我們準備了能在短時間……

jaJP_text: 네 사정 따위 내가 알 게 뭐야! 우리님들의 화풀이에 좀 어울려 달라구!
enUS_text: I don't care about yer stupid rush! You're gonna amuse us whether you like it or not!
zhTW_text: 誰管你趕不趕路啊！　大爺我要讓你陪我們洩憤！

jaJP_text: ……참고로 어중간한 시점에 귀환하면, 무슨 문제라도 있나?
enUS_text: Incidentally, what's going to happen if I go back halfway through?
zhTW_text: ……順道一問，要是在不上不下的地方回去，會有什麼問題嗎？

enUS_text: I take back what I said!
zhTW_text: 喂！

enUS_text: What do you mean?
zhTW_text: 代價？　什麼啊？

enUS_text: Who goes there?!

jaJP_text: 뭐 이쪽도, 모즈누들이 긁어모은 거금을 옆에서 가로챌 계획을 세우고 있었지만 말이지……
enUS_text: Though I guess we did also plan to swipe the money you'd amassed...
zhTW_text: 不過我們也擬定計畫，試圖搶走伯勞他們掠奪來的大錢就是了……

jaJP_text:
정신 차려 보니 꽤 깊숙이 내려왔는데, 대체 어디까지 이어지는 거지?
이 토라노아나라는 곳은.
enUS_text:
We're quite deep now. How far does this
Tiger's Den place go?
zhTW_text:
回過神來才發現我已經來到很深的地方了，　
但這個叫虎穴的地方到底延伸到哪裡啊？

enUS_text: This world reflects your psyche, Master.
zhTW_text: 這裡反映著主人的心理世界。

jaJP_text: 참고로, 깨어나고 싶으시면 언제든 돌아가실 수 있습니다.
enUS_text: By the way, you can choose to wake up and return to reality at any time.
zhTW_text: 順帶一提，要是您想醒過來了，隨時都能回去現實。

jaJP_text: 설마 처음 만나는 게 저 녀석들일 줄이야.
enUS_text: I can't believe these guys are our first encounter.
zhTW_text: 沒想到最先碰上的是那些傢伙啊。

enUS_text: What... That's Abel Kamul!
zhTW_text: 什……！　阿貝爾卡姆爾！？

enUS_text: This is the last floor...
zhTW_text: 這裡就是最後的階層……

jaJP_text: 적이 점점 강해지고 있습니다. 주인님, 게임을 떠올려 보세요.
enUS_text: It is because the enemies have gotten stronger. Master, imagine you are in a video game.
zhTW_text: 敵人越來越強了。主人，請想像成遊戲。

enUS_text: It's been a while, hasn't it?
zhTW_text: 好久不見了啊。

enUS_text: What're you talking about...
zhTW_text: 你到底是……

enUS_text: But that was because...
zhTW_text: 但那是……

enUS_text: Augh?!
You went back to your old makeup.
zhTW_text: 你化回原本的妝了啊。

jaJP_text:
솔직히, 그 상황에서 네 흉내까지 내 가며 병사들을 단련시키고 조정과 싸운다니,
거의 불가능에 가까웠으니까.
enUS_text:
I'll be honest with you... Pretending to be you, training the soldiers, and fighting the
Imperial Army all at once... It was nearly impossible to pull off!
zhTW_text:
老實說，要在那情況下邊模仿你邊鍛鍊士兵與朝廷作戰，
幾乎是不可能的事情。

jaJP_text: 아니, 그건 조금이 아니잖아. 아니 애초에, 진심을 내겠다고 했었잖아.
enUS_text: That didn't feel like just a little! And you clearly said you were gonna get serious!
zhTW_text: 不，那不只一點吧。應該說，你不是說要來真的嗎。

enUS_text: Inexplicable.
zhTW_text: 無法理解。

enUS_text: Did we win...?
zhTW_text: 成功了……嗎？

jaJP_text:
이 세계에는 죽음이 존재하지 않습니다.
죽어도 상대의 투지가 사라지지 않았다면, 되살아날 수 있습니다.
enUS_text:
Death does not exist in this world. Even if someone does die,
he can always come back again as long as his fighting spirit remains.
zhTW_text:
這個世界不存在死亡。
即使死亡，只要對手還有鬥志，就能復活。

enUS_text: Man... You're trying a bit too hard for being in a dream, don't you think?
zhTW_text: 唉……就算是在夢裡，你也太有幹勁了吧……

enUS_text: Would you like to keep going, Master?
zhTW_text: 主人，您要繼續前進嗎？

jaJP_text: 가면이여. 문이 되어 근원으로 향하는 길을 열어젖혀라!
enUS_text: Akuruka! Become the door to my origin of power! And now, open!
zhTW_text: 假面啊。成為門扉，開啟通往根源之路！

enUS_text: GAAAAAH!! OSHTOOOOORRR!
zhTW_text: 唔啊啊啊啊啊啊，奧修特爾！

enUS_text: Maroro...
zhTW_text: 麻呂呂……

enUS_text: No, it's not a light. That's... That's...!
zhTW_text: 不，不對……那是……那個身影是……

jaJP_text: 게임에서는 적이 강해질수록, 끝에 가까워지고 있습니다.
enUS_text: The stronger the enemies in a video game become, the closer you are to the end.
zhTW_text: 在遊戲中，敵人越強，就越接近終點。

enUS_text: That voice...
zhTW_text: 這聲音是……

jaJP_text: 역시 너한테는 그 흰 분장이 잘 어울려.
enUS_text: I have to say, you still look best in white makeup to me!
zhTW_text: 果然，還是那層白粉最適合你。

jaJP_text:
아니 그보다 말이야.
엔나카무이 병사들의 숙련도가 낮은 걸 알면서 그런 말을 한 건 비겁한 거 아냐?
enUS_text:
Also, I can't believe you made that request knowing how
inexperienced the Ennakamuy soldiers were!
zhTW_text:
應該說……
你都知道恩納卡姆依士兵的練度很低了還說那種話，也太卑鄙了吧？

enUS_text: You have improved, Imperial Guard of the Right, Oshtor.
zhTW_text: 你變強了啊。這樣才是右近衛大將奧修特爾。

jaJP_text: 알고 있사옵니다. 라이코우 공에게 조종당하고 있었으니 그렇다고 말하고 싶은 것이겠지요?
enUS_text: Aye, thy concern be discernible. 'Twas but forsooth strings pulleth so by Master Raiko.
zhTW_text: 麻呂我明白。你想說那是因為麻呂我被雷光大人操縱了，對吧？

enUS_text: There it is!!
zhTW_text: 找到了……！

jaJP_text: 즉, 이 녀석의 투지를 꺾지 않는 한……?
enUS_text: In other words, as long as this guy's fighting spirit isn't put out...
zhTW_text: 也就是說，若不撲滅這傢伙的鬥志……

jaJP_text: 저 쿠온? 이 그 사실을 알고 있었다면…… 상상만 해도 무섭군.
enUS_text: If that Kuon knew about the truth... I can't even begin to imagine the consequences.
zhTW_text: 要是那個久遠？　也知道這件事的話……光想想就覺得毛骨悚然。

enUS_text: Course! Now get your weapon, kid.
zhTW_text: 沒錯！小哥你也做好準備吧。

enUS_text: And she was with Abel Kamul...
zhTW_text: 還有阿貝爾卡姆爾也是……

enUS_text: "A little"...
zhTW_text: 什麼一點……

enUS_text: Immobile.
zhTW_text: 停止。

enUS_text: Kid, you never fail to surprise me.
zhTW_text: 小哥你老是令我驚嘆不已啊。

jaJP_text: 알겠다. 그렇게까지 부탁하는데, 거절할 수야 없지.
enUS_text: What sort of a close friend would I be if I turned down such an earnest request, right?
zhTW_text: 我明白了。你都說到這個份上了，我怎麼能拒絕呢。

jaJP_text: 여기서 만난 것도 백만 년 만이다! 그동안 당한 원한, 여기서 갚아 주마!
enUS_text: It was destiny that we met here! Now we're gonna show ya just what we think of all the trouble ya put us through!
zhTW_text: 總算找到你了！　大爺我要一雪之前被你搞得苦不堪言的恥辱！

enUS_text: It IS the same thing I did before!
zhTW_text: 果然是跟之前那個類似的東西啊！

jaJP_text: 거, 거 봐, 네가 찾고 있던 금인이다!
enUS_text: He-Hey! Here's the golden seal you're looking for!
zhTW_text: 你、你看，這是你在找的金印喔。

enUS_text: Have at thee!
zhTW_text: 吃這招吧！

jaJP_text: 더 효과를 낼 수 있는 방법을, 주인님께.
enUS_text: ...and most effective way possible. For our Master.
zhTW_text: 帶來顯著成果的方法給主人。

enUS_text: As if something so convenient really existed...
zhTW_text: ……要是真有那種方法，我們也不會這麼辛苦了。

enUS_text: You must offer a tribute.
zhTW_text: 要獻上供品。

jaJP_text: 무슨 맥 빠진 소리를 하는 것이냐.
enUS_text: Are you not ashamed for letting such cowardly words escape your mouth?
zhTW_text: 你在說什麼丟人的話？

jaJP_text: 실패로 끝난 만큼, 그건 눈감아 주었으면 하네.
enUS_text: It didn't work out though. So you should really just let bygones be bygones.
zhTW_text: 但反正都失敗了，希望對此他們能睜一隻眼閉一隻眼。

enUS_text: Yes, of course it would turn out like this.
zhTW_text: 唉，就知道會變成這樣。

jaJP_text: 응? 아아, 그러고 보니 깨어나고 싶으면 언제든 돌아갈 수 있었지.
enUS_text: Huh? Oh, right. I can go back by waking up whenever I want.
zhTW_text: 嗯？　啊，這麼說來只要我想醒，就能醒過來是吧。

jaJP_text: 죄송합니다. 귀한 돌이라, 대량으로는 구하지 못했습니다.
enUS_text: We are sorry, Master. This stone is valuable and difficult to obtain.
zhTW_text: 非常抱歉。這是很珍貴的石頭，所以無法大量獲得。

enUS_text: Simply give us the word.
zhTW_text: 屆時請對我們下命令。

enUS_text: The ground is shaking? An earthquake?!
zhTW_text: 在搖晃……　是……地震？

enUS_text: Unknown.
zhTW_text: 不明。

enUS_text: Known as the Tiger's Den.
zhTW_text: 通稱虎穴。

jaJP_text: 하지만 저건 물 밑으로 가라앉았을 텐데. 그게 왜 이런 곳에 있는 거지?
enUS_text: But that seal should be at the bottom of the sea. What's it doing here?
zhTW_text: 但那個應該沉入水底了才對。為什麼會出現在這種地方？

enUS_text: Nah, under normal circumstances, it IS impossible.
zhTW_text: 不，一般來說根本就不可能。

jaJP_text: 토키후사에게 건네야 하는 거겠지만, 가까이 가도 괜찮은 건가……?
enUS_text: I should probably give it to him, but I'm not sure it's safe to approach him now...
zhTW_text: 我應該把這個還給時櫻吧，但我接近他沒問題嗎……？

enUS_text: He's not listening to me!
zhTW_text: 根本沒聽我說話！

enUS_text: The threat has passed, Master.
zhTW_text: 主人，威脅已經消失了。

enUS_text: ROOOOOOARRR!
zhTW_text: 唔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔！

enUS_text: You've gotta be kidding me...
zhTW_text: 真的假的……

enUS_text: Oshtor?
zhTW_text: 奧修特爾？

jaJP_text: 원 참…… 아무리 그래도 여기까지 하면, 브라이도 포기하#@－－#
enUS_text: Phew... After all that fighting, even Vurai would know when to give—
zhTW_text: 真是的……都做到這個地步了，就算是武賴也會放棄#@－－#

enUS_text: Yeah!
zhTW_text: 是！

jaJP_text: 이 자식, 아직도 정신 못 차리고 금인을 노리는 건가.
enUS_text: He's still not giving up on the seal?
zhTW_text: 這傢伙還沒學乖，還是在找金印嗎？

jaJP_text: 하쿠 공. 또 우콘 공과 함께 술잔을 나누자꾸나.
enUS_text: Master Haku. Another drink shall we shareth once more with Master Ukon in time.
zhTW_text: 哈克大人。下次再一起和右近大人一起喝酒吧。

enUS_text: Hah!

jaJP_text: 아앙? 그건 이쪽이 묻고 싶거든…… 그런데, 네놈은!
enUS_text: Har? You need to be tellin' me the answer to that! Wait... It's you!
zhTW_text: 啊啊？　我們才想問咧……呃，你是！

jaJP_text: 대략적인 길이와 위치 관계만 알 수 있다.
enUS_text: We know only its approximate length and our relative position.
zhTW_text: 只知道大致上的長度和位置的相對關係。

jaJP_text: 그렇긴 한데, 정신 차려 보니 어느새 여기 와 있었거든요.
enUS_text: We were, but we ended up here somehow!
zhTW_text: 是這樣沒錯啦，但回過神來後發現不知何時自己就在這裡了。

jaJP_text: 그들과의 악연이, 이 싸움을 불러낸 모양입니다.
enUS_text: Your quarrel with them has triggered this duel.
zhTW_text: 似乎是與他們之間的過節，導致這場戰鬥發生了。

enUS_text: Ain't we, men?!
zhTW_text: 你們這些傢伙，要上了！

jaJP_text: ……이대로 방치하면, 계속 금인만 찾고 다닐지도 몰라.
enUS_text: If I don't do something, he's just going to keep looking for it.
zhTW_text: ……要是就這麼放著不管，他可能會一直找金印找個不停吧。

jaJP_text: 마로는…… 우콘 공도 그걸 기대하고 있사옵니다.
enUS_text: 'Twill be an occasion that Maro...and Master Ukon awaiteth with great anticipation.
zhTW_text: 麻呂我……還有右近大人也非常期待喔。

jaJP_text: 저희도 그 전나를 본 적은 없습니다.
enUS_text: Not even we know everything about it.
zhTW_text: 我們也從未目睹它的全貌。

jaJP_text: 너희들, 이런 곳에서 뭐 하고 있는 거냐.
enUS_text: You lot... What do you think you're doing here?
zhTW_text: 喂，你們在這種地方做什麼啊。

enUS_text: Part of your training.
zhTW_text: 這也是鍛鍊的一環。

jaJP_text: 하지만 너희들, 제도 감옥에 갇혀 있다고 들었는데.
enUS_text: I heard you'd been thrown into prison in the Imperial Capital?
zhTW_text: 不過，我聽說你們被丟進帝都大牢了啊。

enUS_text: Oh, I get it now...
zhTW_text: 啊，是這麼一回事啊……

jaJP_text: 금……은 어디 있지…… 내…… 금인은 어디 있지……
enUS_text: The seal...where... Where is my golden seeeal?!
zhTW_text: 金……在哪……我的……金印在哪裡……

enUS_text: I cannot deny that.
zhTW_text: 這點鄙人不否定。

enUS_text: I thought you might be happier to see me.
zhTW_text: 我還以為你反應會更熱烈的。

enUS_text: Are you serious...
zhTW_text: 真的假的……

enUS_text: Worry not.
zhTW_text: 沒事的。

enUS_text: I hope you're satisfied now.
zhTW_text: 這樣你應該心滿意足了吧？

jaJP_text: 역시 하쿠답군. 나도 모르게 조금 진심이 되어 버렸어.
enUS_text: Well done, Haku. I couldn't help but get a little serious there.
zhTW_text: 真不愧是哈克。害我不小心動了一點真本事。

enUS_text: The opponent has been incapacitated.
zhTW_text: 已確認對手的行動停止。

enUS_text: You will fight him again and again.
zhTW_text: 就必須無數次與他交手。

enUS_text: Hang on... You still wanna fight?
zhTW_text: 等……你、你還要繼續打？

enUS_text: JP Reward +%d
zhTW_text: JP報酬 + %d

jaJP_text:
이것도 병사의 책무!
각오하시지요, 키우루 님, 이타쿠 님!!
enUS_text: This is all part of a soldier's duty...! Get ready, Lord Kiwru, Lord Itak!
zhTW_text:
這也是士兵的職責！
請做好覺悟吧，奇羽琉大人、伊塔庫大人！

jaJP_text:
오, 오슈토르 님이 좋아하는 거라든가…….
고기는 드실 수 있으려나?
enUS_text: What kind of stuff does Oshtor like? Is he a big meat eater?
zhTW_text:
就、就是奧修特爾大人喜歡的東西之類的……
他會吃肉嗎？

enUS_text: Yowowow! I think that last one broke a bone...!
zhTW_text:
痛痛痛痛痛痛！
要、要骨折了！
咕嚕！　咕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: You interested in gambling, Your Majesty?
zhTW_text: 聖上，您對賭博有興趣？

enUS_text: Kiwru, you can't go out in front! It's too dangerous!
zhTW_text: 奇羽琉，太接近敵人會很危險的！

enUS_text: Waaaaaargh!
zhTW_text: 嗚哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

jaJP_text: 무턱대고 무기만 휘둘러서 적을 쓰러뜨릴 수 있다면 고생은 안 하겠지요.
enUS_text: If blindly swinging a weapon around was all it took to defeat your enemies, warfare would be so much easier.
zhTW_text: 要是亂揮武器能打倒敵人，我們也不用那麼辛苦了。

enUS_text: Eeek! P-Please hit something...!
zhTW_text: 看我的！　要射中啊～！

jaJP_text:
네코네씨에게서 떨어져!!
도적 따위라고 해서 봐주진 않겠다!!
enUS_text: Stand back, Nekone! Bandits or not, I won't let anyone harm you.
zhTW_text:
給我離貓音小姐遠一點！
就算你只是個賊，我也不會放過你！

enUS_text: Your Majesty.
zhTW_text: 聖上。

enUS_text: Rulutieh.
zhTW_text: 露露緹耶。

enUS_text: Sister... Is that the reason you invited me to this?
zhTW_text: 姊姊大人邀我過來，難道是為了……

jaJP_text:
그, 그렇지!!
어차피 우리도 똑같이 당하게 할 셈이잖아!!
enUS_text: Th-That's right! The same trick won't work on us twice!
zhTW_text:
對、對了！
反正你也打算對我們做那種事吧！

enUS_text: This arrow will change the course of fate!
zhTW_text: 我要憑這一箭扭轉局勢！

jaJP_text:
후우… 후우…….
야, 창이라는 게 이렇게까지 무거운 거였던가…….
enUS_text: *huff, huff* W-Was this spear always so heavy...?
zhTW_text:
呼……呼……
原、原來一把長槍這麼重啊……

enUS_text: Cocopo... Thank you.
zhTW_text:
可可啵……
謝謝你。

jaJP_text:
모처럼 두 황(오울로) 다 분위기가 좋잖아.
여기서 맞춰 주는 게 사나이라는 거지.
enUS_text: Come on, your owlos are givin' it their all here. A real man knows how to rise to a challenge.
zhTW_text:
難得兩邊的皇都興致勃勃的。
這時候搭腔才算是男人吧。

enUS_text: So this is the current strength of Ennakamuy's soldiers.
zhTW_text: 這就是……現在恩納卡姆依士兵的實力嗎。

enUS_text: All right now, enough of your mischief.
zhTW_text:
好的～
不可以惡作劇喔？

jaJP_text:
그렇구나…….
짐도 이걸 무척 기대하고 있었느니라.
『자, 여기 있다』 하고 순순히 내줄 수는 없느니라!
enUS_text: Well, unfortunately for you, I've been looking forward to this. I won't hand it over without a fight.
zhTW_text:
這樣啊……
余自己也很期待這個東西啊。
但余也無法輕易拱手讓人！

jaJP_text:
잘못하면 동료끼리 싸우게 돼.
이건 손을 대기보다 지켜보는 수밖에 없겠어……
enUS_text: I'd prefer not to get caught in the crossfire... I guess I've got no choice but to watch.
zhTW_text:
一個不巧，可能演變成同伴自相殘殺。
這時比起出手，只能默默在旁守望了……

enUS_text: You really did end it all in the blink of an eye..
zhTW_text: 真的是眨眼間就發生的事……

jaJP_text: 전장을 잘 살피고, 순식간에 공격에서 지원으로 전환하고 있어.
enUS_text: You know how to gauge the situation and shift from attack to support at a moment's notice.
zhTW_text: 他們對戰場觀察入微，還能瞬間從攻擊轉為掩護。

enUS_text: Hmph... How about you, Rulie? You want in on some action?
zhTW_text: 唔～那小露露呢？

jaJP_text:
금방 끝나면 아깝잖아.
쿠온씨도 좀 더 즐기고 싶은 거 아인교?
enUS_text: It'd be a waste to let this end so soon. You're not done having fun yet, am I right?
zhTW_text:
要是馬上結束就太可惜啦。
久遠小姐，你應該也想再多打一點的吧？

enUS_text: W-We can do it...
Thanks. Watch my back for me, will ya?
zhTW_text: 幫大忙了。　後面就麻煩你囉！

enUS_text: H-Hey, boss? Are you sure about this...?
zhTW_text:
大哥……
真、真的沒問題嗎？

enUS_text: Urgh... Damn it!
zhTW_text: 可、可惡～！

jaJP_text:
알고 있데이.
끼어들고 싶지만…… 지금 끼어드는 건 멋이 없다는 건 내도 안다 아이가.
enUS_text: I know, I know. I won't butt in. I've got more delicacy than that.
zhTW_text:
人家知道啦。
雖然很想加入……但人家也明白，現在加入就太不解風情了。

enUS_text: Hmph. Is that the best you got?
zhTW_text: 哼，就這點程度嗎。

enUS_text: Of course. Let's go!
zhTW_text: 嗯，走吧！

enUS_text: Haaagh!
zhTW_text: 喝啊～！

enUS_text: Gyah...!
zhTW_text: 嗚咿……！

enUS_text: Gwargh!
zhTW_text: 嗚咿！？

enUS_text: G-Get away from meee!
zhTW_text: 不、不准過來！

enUS_text: *rattle, rattle*
zhTW_text: 嘰嘰嘰！　嘰嘰嘰嘰嘰！

enUS_text: Hm... I'm starting to worry about this squad's future...
zhTW_text:
這……
看來前途堪憂啊……

jaJP_text:
상냥한 키우루라서,
지도도 부드럽고 꼼꼼할 줄 알았더니 제법 엄하게 하는구나.
enUS_text:
Here I thought Kiwru'd be too much of a nice guy to teach anyone.
He's actually pretty strict with 'em, huh?
zhTW_text:
畢竟奇羽琉那麼溫柔，
還以為他指導時也會很溫柔細心，沒想到挺嚴格的。

jaJP_text: 하지만 위험하니까 너무 앞으로 나서진 마.
enUS_text: But you should keep your distance. We don't want you getting hurt.
zhTW_text: 但很危險，所以你別太靠近喔。

enUS_text: Gwrgh...?!
zhTW_text: 唔啊！？

enUS_text: Sorry Daddy.
zhTW_text: 不好意思啦，爸爸。

enUS_text: Heehee. Yes, give it your all, Miss Munechika.
zhTW_text:
呵呵。
宗近大人，請您加油。

enUS_text: Understood!
zhTW_text: 遵命！

enUS_text: I get you this time...!
zhTW_text: ……給我打中啊！

enUS_text: Don't start getting careless, Atuy.
zhTW_text: 阿圖依，別偷跑啊。

enUS_text: Ngah...!
zhTW_text: 唔唔……！

enUS_text: ...Hm? Atuy, you're here! And Nosuri too!
zhTW_text:
……嗯？
啊，果然是阿圖依小姐！
連鵟小姐都在！

enUS_text: Gyargh!
zhTW_text: 嗚啊啊啊啊！

enUS_text: Then what are we supposed to do...?
zhTW_text: 那麼，我該怎麼做……！？

enUS_text: Ack!
zhTW_text: 呀啊……！

enUS_text: You're open!
zhTW_text: 發現破綻啦！

enUS_text: Now it's my turn!
zhTW_text: 接下來換我們發動攻勢！

enUS_text: Tch... You're pretty good at this, huh?
zhTW_text:
唔……
這個女人，還挺有一套的。

jaJP_text: 오우, 나도 넓은 아량으로 지켜봐 주마!
enUS_text: I'll be benefferent and watch, too!
zhTW_text: 嗯，我也要心胸寬大地守望那兩個人！

enUS_text: There's nothing for it now. Everyone, to arms!
zhTW_text:
沒辦法了……！
所有人一起上！

enUS_text: Heh, not a bad idea. I suppose we should get started, then.
zhTW_text:
呵呵，我明白了。
那麼，我要上了。

jaJP_text:
그래도 동료니까 계속 참고 있었데이.
그런데…… 저런 걸 보여 주면, 이젠 더는 못 참겠데이.
enUS_text: But since we're on the same side, I've had to hold back... But after seeing you like that, I'm at my limit!
zhTW_text:
但畢竟你是同伴，所以人家一直都在忍耐。
但……看了那種東西，人家也實在是忍不住了。

enUS_text: Seiyah!
zhTW_text: 喝啊……！

jaJP_text: 잘난 척해서 미안하지만, 떠들 시간은 없는 것 같네.
enUS_text: Sorry to interrupt your boasting, but we don't have time to talk right now.
zhTW_text: 抱歉在你自豪的時候打斷你，但現在沒空閒聊了。

enUS_text: Tch. Called in your friends, huh?
zhTW_text: 唔，牠找同伴來了嗎。

enUS_text: Heehee. Miss Munechika and Lord Benawi look like they're having fun.
zhTW_text:
呵呵。
宗近大人跟貝納威大人看起來都好開心。

enUS_text: Hah...!
Ahahahahaha!
zhTW_text: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

enUS_text: Y-Yaaargh!
Kiwru, this is no time to get distracted. Focus on the battle!
zhTW_text:
奇羽琉，現在不是東張西望的時候。
要來了！

enUS_text: Go, go! Do your best!
zhTW_text: 加油、加油！

jaJP_text:
아, 아니, 그런 뜻은…….
사무 일도 제대로 하고 있었다고.
enUS_text: I-I don't know about that... And it's not like I hated doing paperwork or anything.
zhTW_text:
不、不是那樣……
我可是有好好處理文書工作的啊。

enUS_text: Take this!
zhTW_text: 正中目標吧！

jaJP_text: 두 사람 다 목적이 바뀌어 가고 있는 거 아냐……
enUS_text: Did their reasons for fighting get swapped around at some point...?
zhTW_text: 她們兩人的目的是不是都跟原本不一樣啦……

enUS_text: Big Sister...
zhTW_text: 姊姊大人……

jaJP_text: 어머? 후후, 짐승들 덕분이라고 해야 하려나요.
enUS_text: Oh? Looks like we found them, thanks to these monsters.
zhTW_text: 咦？　呵呵，或許得歸功於野獸？
嘎喔喔喔喔喔喔！

jaJP_text: 아직이다, 아직 공격의 손을 늦춰선 안 된다!!
enUS_text: Keep up those attacks, and don't stop for anyone!
zhTW_text: 不准停下攻擊！

enUS_text: Urgh... Damn it!
zhTW_text: 可、可惡……

jaJP_text: 부디 진정하시고 저희 이야기를 들어 주세요!!
enUS_text: Please, calm down and listen to what we have to say!
zhTW_text: 請冷靜點聽我們說！

enUS_text: Ha! I barely even felt that one.
zhTW_text: 這點程度，根本不痛不癢！

jaJP_text: 보수는 넉넉히 드릴 테니, 잘 부탁합니다!!
enUS_text: I'll make it worth your while, so don't show them any mercy!
zhTW_text: 報酬會多付一點的，麻煩你們了！

enUS_text: O-Over there! Lady Nosuri's over there!
zhTW_text:
喂、喂！
鵟大人去那邊了！

enUS_text: Yeah, I guess that's the only way... In that case, I'll help too!
zhTW_text:
只能這麼做了……
我知道了。　我也會幫忙的！

enUS_text: Graaawr!
zhTW_text: 呀嗚！

enUS_text: Urg... Gwah!
zhTW_text: 唔啊、嗚呼……！？

enUS_text: Nay, I will fight too.
zhTW_text: 不，余也要戰鬥。
咕嚕嚕嚕嚕～<onpu>

enUS_text: I should've known we'd never be able to hit her...
zhTW_text: 果然還是打不中她嗎……

enUS_text: Hah!
zhTW_text: 哈啊……！
咕嚕！

enUS_text: Aye!
zhTW_text: 知道啦！

jaJP_text:
사실, 예전에는 방어에만 급급했던
투스쿨 병사들과의 싸움에서도 대등하게 겨룰 수 있게 되었다.
enUS_text: Where before I was forced to fight defensively, now I can face Tuskur soldiers on equal standing.
zhTW_text:
之前的在下只能一味防守，
但現在與圖斯庫爾士兵交戰，卻能互相抗衡。

enUS_text: Y-Yaaargh!
zhTW_text: 噫、噫……

jaJP_text:
좋아, 이제 절반 정도 남았나?
계속 몰아붙인다!!
enUS_text: Looks like I've taken out half of you already. Now to clean up the rest!
zhTW_text:
很好，差不多剩一半吧？
繼續上吧！

enUS_text: Gwuh!
zhTW_text: 啊唔！？

jaJP_text:
너희들 때문에 내가 얼마나 고생했는지…….
하지만 그 고생이 드디어 보답받는구나! 드, 드디어…… 으으……
enUS_text: You've put me through so much... Now you're going to get your just desserts! F-Finally... *sniffle*
zhTW_text:
你們知道都因為你們，害我有多麼辛苦嗎……
但我的辛苦也有了回報！　終、終於……嗚嗚……

jaJP_text:
큰언니는 도로타보우의 엄마니까 말이야.
강한 게 당연하지!
enUS_text: Sis is Dorotabou's mommy, after all. Of course she's strong!
zhTW_text:
因為是大姐姐是德羅塔伯的媽媽啊。
這麼強也是當然的！

enUS_text: M-Me, my lady?
zhTW_text: 我嗎？

jaJP_text:
조금만 더 거기서 벌어들일 생각이었는데,
네놈들이 쳐들어오는 바람에 다 망쳐 놨어!
enUS_text: We weren't done squeezing that town yet. We had to pack up and move early because of you!
zhTW_text:
我們原本打算在那邊再多賺一些的，
都因為你們闖進來而通通泡湯了！

jaJP_text:
흠…….
격렬한 검격이로다, 이대로 일방적으로 몰아붙여지면 수세에 몰릴 터이나
enUS_text: Hmm... Your sword work is impressive. Against a normal opponent, you could probably keep them on the defensive and tire them out.
zhTW_text:
唔……
好激烈的劍戟之戰，再這樣不斷被單方面攻擊的話，可能會沒有餘力發動攻勢。

enUS_text: Nrgh... W-We're not done yet!
zhTW_text: 咳咳……還、還沒完！

jaJP_text: 아까 기습당한 몫도 있고 하니, 이번엔 먼저 하시죠.
enUS_text: I got the jump on you before, so feel free to make the first move this time.
zhTW_text: 既然人家剛剛出其不意攻擊了，這次就請妳先出招吧。

咕嚕嚕！
咕嚕嚕嚕～！

jaJP_text: 큭! 생각했던 것 이상으로 숙련도가 높아…!
enUS_text: Urk...! You're more skilled than I expected.
zhTW_text: 嗚！　練度比我想像中還高！

enUS_text: Aye!
zhTW_text: 知道啦！

enUS_text: Whup.
zhTW_text: 嘿咻。

enUS_text: I just hope he won't lose too quickly.
zhTW_text: 所以你可別三兩下就被解決囉。

enUS_text: B-But he...!
zhTW_text: 可、可是，這傢伙……

jaJP_text:
거의 기척을 느끼지 못해서,
하마터면 한칼 맞을 뻔했다.
enUS_text: I didn't even sense their presence. I was close to taking a hit.
zhTW_text:
畢竟幾乎沒發現對方的氣息，
差一點就要被打個正著了。

jaJP_text:
하지만 이 숫자라면 화살이 다 떨어질 가능성이 있다.
우리도 나서겠다.
enUS_text: I suppose we shouldn't risk her running out of arrows. I'll join the fray too.
zhTW_text:
不過話雖如此，以這個數量來看，箭可能會用光。
吾等也過去吧。

enUS_text: Sure thing. How's about you take that group over there, Ougi?
zhTW_text:
知道囉。
那邊的士兵就交給扇吧。

jaJP_text:
네…….
코코포가 지켜주지 않았으면 큰일 날 뻔했어요.
enUS_text: Right. If Cocopo hadn't protected us, we'd have been in real trouble.
zhTW_text:
是……
要是可可啵沒有保護我的話，後果不堪設想呢。

jaJP_text:
노스리씨라면 그렇게 말할 줄 알았데이.
적을 많이 쓰러뜨릴수록 오슈토르씨가 칭찬해 줄 테고,
역시 노스리씨도 칭찬받고 싶은 기라.
enUS_text: I had a feeling you'd see it that way. Oshtor's sure to compliment whoever does the best, and you want that to be you, right?
zhTW_text:
就知道鵟小姐你會這麼說。
要是打倒很多敵人，能受奧修特爾先生誇獎，
果然鵟小姐也是想被誇獎的吧。

enUS_text: Got it!
zhTW_text: 好！

enUS_text: Hah! Hyah!
zhTW_text:
喝！
呼……

enUS_text: Whoops... I think I had a close escape just now.
zhTW_text: …………等等，這樣很危險吧？

enUS_text: Nosuri...
zhTW_text: ……鵟小姐。

jaJP_text: 노스리 녀석, 속임수라는 걸 알자마자 강하게 나오네…….
enUS_text: Nosuri got awfully bold once she found out about the cheating.
zhTW_text: 鵟那傢伙，一發現對方是出老千的，就瞬間氣勢高漲……

enUS_text: I'd say you're about as strong as our Kuon, for sure.
zhTW_text: 強度和大小姐算是不相上下吧。

jaJP_text:
아무래도 아직 더 어울려 주실 수 있을 것 같군요.
부디 전력으로. 저도…… 가겠습니다!
enUS_text: It seems we're not done yet. In that case, allow me to come at you with everything I have!
zhTW_text:
看來我還有幸能繼續和你們交手呢。
請務必使出全力。　我也會……這麼做的！
咕嚕！　咕嚕嚕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: Hey, no fair starting without me.
zhTW_text:
哎呀呀。
怎麼自個兒開始了，真狡猾。

enUS_text: I'm sure that would make him happy, too.
zhTW_text: 想必哈克先生也會很高興的……

enUS_text: Yeah, and she'd win, too!
zhTW_text: 唷，壓倒性勝利！

enUS_text: Hah!
zhTW_text: 哈！

enUS_text: Heehee, you guys are really starting to shape up.
zhTW_text:
嘻嘻。
小哥們，氣勢不錯嘛～

enUS_text: You're determined to go through with this, then?
zhTW_text: ……你無論如何都要打嗎？

enUS_text: Haku...?
zhTW_text: 哈克……先生？

jaJP_text:
투스쿨 병사들 중에 정예가 많다는 건 알고 있었지만,
그 대장인 그대도 고작 그 정도일 거라고 생각했지.
enUS_text: I know now that Tuskur has many powerful warriors on its side. And you might just be one of the best.
zhTW_text:
雖然原先就知道圖斯庫爾有許多精悍強者，
但沒想到領率那些士兵的您會有那等水準。

enUS_text: I-I've been training hard since the last time.
zhTW_text: 從、從那之後，我們也努力鍛鍊過了！

enUS_text: Oof!
zhTW_text: 唔嘔！

enUS_text: Oh no... Oh no oh no oh no...!
zhTW_text: 哇哇、哇哇哇哇哇……

jaJP_text: 크로우 공, 폐하에 대한 모욕은 거기까지 해 주시기 바랍니다.
enUS_text: Lord Kurou, I'll thank you not to insult our sovereign any more than that.
zhTW_text: 克羅大人，對聖上的侮辱就到此為止吧。

jaJP_text:
아아, 그렇네요.
예전 형님은 칼만으로 싸우셨으니까요.
enUS_text: Right, of course. He never used to use anything other than his sword.
zhTW_text:
啊，說得也是呢。
畢竟以前兄長大人只用刀作戰。

jaJP_text:
뭐지, 이 이상한 분위기는.
설마 쿠온도 진심인 건가#@－－#
enUS_text: Something feels odd here... Why is Kuon getting into it, too?
zhTW_text:
這種詭異的氣氛是怎麼回事。
難道久遠也是認真的嗎#@－－#

jaJP_text:
하지만 지금은 다르다.
그 베나위님과 대등하게 승부하고 있다!
enUS_text: Fighting you as an equal's a pleasure and a privilege, Lord Benawi!
zhTW_text:
但現在不同。
在下和那個貝納威大人打得平分秋色！

jaJP_text:
둘이 하나를 상대하다니 치사하데이.
그래도 그 편이 날 더 즐겁게 해 줄 것 같구마.
enUS_text: Two against one, huh? Hardly fair, but at least it'll be more fun for me!
zhTW_text:
竟然二對一，真狡猾。
不過，感覺這樣人家打起來更開心。

enUS_text: Very well.
zhTW_text: 收到。

enUS_text: Too slow!
zhTW_text: #@－－#太天真了。

enUS_text: Honestly, your skills aren't bad. However...
zhTW_text:
實力不錯。
但#@－－#

jaJP_text:
으, 으음.
너무 빨라서 눈으로 쫓을 수가 없느니라.
enUS_text: I-Indeed. I can barely keep up with their movements.
zhTW_text:
是、是啊。
快到余的眼睛都跟不上了。

enUS_text: That was always my intent.
zhTW_text: 不必您說，我也會這麼做。

enUS_text: I'm glad I asked for your assistance with this matter, Nosuri.
zhTW_text: 現在想起來，有拜託鵟真是太好了。

jaJP_text: 이대로면 누님이 전부 다 쓰러뜨려 버릴 기세네요.
enUS_text: At this rate, she could easily defeat them all on her own.
zhTW_text: 再這樣下去，感覺所有人都要被大姊打倒了。

enUS_text: When it comes to your other attributes, though...
zhTW_text: 不過，果然胸部還是……

enUS_text: Seiyah!
zhTW_text: 喝啊啊啊！

enUS_text: Ready, Cocopo?
zhTW_text: 可可啵

enUS_text: Heheh, not bad. But let's see how you deal with this!
zhTW_text:
嘻嘻嘻，真有你的。
不過，這樣就結束了？

jaJP_text:
절대로 나중으로 미뤄 두고 쌓아둔 것도 아니고,
막상 하려고 하다가 자 버려서 결국 아무것도 안 한 적도 없다고!?
enUS_text: I certainly didn't put it all off until the last minute then end up falling asleep so that I achieved absolutely nothing the whole time I was assigned to it!
zhTW_text:
我絕對沒有拖延累積工作，
也沒有本來打算要工作卻不小心睡著到頭來什麼都沒做喔！？

enUS_text: Nrk...!
Aw man, I missed. You're really good at this.
zhTW_text:
哎呀呀……打偏了。
真有你的。

enUS_text: Ooogee!
zhTW_text: 嗚啊！

jaJP_text:
그렇군…….
받지 않을 이유도 없고, 좋아.
enUS_text: Hmm... Okay, I guess. There's no reason we can't have a little fun with this mission.
zhTW_text:
嗯……
好啊，反正也沒有拒絕的理由。

jaJP_text:
……전언은 취소하마.
저자라면 조금은 무네치카를 즐겁게 해 줄 수 있겠구나.
enUS_text: I take back what I said before. It seems he can keep Munechika entertained after all.
zhTW_text:
……余收回前言。
若是那傢伙，或許就能稍微討宗近歡心呢。

jaJP_text: 성상이시여, 이 정도 일로 마음을 흐트러뜨리시면 아니 되옵니다.
enUS_text: You mustn't lose composure over such a trivial matter, my liege.
zhTW_text: 聖上，不能因為這點瑣事就動怒。

enUS_text: Hm, a sneak attack from behind, huh?
zhTW_text:
唔……
從背後發動突襲啊。

enUS_text: Heh. Very good.
zhTW_text: 呵呵，我明白了。

jaJP_text:
네.
후후, 이건 이거대로 즐거워질 것 같네요.
enUS_text: Very well. Heheh, this could be fun in its own way.
zhTW_text:
好的。
呵呵，感覺會很有趣呢。
咕嚕嚕～<onpu>

enUS_text: Uh oh...
zhTW_text: 哎呀呀……

jaJP_text:
우, 우리는 오슈토르님의 정예!
지금이야말로…라 했는데 으갸아아!!!
enUS_text: W-We are Lord Oshtor's elite troops! This time we'll— Gyaaargh!
zhTW_text:
我、我們是奧修特爾大人的精銳部隊！
這次一定……呃啊啊啊啊啊！

enUS_text: Gwagh!
zhTW_text: 嗚啊！

enUS_text: Wow, this is amazing...
zhTW_text: 好棒……

jaJP_text:
……형님께서 하쿠 씨의 뜻을 잇고 계시니,
하쿠 씨로 보였던 걸지도 모릅니다.
enUS_text: ...He's decided to carry on Haku's legacy. I guess it's no wonder he'd start to resemble him a little.
zhTW_text:
……或許是因為兄長大人繼承了哈克先生的心念，
看起來才會有哈克先生的影子。

jaJP_text:
이렇게 된 이상 봐줄 순 없으니까…… 미리 말해 둘게.
죽여 버리게 되면 미안하지만, 포기해.
enUS_text: Once I get like this, I can't hold back... I apologize in advance if I end up killing you.
zhTW_text:
事情演變至此，我也無法手下留情了……所以我先說在前頭。
要是我打死你的話就不好意思，請你認命吧。

enUS_text: You really have become stronger.
zhTW_text: ……您果然變強了呢。

enUS_text: I'm here to help!
zhTW_text: 我也來助陣！

jaJP_text:
이런, 이번엔 이쪽을 화나게 해 버렸나.
하지만 당신도 고생이 많구려.
enUS_text: Whoops, looks like I'm getting everyone mad at me today. I figure you've got it hard too though, my lady.
zhTW_text:
哎呀，這次換成惹怒這邊了？
不過你也真辛苦啊。

enUS_text: Is that all you have to say?
zhTW_text: 你想說的就這些嗎？

enUS_text: Why would I want to stop? This is so exciting!
zhTW_text:
有什麼停手的必要嗎？
人家興致勃勃的呢。

enUS_text: What?
zhTW_text: 咦？

jaJP_text:
죄송해요…….
그래도 저도 질 수는 없어요……!
enUS_text: I'm sorry... But I cannot afford to lose!
zhTW_text:
對不起……
但我也不能輸……！

jaJP_text:
지금의 당신은 강합니다.
덕분에 저도 진심을 내지 않으면 안 될 것 같군요.
enUS_text: You're strong too, Lady Munechika—now more than ever. I can see that I'll have to give this my all as well.
zhTW_text:
現在的您很強大喔。
多虧如此，我似乎也不得不動真本事了。

jaJP_text:
아하하, 제대로 막아 내다니 기특하네.
예전하고는 완전 딴판이구마.
enUS_text: Nice work, you actually blocked it. You've come a long way.
zhTW_text:
啊哈哈，有好好防住，真了不起。
跟以前簡直天差地遠。

enUS_text: Argh...!
zhTW_text: 咳咳……

jaJP_text:
음, 음.
무네치카야, 야마토 팔주장의 강함을 그 자에게 똑똑히 보여 주거라!
enUS_text: Indeed. Keep it up, Munechika. Show them the power of a Pillar General!
zhTW_text:
嗯、嗯。
宗近啊，讓那個人見識大和八柱將的強大之處！

enUS_text: Hrgh...!
zhTW_text: 哼！

jaJP_text:
제기랄! 진형을 무너뜨리지 마!
단숨에 포위하는 거다!
enUS_text: Tch...! Don't break formation! Surround her!
zhTW_text:
可惡！　要維持陣形！
一口氣包圍她！

enUS_text: Gwurgh!
Shaaaaaargh!
Awroooh!
zhTW_text: 轟喔喔喔喔！

enUS_text: Yrgh!
zhTW_text: 呀嗚！？

jaJP_text:
짐이 세상을 바로잡는 여행을 결심한 것은,
돌아가신 아버님 뒤를 잇는 것과 함께 오슈토르를…… 하쿠를 찾기 위해서였느니라.
enUS_text: The reason I set out on this journey of restoration was to carry on my father's legacy and to find Oshtor... or rather, Haku.
zhTW_text:
余會下定決心踏上世間改革之旅，
不只是為了繼承父親大人的遺志，同時也是為了要尋找奧修特爾……尋找哈克。

enUS_text: Cocopo...!
zhTW_text: 可可啵！

enUS_text: Heehee. Yeah, that's more like it.
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻，這股氣勢就對啦。

jaJP_text:
젠장, 떠올리니까 또 열받네!
선생님들, 저 녀석들을 철저하게 때려눕혀 주세요!
enUS_text: Urgh, just thinking about it makes me see red! Bodyguards, give these meddling busybodies a thrashing!
zhTW_text:
可惡，回想起來就滿肚子火！
老師們，請把那些傢伙打得落花流水吧！

enUS_text: Wargh! Our allies are falling one after another...
zhTW_text:
嗚哇！
同伴們一個個被……

jaJP_text: ……이렇게 된 이상, 일단 기절시킨 뒤 사정을 설명하는 수밖에 없겠군요.
enUS_text: We're going to have to knock them out and restrain them before we can properly explain things.
zhTW_text: ……看來只能暫時讓他昏過去，之後再好好解釋了。

enUS_text: Gwuh...
zhTW_text: 嗚、嗚嗚嗚……

enUS_text: Let's see how you like it when I go on the attack!
zhTW_text: 接下來換我上了！

jaJP_text:
이런 산속 깊은 곳에 숨어 있었다니…….
저기, 다치신 데는 없으십니까?
enUS_text: I never thought they'd get this far into the mountains... Excuse me, are you all right?
zhTW_text:
竟然躲到這種深山裡面……
那個，你有沒有受傷？

enUS_text: S-Stop it, Cocopo!
zhTW_text: 可、可可啵！　不行！

jaJP_text:
아니, 이 정도는…….
너희들, 시스 님께 평소 단련의 성과를 보여 드릴 때다!
enUS_text: We're not done yet... Everyone, this is our chance to show Lady Shis the results of our training!
zhTW_text:
不，這點程度……
我說你們，現在正是發揮每天受希絲大人鍛鍊的成果之時！

enUS_text: Hyah!
C-Cocopo...
zhTW_text: 可、可可啵……

jaJP_text:
과연 형님께서 이끄는 부대답네요.
저도 배우겠습니다!
enUS_text: I guess it's no wonder, with a leader like Oshtor. I'll have to learn from this, too!
zhTW_text:
不愧是兄長大人率領的部隊。
也讓我學到不少！

jaJP_text:
좋아, 노스리 님이 동요했다.
이 기세로 계속 쏘는 거다!
enUS_text: See? Even Lady Nosuri can get shaken up. Keep firing!
zhTW_text:
很好，鵟大人陷入動搖了。
照這個步調繼續放箭！

jaJP_text:
후후, 말투만 바뀌었을 뿐인데 공격력이 늘어나다니…….
꽤 흥미로운 결과네요.
enUS_text: Heh. Who would have thought a new mode of speech would make such a difference? Quite the interesting result.
zhTW_text:
呵呵，沒想到光是改變用字遣辭，攻擊力就提升了……
真是有趣的結果。

jaJP_text:
한층 더 무인으로서 성장할 것을,
그리고 여성으로서의 성장 또한 이 자리에서 맹세하겠노라!
enUS_text: I'll keep growing, both as a Mononofu and as a woman. This I swear!
zhTW_text:
在下於此發誓，要作為武士、
作為女性更上一層樓！

jaJP_text: 루루냥도 안 된다면…… 거기 있는, 그 뭐냐……
enUS_text: If I can't fight Rulie, then... Hey, you over there.
zhTW_text: 要是連小露露都不行的話……那邊的……呃……

jaJP_text: 우, 우리도 말이야, 그 뒤로 고생이 많았다고!
enUS_text: Hey, we've had it hard too!
zhTW_text: 我、我們也一樣，在那之後過得很辛苦啊！

enUS_text: Ack...!
zhTW_text: 可惡……！

jaJP_text:
아이고야, 이 정도로 벌써 항복인 기가?
실망이구마.
enUS_text: Sheesh, you're throwing in the towel already? What a letdown.
zhTW_text:
哎呀呀，這點程度就要投降了？
真令人失望。

jaJP_text:
괜찮은 거야?
자만에는 대가가 따르게 될 텐데.
enUS_text: Are you sure? If you're overconfident, you're going to pay for it...
zhTW_text:
這樣好嗎？
你會為自己的驕傲付出代價的。

enUS_text: Control yourself, Atuy.
zhTW_text: 阿圖依，自重一點。

jaJP_text:
젠장~! 우리도 질 순 없지 않겠어!
너희들, 정신 바짝 차리고 가자고!!
enUS_text: Damn it... Get it together, all of you! Show her what we're really made of!
zhTW_text:
可惡～！　我們也不能輸！
你們都給我加把勁！

enUS_text: Nrgh?!
zhTW_text: 呼咿！？

enUS_text: Phew... I finally caught up with you guys!
zhTW_text: 我總算……總算把你們逼到絕境了！

jaJP_text: 어느 틈에…… 조금 전까지만 해도 꽤 거리가 있었을 텐데.
enUS_text: She closed that distance like it was nothing at all...
zhTW_text: 距離是什麼時候縮短的……她們剛剛還隔得挺遠啊。

enUS_text: Where do you think you're going?
zhTW_text: 你打算去哪？

jaJP_text:
소생은 강해지고 있다.
이것은 자만 같은 것이 아니다.
enUS_text: I am stronger now. That's not some arrogant boast - it's the truth.
zhTW_text:
在下已經變強了。
這並不是自負。

enUS_text: Hah! Hyah!

jaJP_text: 그렇다고는 해도, 마냥 재밌다고만 할 상황은 아니잖아.
enUS_text: This is hardly the time to be givin' us a running commentary.
zhTW_text: 話雖如此，現在似乎不是能說有不有趣的情況呢。

enUS_text: Huh...? Argh!
zhTW_text:
咦？
呀！

jaJP_text:
아, 아니에요.
이타크 씨의 공격도 정말 훌륭해요.
enUS_text: You're too kind, Itak. Your attacks were just as impressive.
zhTW_text:
不，過獎了。
伊塔庫先生的攻擊也非常出色喔。

enUS_text: Too slow!
zhTW_text: 太天真了！

enUS_text: Gwuh?!
zhTW_text: 呃啊……！

enUS_text: Gwaaargh!
zhTW_text: 唔啊啊……！

enUS_text: Whoops, looks like we've been found out.
zhTW_text: 哎呀呀，被發現啦。

enUS_text: Ack!
zhTW_text: 呀啊！？

jaJP_text:
적은 가만히 서 있는 표적이 아닙니다.
확실히 조준하고…… 지금입니다!!
enUS_text: You need to get used to dealing with moving targets. Take careful aim, and... Now!
zhTW_text:
敵人並不是呆站不動的標靶。
要瞄準目標……就是現在！

jaJP_text: 여자는, 아빠보다 남자한테 지켜지고 싶은 거야.
enUS_text: A lady prefers getting rescued by a handsome prince.
zhTW_text: 女人啊，比起爸爸，更希望被男人保護。

enUS_text: Fight hard, Sis!
zhTW_text: 大姐姐加油！

enUS_text: Good to see you're all making progress.
zhTW_text: 唷～真有一套。

enUS_text: It's okay, Kiwru.
zhTW_text: 別擔心，奇羽琉。

enUS_text: Gagh?!
zhTW_text: 唔啊！

enUS_text: Whoa!
zhTW_text: 嗚哇！

jaJP_text:
엣?
앗, 네, 다음은 꽤 큰 마을이네요.
enUS_text: Huh? O-Oh, right. Our next stop is in a large town.
zhTW_text:
咦？
啊，是，接下來要去的是相當大的城鎮呢。

enUS_text: Geegeegee...!
zhTW_text: 嘰嘰嘰嘰嘰！

enUS_text: Eeek! I-I can't do this anymore!
zhTW_text:
咿！
我、我做不來啦～！

enUS_text: R-Right!
zhTW_text: 是、是的！

enUS_text: Your Highness, Lady Fumirul, Shinonon...
zhTW_text: 聖上、芙米露露大人、詩諾農……

jaJP_text:
그래서 몸을 움직일 수 있는 게 마냥 즐거운 기라.
응응, 그럼 누가 더 많이 적을 쓰러뜨릴지 승부해 볼래?
enUS_text: There's nothing like getting out in the field and really testing yourself. Hey, why don't we have a contest to see who can defeat the most?
zhTW_text:
所以活動起身體才這麼樂在其中。
嗯嗯，那要不要來比比誰能打倒更多敵人？
咕嚕嚕！

jaJP_text: 후후후후, 가슴에 큰 구멍이 뚫리는 쪽이 먼저일 것 같은데?
enUS_text: Heehee, you might end up with a hole in your chest before that happens.
zhTW_text: 呵呵呵，人家覺得會是妳的胸前先開個大洞耶。

jaJP_text:
이번 싸움…… 절대로 질 수 없거든.
내가 더 많이 적을 쓰러뜨릴 기다! 아하하하하하!
enUS_text: Not that I mind giving you a head start. I'm still not about to lose... I'll defeat so many enemies it'll make your head spin! Ahahahaha!
zhTW_text:
人家絕對……不能輸掉這場比賽。
人家一定要打倒更多敵人！　啊哈哈哈哈哈！

enUS_text: Oh, you're right. They've already got us surrounded.
zhTW_text: 哎呀哎呀，完全被包圍住了呢。

enUS_text: Awroooh!
zhTW_text: 轟嗡嗡嗡！

jaJP_text: 아, 아직 결판이 안 난 건가……!
enUS_text: Th-They're still going at it...!
zhTW_text: 還、還沒分出勝負嗎……！

enUS_text: Osh is strong, all right. But so is Daddy!
zhTW_text:
因為奧修很強啊。
但是爸爸也很強喔！

enUS_text: I feel like there's been a misunderstanding here...
zhTW_text: 你是不是搞錯了什麼？

jaJP_text:
이게 루루티에 언니의 실력…….
방심했다간 목이 단번에 날아가도 이상하지 않겠네.
enUS_text: You too... Rulutieh told me her sister was strong, but this is ridiculous. If I let my guard down for a moment, I could end up losing my head.
zhTW_text:
這就是露露緹耶的姊姊的實力……
要是鬆懈，瞬間頭顱落地也不奇怪。

jaJP_text:
짐은 관대하니,
저자들이 만족할 때까지 지켜봐 주도록 하마!
enUS_text: And I am a benevolent ruler, so I will remain here and observe until my vassals are both satisfied.
zhTW_text:
畢竟余心胸寬大啊，
就守望到他們打到滿意為止吧！

enUS_text: More troops? Where have they been hiding all this time?
zhTW_text:
什麼，有伏兵？
至今為止究竟都躲在哪裡？

jaJP_text:
이 정도는 아무렇지도 않다!
전부 해치워서 오슈토르에게 줄 선물로 삼아 주마!
enUS_text: We can deal with this many, no problem! They'll make a fine souvenir to bring Oshtor.
zhTW_text:
這點程度不算什麼！
通通解決掉，拿回去帶給奧修特爾吧！

jaJP_text:
진짜로 말하자면 말이지?
훨씬 전부터 언젠가 쿠온 씨와
한번 죽어라 싸워 보고 싶어서 근질근질했거든.
enUS_text: I'll be honest with you. I've been itching to have a no-holds-barred battle with you for a while now, Kuon.
zhTW_text:
真要說起來啊，
人家從很久以前，就很想和久遠小姐
互相廝殺，想得不得了呢。

enUS_text: Hah!

jaJP_text:
그, 그런가.
도박이라면, 금전 같은 것을 거는 것이겠지?
enUS_text: I-I see. I assume it's a place where you attempt to win money through games of chance?
zhTW_text:
這、這樣啊。
既然說是賭博，那邊應該會賭錢對吧？

enUS_text: Gaaaaaah!
zhTW_text: 嗚啊！

enUS_text: I can block this...!
zhTW_text: 防住！

enUS_text: O-Oh, I'm sorry. I should help out too, shouldn't I?
zhTW_text:
啊……
對、對不起。　我也要一起……

enUS_text: What? But...
zhTW_text: 唔……這、這個嘛……

enUS_text: Gwargh!
zhTW_text: 呀啊！

enUS_text: Hm! Hah! All right, you're next!
zhTW_text:
呼！　咻！
好了，下一個！

jaJP_text: 아앙? 그런 가는 팔뚝으로 뭘 할 수 있단 거냐!?
enUS_text: And what's a scrawny kid like you going to do to stop us?
zhTW_text: 啊啊？　就憑你那瘦弱的手臂能做什麼？

jaJP_text:
아니요, 저는 괜찮아요!
그보다 네코네 씨는 뒤로 물러나 주세요!
enUS_text: It's okay, I'm fine! Just get behind me, Nekone.
zhTW_text:
不，我沒問題的！
比起我，請貓音小姐你退下吧！

enUS_text: Doesn't look like they're in any mood to come quietly.
zhTW_text: 畢竟也不能默默任由對方出手啊。

jaJP_text: 아, 아니, 딱히 그런 뜻은 아니거든!?
enUS_text: N-No, of course not! Such diversions are beneath me!
zhTW_text: 不、不是那樣的喔！？

enUS_text: L-Lord Kiwru...
zhTW_text: 奇、奇羽琉大人……

jaJP_text:
짐이 그것을 이루는 모습을,
부디 상세로부터 지켜봐 주시옵소서!
enUS_text: Watch over me from Kotuahamuru... There is still much work to do!
zhTW_text:
請在那個世界，
見證余成功的那一刻吧！

enUS_text: Yaaargh!
zhTW_text: 呀啊！

enUS_text: Whoopsie...
zhTW_text: 哎呀呀……

jaJP_text:
그런가.
……자, 그럼 우리도 진심으로 가 보자고!
enUS_text: You think so? Well, I guess I might as well cut loose too!
zhTW_text:
是這樣嗎？
……好了，那我們也認真上吧！

enUS_text: Ughrgrhgh...
zhTW_text: 抖抖抖抖……

jaJP_text:
그곳에 대규모 도박장이 있고,
악행을 저지르는 무리가 있는 모양입니다.
enUS_text: There's a gambling hall there that's doing a lot of shady business.
zhTW_text:
而且還有大規模的賭場，
似乎有人在那裡胡作非為。

enUS_text: Waaargh!
zhTW_text: 唔啊啊啊啊！

enUS_text: Hiyaaah!
zhTW_text: 看我的～！

enUS_text: Hm. I thought I was going to take your head off with that last attack... That's too bad.
zhTW_text: 呼，我還以為我拿下了你的項上人頭……可惜。

enUS_text: Let's... do... this...!
Ooh, what's this?
zhTW_text: 哦，這是什麼？

jaJP_text:
비, 비겁먹지 마라.
너희들, 나를 본받으란 말이다!
enUS_text: What are ya, a bunch of cowards?! Try to be more like me!
zhTW_text:
怕、怕什麼啊。
你們這些傢伙，好好向我看齊！

enUS_text: Kiwru...
zhTW_text: 奇羽琉……

jaJP_text: 그래도 이런 걸 보여 놓고 못 하게 하다니 애가 타네.
enUS_text: It hurts though, watching such an awesome fight and not being able to join in.
zhTW_text: 但看了這種戰鬥還不能一起下去打，也太令人難受了。

enUS_text: It's coming your way, Fumirul!
zhTW_text: 小姐，過去你那邊了！

jaJP_text:
정 원한다면,
짐에게서…… 짐들에게서 빼앗아 보거라!
enUS_text: If you want it, you're going to have to take it from me... From us!
zhTW_text:
要是你們真那麼想要，
就從余……余等手中搶吧！

jaJP_text:
두 사람의 실력은 거의 막상막하…….
섣불리 끼어들면 균형이 무너지고 말아.
enUS_text: It seems like they're equally matched. If I try to butt in now, it could disrupt that balance.
zhTW_text:
兩人實力幾乎不相上下……
要是隨便打斷她們，就會破壞平衡。

enUS_text: Gwuh...urgh...
zhTW_text: 咿……咿咿……

jaJP_text: 과연 유격전을 특기로 하는 노스리 일행답군.
enUS_text: Just what I'd expect from a strike team like yours.
zhTW_text: 不愧是擅長游擊戰的鵟一派。

enUS_text: Wh-What? Me?
zhTW_text: 咦，我嗎？

jaJP_text:
어이, 너 임마~.
창을 단단히 쥐어라!
enUS_text: Hey, get it together! Keep a tighter grip on your spear.
zhTW_text:
喂，我說你～
給我把長槍拿好！

enUS_text: Ooogee!
I don't know about that...
zhTW_text: 實在是……

jaJP_text: 숙련도가 낮다며 한탄하던 게 거짓말처럼 느껴질 만큼 높다.
enUS_text: Looking at you now, it's hard to believe I ever had occasion to lament your poor skills.
zhTW_text: 前不久我還因為他們練度太低而搖頭嘆息，現在卻強得驚人。

enUS_text: Huh? Gwaaargh!
zhTW_text: 唔……　唔啊啊啊！？

jaJP_text:
아하하하하, 즐겁네.
이렇게 두근거리는 건, 그때 이후로 처음이구마!
enUS_text: Ahahaha, this is so much fun! It's been a long time since I got to cut loose like this!
zhTW_text:
哈哈哈哈哈，真愉快啊。
上次這麼興奮應該是那個時候了吧！

enUS_text: Hrgh!
zhTW_text: 唔嗯！

enUS_text: Oof...!

jaJP_text:
하지만 그렇다고 해서 질 수는 없습니다.
오슈토르 님과의 미래를 위해, 반드시 쓰러뜨리겠습니다!
enUS_text: But that's all the more reason why I can't lose. I have to defeat you for the sake of Oshtor's future happiness!
zhTW_text:
但我也不能就這樣敗給她。
為了和奧修特爾大人之間的未來，我要打倒你！

jaJP_text:
흥, 당연하느니라.
야마토의 체신중은 정예만 모여 있으니 말이다.
enUS_text: Naturally. None but the most elite are selected to serve as Tiriryarai.
zhTW_text:
哼，這是當然的。
大和的通訊眾人人都是菁英啊。

jaJP_text: 키우루 씨는 언젠가 나라를 짊어지고 설 사람이니까요.
enUS_text: He's a capable young man. He's going to inherit the position as owlo of his country someday, after all.
zhTW_text: 因為奇羽琉殿下總有一天要承擔起整個國家啊。

enUS_text: "Like that?" What are you talking about?
zhTW_text: 看了？你是指什麼？

jaJP_text:
대단해…….
그 야쿠토와루토 씨를 상대로 한 걸음도 물러서지 않고……
enUS_text: Amazing... Oshtor's keeping up with someone as skilled as Jachdwalt without missing a step.
zhTW_text:
好強……
面對那個亞庫托瓦爾特先生，卻毫不退縮……

enUS_text: Prepare yourself!
zhTW_text: 做好覺悟吧！

enUS_text: Munechika, with me!
zhTW_text: 宗近，出陣！

enUS_text: Seems we don't have the luxury of taking it slow.
zhTW_text: 看來沒時間拖拖拉拉的了。

enUS_text: Let's allow them to fight a little longer, Your Highness.
zhTW_text: 杏樹大人，我們再守望他們一下吧。

enUS_text: Not so fast!
zhTW_text: 休想得逞！

jaJP_text:
에엣!?
그런 말씀 마시고 야쿠토와루토 씨도 싸워 주세요!
enUS_text: Huh?! Don't joke about that, Jachdwalt. You have to fight too!
zhTW_text:
咦！？
請別說那種話，亞庫托瓦爾特先生你也一起戰鬥啦！

enUS_text: Go, Miss Munechika! Give it your all.
zhTW_text:
宗近大人～！
加油～！

enUS_text: Hah!
zhTW_text: 哈啊……！

jaJP_text:
과연, 두 사람 다 대단해…….
거의 움직임이 보이지 않아.
enUS_text: These two are amazing. I can barely follow their movements.
zhTW_text:
好強，兩個人都好厲害……
幾乎看不清她們的動作。

enUS_text: Haha! Ahahaha! Hahahahahaha!
zhTW_text: 啊哈哈！　啊哈哈哈！　啊哈哈哈哈哈！

jaJP_text: 키우루 씨, 지금 저들에게 무슨 말을 해도 소용없습니다.
enUS_text: Kiwru, it's no good trying to talk to them at this point.
zhTW_text: 奇羽琉殿下，現在對他們說什麼都無濟於事的。

enUS_text: A gambling hall?
zhTW_text: 你說，賭場……？

jaJP_text:
좋겠네, 좋겠네…….
저런 거랑 싸울 수 있다니, 키우냥이랑 네코냥이 부럽데이.
enUS_text: Oh man, those two are so lucky! I wish I could fight that thing.
zhTW_text:
太棒了、太棒了……
竟然能和那種的交手，好羨慕小奇羽琉和小貓音啊。

jaJP_text:
흠…….
쿠쥬우리에서 무쌍의 창잡이라고 들었건만,
무네치카로서는 성에 차지 않는 상대일지도 모르겠구나.
enUS_text: Hmm... Kujyuri's spearmen are renowned for their skills, but I suppose even they come up short against Munechika.
zhTW_text:
唔……
雖然余聽說他在九重里是首屈一指的長槍高手，
但看來對宗近來說還是小菜一碟啊。

enUS_text: Are you all right?
zhTW_text: 你沒事吧？

enUS_text: Thanks for cheering us on, Shinonon.
zhTW_text: 謝、謝謝你，小詩諾農。

jaJP_text:
거기!
화살을 쏜 뒤에도 자세를 유지해!
enUS_text: You, there! You need to maintain that posture even after you fire your arrow.
zhTW_text:
那邊的！
射出箭後也要維持姿勢！

enUS_text: Hey, I thought that was my job.
zhTW_text: 哎呀，那個角色應該是我來當才對吧？

enUS_text: You need to do better than that!
zhTW_text: 太弱了！

enUS_text: We'd better step up our game, too.
zhTW_text: 人家這邊也不能輸。

jaJP_text: 그렇지만 눈앞에 즐길 거리가 있는데 참을 수가 없거든.
enUS_text: I know, I know. I just can't help myself when there's so much fun to be had, though!
zhTW_text: 是沒錯，但是樂子就在眼前卻無法盡情享受，人家怎麼忍得住。

jaJP_text:
그때 소생은 자만하고 있었다.
그리고 그 자만이 패배를 불러온 것이다.
enUS_text: The last time, I was arrogant, and that arrogance resulted in my defeat.
zhTW_text:
當時在下過於自負了。
那份自負，招致了敗北的結果。

jaJP_text:
흠…….
저 정도라면 무네 씨 일행에게 맡겨 두면 되지 않겠느냐.
enUS_text: Hm. If this is all these ruffians have got, we may as well leave them to Munechika and Mikazuchi.
zhTW_text:
唔……
若只有那點程度，交給阿宗他們就行了吧。

jaJP_text:
아투이 씨, 노스리 씨!
거기 있지 말고 도와#@－－#
enUS_text: Atuy, Nosuri! Don't just stand there - help us!
zhTW_text:
阿圖依小姐、鵟小姐！
別待在那種地方，快來救救#@－－#

enUS_text: Ha! That's what happens to evildoers in this country!
zhTW_text:
哼哼，看到沒有！
這就是正義的鐵鎚！

jaJP_text:
좋아, 다음은 우리 차례입니다.
여러분, 기합 넣어 주세요!
enUS_text: All right, now it's my turn. Put your heart into it, everyone!
zhTW_text:
很好，接下來換我了。
各位，請拿出幹勁！

enUS_text: Ah, good to know. Maybe he'd appreciate some chamokku liver, then...
zhTW_text:
是、是嗎……
那麼恰摩可的肝也……

enUS_text: B-But...
zhTW_text: 但、但是……

enUS_text: Oshtor, I'll help too.
zhTW_text: 兄長大人，我們也……

enUS_text: Of course. Shumari, it's your time to shine.
zhTW_text:
我知道了。
修瑪利，拜託你了。

jaJP_text:
당연한 거 아냐!
보물이 눈앞에 있는데, 그걸 그냥 놓칠 수 있겠냐고!
enUS_text: Of course! We're not about to pass up treasure when it's right in front of us.
zhTW_text:
那是當然的啊！
寶藏就在眼前了，怎麼可能就這樣放跑啊！

enUS_text: Hah... Heeheehee...
zhTW_text: 呵……呵呵呵……

enUS_text: Whoa... Even I couldn't follow that.
zhTW_text: 完、完全看不見……

enUS_text: You! Go help out that group over there.
zhTW_text: 你去輔助那邊！

enUS_text: Absolutely not.
zhTW_text: 我拒絕。

enUS_text: Heh... Heheheh...
zhTW_text: 呵呵，呵呵呵呵#@－－#

enUS_text: R-Remember the reward, men...

jaJP_text:
이런.
이 녀석들, 제법 움직임이 좋잖아?
enUS_text: Well, now. These guys' moves actually aren't too shabby.
zhTW_text:
嘿咻。
這些傢伙，動作還滿不錯的耶？

enUS_text: I-I'll do what I can to help, too!
zhTW_text: 我、我也會幫忙的！

enUS_text: Atuy...
zhTW_text: 阿圖依。

enUS_text: Heh... Heehee!
zhTW_text: 呵呵，呵呵呵呵～

jaJP_text:
시시하네.
차라리 여기 있는 전원이 한꺼번에 덤벼도 괜찮아.
enUS_text: This isn't even worth my time. You might as well all come at me at once.
zhTW_text:
打起來根本不盡興。
乾脆在場所有人都一起上也行喔。

enUS_text: Hgh! Hah!
zhTW_text: 呼！　喝！

jaJP_text:
뭐라고!? 어, 어떤 곳이냐!
역시 주사위 눈 같은 걸로#@－－#
enUS_text: What?! What was it like? Did you bet on dice, or—
zhTW_text:
什麼！　那、那裡是怎樣的地方！
果然是靠骰子結果之類的#@－－#

jaJP_text:
음.
스스로 세상의 악행을 심판한다는 건 실로 기분 좋은 일이로구나!
enUS_text: Aah, traveling the realm and punishing evildoers with my own hands quite the thrill!
zhTW_text:
嗯。
親自制裁世上的惡徒，著實令人痛快！

enUS_text: A-And what might that be...?
zhTW_text: 有事想問我？

enUS_text: Cocopo...?
zhTW_text: 可可啵……？

jaJP_text:
어쩔 수 없군요.
역시 먼저 기절시킨 뒤 이야기를 진행하죠.
enUS_text: They're too frightened to listen to reason. We'll have to knock them out like we did with the others.
zhTW_text:
真是沒轍。
果然得先讓他們昏過去才能進一步說明。

jaJP_text:
으으응, 지금은 생각하면 안 돼…….
눈앞의 일에 집중하자.
enUS_text: No time to think about that now... I have to concentrate on the task at hand.
zhTW_text:
不，現在不能想那個……
先專注眼前吧。

enUS_text: Better hope my hand doesn't slip and mess up that pretty face of yours!
zhTW_text: 要是東張西望，可愛的臉蛋可是會受傷的喔～？

jaJP_text: ……루루티에 공, 두 사람의 다툼에 휘말리게 해서 미안하오.
enUS_text: Lady Rulutieh, I'm sorry you had to get involved in their fight, even if it's only as a spectator.
zhTW_text: ……露露緹耶殿下，抱歉，害你被捲進那兩人之間的紛爭。

jaJP_text: 죽기 싫어 죽기 싫어 죽기 싫다아아아아아!
enUS_text: I-I d-don't want to diiiiiiiiie...!
zhTW_text: 我不想死我不想死我不想死！

enUS_text: Ooh, there's even more here! I hit the jackpot!
zhTW_text:
哦哦～這邊也有好多啊。
大豐收！

jaJP_text:
바, 바보 자식아!
이쪽으로 활을 당겨서 어쩌자는 거냐!?
enUS_text: Hey, you idiot! Watch where you're pointing that bow!
zhTW_text:
你、你傻了嗎！
射我這邊幹什麼！？

jaJP_text:
분명 말했을 텐데!
네코네 씨에게 다가가면 용서하지 않겠다고!
enUS_text: I warned you! Stay away from Nekone, or you'll have to answer to me!
zhTW_text:
我應該說過了！
要是敢再接近貓音小姐，我不會放過你！

enUS_text: Sh-Shut up, all of you!
zhTW_text: 吵吵吵吵、吵死了！

enUS_text: Yeah, that's what I like to see! Let's have some fun!
zhTW_text:
真不錯、真不錯。
人家也開心起來了。

jaJP_text: 혼자서 저렇게 많은 병사를 상대하고 있는데도, 전혀 멀쩡해 보여……
enUS_text: You're taking on all those soldiers at once without even breaking a sweat.
zhTW_text: 一個人面對那麼多士兵，還這麼游刃有餘……

jaJP_text:
아, 아직 멀었어!
시스 님을 위해서……!
enUS_text: We can still fight...! For Lady Shis!
zhTW_text:
還、還沒完呢！
為了希絲大人……！

enUS_text: Wow, that's some attack.
zhTW_text: 哎呀呀，好驚人的攻擊。

jaJP_text:
지, 진정해 주세요!
저희는 결코 여러분에게 해를 끼칠 생각은……
enUS_text: Hey, calm down! We're not here to hurt you. We just—
zhTW_text:
請、請你冷靜點！
我們絕對沒有要傷害你們的意思……

jaJP_text:
으, 음.
전혀, 조금도 그렇게 생각하지 않았느니라!?
enUS_text: M-Me? Munechika, please. Such a thought never entered my mind!
zhTW_text:
唔，嗯。
余一點、一點興趣都沒有喔！？

enUS_text: Hiyaaah!
zhTW_text: 喝啊啊啊！

enUS_text: S-So this is the Mad Princess of Shyahoro...!
zhTW_text: 這、這就是……夏赫羅的瘋狂公主！

jaJP_text: 인정해 버리면 편해질 텐데, 미련이 남았구나.
enUS_text: It'd be a whole lot less stressful for you if you just admitted the truth, you know.
zhTW_text: 明明乾脆承認就會輕鬆許多，還真嘴硬。

enUS_text: Yeah, that's the stuff! Keep it up.
zhTW_text: 嗯嗯嗯，就是要這樣才行呀。

enUS_text: Hmph!
zhTW_text: 哼！

enUS_text: Ooogee?!
zhTW_text: 嗚吱──！

enUS_text: The last time we fought, I let my strength make me arrogant...
zhTW_text: ……當時，在下過於自負了。

enUS_text: Try not to get blown away!
zhTW_text: 小心別被打飛囉。

enUS_text: Gyargh!
zhTW_text: 咕呼！

jaJP_text: 아마 오라버니가 철선도 함께 써 가며 싸우고 계셔서 그런 것 같아요.
enUS_text: It's probably just because he fights with a metal fan now.
zhTW_text: 我想，是因為兄長也用了鐵扇作戰吧。

enUS_text: Just don't blame me for what happens next!
zhTW_text: 後果會如何，我也不知道喔。

enUS_text: Urk.
zhTW_text: 唔呃……

jaJP_text:
예전에는 일방적으로 몰아붙여져,
이를 악물고 버티는 것밖에 할 수 없었다.
enUS_text: It was frustrating not being able to do anything but weather my opponents' attacks...
zhTW_text:
之前在下只能單方面遭受攻擊，
咬牙忍耐。

jaJP_text:
응, 그런 것 같네.
이 정도면 조금 진심을 내도 괜찮겠제?
enUS_text: Looks like it. I might even be able to get serious around you now!
zhTW_text:
嗯，看得出來呢。
那麼人家稍微動真本事也沒關係吧？

jaJP_text:
미안하지만 모피가 되어 줘야겠다.
오우기, 합 맞춰라!
enUS_text: Sorry, but we need your hide. Come on, Ougi!
zhTW_text:
抱歉，我得讓你變成毛皮了。
扇，配合我！

enUS_text: Pfft...!
zhTW_text: 噗呼……

jaJP_text:
후후.
무네치카 님이라면, 이즈루하 제일의 상대라도 이길 수 있겠네요.
enUS_text: Heehee. Lady Munechika could probably take on the whole of Izuruha by herself.
zhTW_text:
呵呵。
若是宗近大人，就算對方是伊茲魯哈首屈一指的高手，也能戰勝呢。

enUS_text: Let's give this our all!
zhTW_text: 我會全力以赴的！

enUS_text: Whoaaa... They're even faster than Daddy!
zhTW_text:
哦哦……
比爸爸還快！

jaJP_text:
뭐냐!?
벼벼벼, 별로 칭찬받고 싶은 건 아니거든!
enUS_text: Wh-Wh-What? It's not like I'm only doing this for him...!
zhTW_text:
什！？
我我我、我可沒有想被誇獎啊！

jaJP_text:
역시 팔주장 중 한 명, 강하다……!
하지만 나도 질 수는 없다!
enUS_text: You're strong... As I'd expect from a Pillar General. But I haven't lost yet!
zhTW_text:
不愧是八柱將之一，好強……！
但我也不能輸！

enUS_text: Your Majesty, don't get emotional.
zhTW_text: 聖上，請勿衝動行事。

enUS_text: Hiiiyah!
zhTW_text: 吃我一擊啊啊啊啊！

enUS_text: You say that, but you're still fighting as well.
zhTW_text: 說是這麼說，你也打倒不少啊……

jaJP_text:
야쿠토와루토 씨, 오우기 씨.
다음엔 저들에게 검술을 지도해 주실 수 있나요?
enUS_text: Jachdwalt, Ougi, do you think you could show the troops some swordwork next?
zhTW_text:
亞庫托瓦爾特先生、扇先生。
接下來能請你們為他們指導劍術嗎？

jaJP_text:
부디 진심으로 덤벼 주시길 바랍니다.
소생도 진심으로 임할 생각이오.
enUS_text: Come at me with everything you have. I'll do the same.
zhTW_text:
請務必使出全力。
在下也會動用全力挑戰您的。

enUS_text: Heh. You're getting pretty good at this.
zhTW_text: 哈哈，挺有一套的嘛。

jaJP_text:
우히히.
좀 더, 좀 더 즐겁게 해 주이소!
enUS_text: Heehee, make it fun for me, darlings!
zhTW_text:
嘻嘻。
再多讓人家玩玩吧！

jaJP_text: 오라버니는 하쿠 씨의 뜻을 이어받고 계십니다.
enUS_text: And... If Haku were here now, and knew my brother was so committed to keeping his memory alive...
zhTW_text: 兄長繼承了哈克先生的心念。

enUS_text: Gwurgh...!
zhTW_text: 唔唔……！

enUS_text: She's so fast!

jaJP_text:
방금 건 누가 봐도 심장을 노린 일격…….
아투이 녀석, 진심인 건가!?
enUS_text: You were clearly aiming for her heart! Just how seriously are you taking this match?
zhTW_text:
剛才那招顯然是瞄準心臟吧……
阿圖依那傢伙，是認真的嗎！？

jaJP_text: 게다가 저런 높은 곳에 적이 숨어 있을 거라고는 보통 생각하지 못하겠지.
enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

enUS_text: Yaaargh!
zhTW_text: 呀啊啊啊啊！

enUS_text: Whup, that was a close one.
zhTW_text: 哎呀，好險、好險。
咕嚕！

enUS_text: Let's go, Cocopo!
zhTW_text: 可可啵，拜託你……！

jaJP_text:
무, 무슨 표정이냐!
설마 의심하고 있는 게냐!?
enUS_text: Quit looking at me like that! What, do you think I'm lying?
zhTW_text:
你、你那表情是怎樣！
難道你在懷疑我嗎！？

jaJP_text:
그 후로 포로가 되었고,
후미뤼르 공 덕분에 자유의 몸이 되었소.
enUS_text: When I was taken prisoner afterward, I only escaped thanks to Lady Fumirul's help.
zhTW_text:
在那之後在下淪為囚犯，
多虧有芙米露露大人，才得以重獲自由。

enUS_text: Hah!
Hmph!
zhTW_text: 哼！

enUS_text: Geegeegee!
zhTW_text: 嗚吱吱吱吱！

enUS_text: Get ready, everyone. Here we go!
zhTW_text:
配合彼此的步調！
要上了！

jaJP_text:
좋은 여자란,
결코 자기 말을 거짓으로 만들지 않는 법이다!!
enUS_text: A good woman never lets herself be proven wrong!
zhTW_text:
所謂的好女人，
絕對說到做到！

enUS_text: Leave this to me!
zhTW_text: 這邊請交給我吧！

enUS_text: Gargh!
zhTW_text: 呃啊！？

enUS_text: Nosuri sounds like she's about to start crying.
zhTW_text: 鵟那傢伙哭得唏哩嘩啦的……

enUS_text: EEEEEEEEEK!
zhTW_text: 噫咿咿咿咿咿咿咿咿咿咿！

jaJP_text:
그래 그래, 제법 강해 보이기도 하고.
우리랑 한번 죽어라 붙어 볼래?
enUS_text: Yeah, you look pretty strong. How'd you like to fight me to the death?
zhTW_text:
對對對，畢竟看起來也挺強的。
要不要和人家廝殺一下？

jaJP_text: 게다가 손님들한테 돈 돌려내라고 쫓겨 다녔단 말이야!?
enUS_text: And ever since then, we've had angry customers chasin' after us demanding their money back!
zhTW_text: 而且還被客人追討賺來的錢！

enUS_text: Just what we'd expect from Lady Munechika.
zhTW_text: 真不愧是宗近大人。

enUS_text: We...
zhTW_text: 我們……

enUS_text: Ookee! Geegeegee! Kee-kee!
zhTW_text:
嗚吱──！
吱吱吱！　嗚吱吱吱吱！

jaJP_text:
좋아, 측면에서 호흡 맞추는 거다!!
키우루 공에게 공격할 틈을 줘선 안 된다!
enUS_text: That's right, come in from the side! Don't give Sir Kiwru a chance to attack!
zhTW_text:
很好，從旁配合吧！
不要讓奇羽琉殿下有機會攻擊！

enUS_text: Don't give up yet!
zhTW_text: 不，還沒結束！

enUS_text: I got it.
zhTW_text: 嗯。

jaJP_text:
아, 아니에요…….
언니와 쿠온 님의 마음은, 저도 알 것 같으니까요……
enUS_text: N-No, it's fine... I can see where they're coming from; both of them.
zhTW_text:
不、不會……
畢竟我也能明白姊姊大人和久遠大人的心情……

jaJP_text: 소생은 후미뤼르 공처럼 될 수는 없다.
enUS_text: I know I'll never be like Lady Fumirul.
zhTW_text: 在下無法成為像芙米露露大人那樣的人。

jaJP_text:
여, 여기까지 도망쳐 왔단 말이야!
반드시 살아남고 말겠어……!!
enUS_text: We've made it this far, we can't give up now... We're going to survive!
zhTW_text:
我、我好不容易才逃到這裡！
我一定要活下去！

enUS_text: Cocopo, please...! You have to calm down.
zhTW_text:
可可啵……
真是的，拜託你冷靜下來！

enUS_text: Aye!

jaJP_text:
성상이시여, 부디 저희 뒤로 물러나 주십시오.
이 정도는 소생들만으로도 충분#@－－#
enUS_text: Your Majesty, get behind me. You've done more than enough for one—
zhTW_text:
聖上，請待在我等身後。
這點程度，有在下等人便足矣#@－－#

enUS_text: You seem rather pleased with yourself, all the same.
zhTW_text: 呵呵，你嘴上這麼說，看起來卻很高興呢。

enUS_text: Guess I'll just have to finish it here!
zhTW_text:
就趁現在，
一口氣收拾掉吧……！

enUS_text: Dear sister, may I leave this to you?
zhTW_text: 大姊，這邊能交給我嗎？

enUS_text: Die! Die, die, diiiiiiiieee!
zhTW_text: 去死！　去死去死去死去死！

enUS_text: Hyah!
zhTW_text: 哈啊……！

jaJP_text:
빠, 빠르다…!!
눈으로 쫓는 것만 해도 벅차…!
enUS_text: She's so fast! It's like she just disappeared!
zhTW_text:
好、好快！
眼睛都差點跟不上了……！

jaJP_text: 그, 그렇게 말하고 우리를 죽일 생각이잖아!
enUS_text: Y-You're only saying that so we'll let our guards down and you can kill us!
zhTW_text: 你、你們嘴上這麼說，但其實是想殺掉我們吧！

enUS_text: Yeeeurgh!
zhTW_text: 呀啊啊啊啊！？

jaJP_text:
응? 아아, 괜찮아 괜찮아.
이 정도로 기죽을 거면, 내 종 실격입니다.
enUS_text: Hm? Oh, don't sweat it. They wouldn't be worthy followers if they let a little beating like this get them down.
zhTW_text:
嗯？　哦，沒事、沒事。
要是這點程度就倒下，根本不配當我的僕從。

jaJP_text:
짐은 야마토의 제, 안쥬이니라.
그것을 이 자들에게, 세상에 들끓는 악인들에게 알리고…….
그리고 먼 땅, 투스쿨에까지 그 용명을 떨치도록 하겠노라!
enUS_text: I am Anju, Mikado of Yamato. I'll show these villains what happens to those who threaten the peace, and make my glorious deeds known even in far-off Tuskur!
zhTW_text:
余乃大和之帝杏樹。
余要讓蔓延世間的惡徒知曉這個事實……
並讓自己的名聲遠播至圖斯庫爾！

enUS_text: Urk...!
zhTW_text: 唔唔……！

jaJP_text: 하지만…… 후미뤼르 공이 동경할 만한 여성이 되는 것은 가능하겠지.
enUS_text: All the same... I feel like I can at least aspire to be more like her.
zhTW_text: 但……能成為芙米露露大人也心生憧憬的女性。

enUS_text: Hah! Hiyaaah!
zhTW_text: 喝啊！　哈啊啊！

enUS_text: Hnh? Ah...!
zhTW_text: 唔？　可惡……！

enUS_text: ...! Kiwru!
Haha... Hahaha...
zhTW_text: 啊、啊哈哈哈……

enUS_text: That's no one's fault but your own.
zhTW_text: 不，那是自作自受。

enUS_text: Amazing! She knocked that fierce volley of attacks aside!
zhTW_text: 喔喔，她把那記猛擊給反彈回去了！

enUS_text: We can still fight!
zhTW_text: 還能繼續！

enUS_text: With your life!
zhTW_text: #@－－#以自己的性命為代價。

enUS_text: We're not done with you yet!
zhTW_text: 還沒結束呢。

enUS_text: Y-Yes, sir!
zhTW_text: 是、是的！

jaJP_text:
어이 어이, 전투 경험도 없는 풋내기 병사잖아.
좀 더 봐주면서 해.
enUS_text: Hey, these are new recruits. Go easy on them; they've never seen real combat before.
zhTW_text:
喂喂喂，他們可是沒有實戰經驗的外行人啊。
稍微放點水吧。

jaJP_text:
뭐, 이해 못 할 것도 없지.
그 뒤로 한동안 절약 생활을 강요당해서 꽤 고생하는 눈치였으니까.
enUS_text: I can't say I blame her, though. It hasn't been easy for her, living on a shoestring budget after your last encounter.
zhTW_text:
哎，也不是不能理解。
在那之後她被迫節儉度日，過得挺貧苦的。

enUS_text: Seiyah!
zhTW_text: 哈啊……！

enUS_text: Hiyah!
zhTW_text: 看我的！

enUS_text: *rattle, rattle*
zhTW_text: 嘰嘰嘰嘰嘰嘰！

enUS_text: *rattle, rattle*
zhTW_text:
嘰嘰！
嘰嘰嘰嘰嘰！

jaJP_text:
소생들도 마찬가지입니다!
모두, 키우루 공의 가르침을 받는다는 마음으로 덤벼라!
enUS_text: We feel the same! We're happy for anything you can teach us, Sir Kiwru!
zhTW_text:
吾等也是！
各位，抱著向奇羽琉殿下討教的覺悟動手吧！

enUS_text: Heh. Nice going, dear sister.
zhTW_text: ……呵呵，不愧是大姊。

jaJP_text:
그리고 수많은 전장을 누비며,
수많은 맹자들과 싸워#@－－#힘을 길렀다.
enUS_text: The battles I've fought since then, the warriors I've faced... They've all made me stronger.
zhTW_text:
接著在下奔赴過許多戰場，
與許多強者交手#@－－#提升了自我。

enUS_text: B-Beasts...?!
zhTW_text: 噫，是野獸……！？

enUS_text: Sister, the soldiers...!
zhTW_text:
姊、姊姊大人……！
士兵們都……！

jaJP_text: 그리고 쿠온, 그대에게 짐의 힘을 알리기 위해
enUS_text: That, and to prove my true power to Kuon!
zhTW_text: 還有讓久遠你知道余的力量。

enUS_text: Is that all you've got?
zhTW_text: 就這樣？

jaJP_text:
흥, 어디서든 덤벼 봐라.
이 나를 적으로 돌린 걸 후회하게 해 주겠다!
enUS_text: By all means, bring it on. But you're going to regret making an enemy of me!
zhTW_text:
哼，儘管放馬過來。
我會讓你們因與我為敵而後悔莫及！

jaJP_text:
자, 나는 여기 있다!
잘 보고 활을 당겨라!
enUS_text: Okay, I'm right here! Take a good look and draw your arrows.
zhTW_text:
好了，我在這裡！
仔細看著再放出箭！

jaJP_text: 또, 또 저렇게…… 히익, 히앗, 아아아아아아아아아!
enUS_text: Just like you did before... N-No! Aaaargh!
zhTW_text: 又要被那樣……噫！呀啊、啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

jaJP_text:
음! 맡기마 오우기!!
확 가 버려라!!
enUS_text: Go ahead, Ougi! I can handle this!
zhTW_text:
嗯！　交給你了，扇！
儘管大顯身手吧！

enUS_text: Urgh...!
Too slow!
zhTW_text: 太弱了！

enUS_text: S-Stay away from me!
zhTW_text: 不、不准過來！
咕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: Gwagh!
zhTW_text: 嗚啊！

enUS_text: Guess maybe I got these two a little too fired up...
zhTW_text: ……真是的，我煽動過頭了嗎？

enUS_text: It's just a scratch...
zhTW_text: 力道不夠……

jaJP_text:
무네치카 녀석…….
완갑으로 공격을 막아 내고, 게다가 상대를 날려 버렸어.
enUS_text: Her hammer not only lets her block attacks, but she can send her opponents flying with it.
zhTW_text:
宗近那傢伙……
不只用拳套擋下攻擊，還把對手打飛了。
咕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: Haaagh!
zhTW_text: 喝啊啊啊！

jaJP_text:
제랑 같이 여행하고 있는 거잖아?
이대로 계속 여행이나 다니다간 혼기도 점점 늦어질 텐데요.
enUS_text: You go everywhere your Mikado goes, right? If you keep traveling around like this, you'll end up an old spinster before you know it.
zhTW_text:
你是陪帝出外旅行的對吧？
再繼續旅行，可是會錯過婚期的喔。

jaJP_text:
죄, 죄송합니다.
지금 형님의 모습이 하쿠 씨로 보여서…….
그럴 리가 없는데, 이상하지요.
enUS_text: O-Oh, sorry. For a moment, Oshtor looked like Haku to me... That's weird, isn't it?
zhTW_text:
對、對不起。
剛才兄長大人看起來就像哈克先生一樣……
明明不可能有這種事的，還真是奇妙。

jaJP_text:
그렇구나…… 그렇게까지 말한다면,
조금만 상대해 줄게.
하지만……
enUS_text: I see... If that's how you feel, I guess I can get serious, too.
zhTW_text:
這樣啊……既然你都說到這份上了，
我就稍微陪陪你吧。
可是……

enUS_text: Nrgh...
zhTW_text: 呃哈……

enUS_text: Ahhh... I have to admit, this is exciting!
zhTW_text:
啊啊……
多麼令人雀躍……

enUS_text: Wha— Gyagh!
zhTW_text: 唔……嗚！

enUS_text: Grrr...!
zhTW_text: 嘎嚕嚕嚕嚕……！

enUS_text: Hup!
Hraaagh...!
zhTW_text: 喝啊！

enUS_text: *rattle*
zhTW_text: 嘰嘰嘰嘰嘰！

jaJP_text: 베나위 공도 그 후로 한층 더 강해지셨다.
enUS_text: As have you. I can feel it.
zhTW_text: 貝納威大人您也是，在那之後又更為強悍了。

enUS_text: Nrgh...!
Guh!
zhTW_text: 呃嗚啊！

jaJP_text:
소생 또한 무인이다.
이제부터는 말이 아니라 주먹으로 이야기하자!!
enUS_text: I am a Mononofu. I'll make my rejoinder not with words... but with my fists!
zhTW_text:
在下也是名武士。
接下來就不動口，用身手告訴你吧！

enUS_text: I'm not done yet!
zhTW_text: 還早得很！

enUS_text: Ready to go another round?
zhTW_text: 那麼，再來一次～

jaJP_text:
무, 무네치카는 짐과 달리 가슴이 크니까…….
아, 아니, 짐도 조금만 더 어른이 되면 커질 것이니라.
이건 분해서 하는 말이 아니니라!
enUS_text: I suppose it would seem trivial to you, Munechika... B-But I'm still growing! I have time to catch up! I'm not bitter at all...!
zhTW_text:
那、那是因為宗近你跟余不同，胸部很大……
不、不對，余再長個幾歲就會變大了。
這絕對不是不服輸！

jaJP_text:
뭐 괜찮데이. 나도 비슷한 처지니께.
그보다 승부할 기가?
enUS_text: Oh, take it easy. It's basically the same deal with me. Now, how about that contest?
zhTW_text:
算了。　反正人家也差不多是這樣。
不說那個了，來打一下吧？

jaJP_text:
저들의 높은 기동력이 있다면,
기습과 매복이 중심이 되는 전투를 벌일 수 있다.
enUS_text: With that kind of mobility, they could build an entire strategy around ambush tactics.
zhTW_text:
若有他們的高機動性，
就能採取以奇襲，或是埋伏為主的戰法。

enUS_text: Eep...!
Hah!
zhTW_text: 哈啊……！

jaJP_text:
엣?
즐거웠으니까, 더 놀고 싶은 거야……?
enUS_text: What's that? You enjoyed it too? You want to play more?
zhTW_text:
咦？
因為很開心，所以還想再玩……？
咕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: Yes. I think so too.
zhTW_text: 嗯……是啊。

enUS_text: I've got you now!
zhTW_text: 到此為止了！

enUS_text: Nice...! You're the best, Kuon!
zhTW_text: 真好……果然還是久遠小姐最棒了呀。

enUS_text: What the—?!

jaJP_text:
기쁜 말을 해 주는군.
그대에게 그 정도로까지 말해 줄 만큼, 소생은 강해진 것이겠지.
enUS_text: Nothing would make me happier. I really must have improved if you feel the need to go that far.
zhTW_text:
您可真會說話。
看來在下確實有所成長，才能聽見您這番話吧。

enUS_text: Ooogee?!
zhTW_text: 嗚吱──！

enUS_text: Yes, I believe he's fond of meat.
zhTW_text:
肉……
是的，他很喜歡吃肉喔。

enUS_text: Hraaaaaagh!
zhTW_text: 哦哦哦哦哦哦！

enUS_text: You DARE to spout that rubbish again?!
zhTW_text: 你這傢伙，還要說那個嗎！
哎呀……

enUS_text: Gwargh!
zhTW_text: 呀啊！

enUS_text: Indeed. I think so, too.
zhTW_text: 是啊。我也這麼覺得。

jaJP_text:
키우루 공의 화살은 정확하고, 루루티에 공의 방어도 훌륭합니다.
이것이 엔나카무이의 유파…… 감복했습니다.
enUS_text: Between Lord Kiwru's archery and Lady Rulutieh's defenses, I didn't stand a chance. You're a credit to Ennakamuy, both of you.
zhTW_text:
奇羽琉殿下的箭矢很正確，露露緹耶殿下的防禦也很牢固。
這就是恩納卡姆依的流派……　太令人敬佩了。

enUS_text: Gyah...!
Wh-What?
zhTW_text: 這、這個……

enUS_text: Wh-Why can't we hit him...?
zhTW_text: 為、為什麼打不中啊！

jaJP_text:
아~ 참 좋구마.
쿠온 씨도 그렇게 생각하제?
enUS_text: Oh man, this feels SO good! Aren't you just having a blast, Kuon?
zhTW_text:
啊～真舒暢。
久遠小姐你也這麼想吧？

enUS_text: What's the matter? You guys tired out already?
zhTW_text: 怎麼啦？　已經累了嗎？

enUS_text: Jachdwalt, I'll help too!
zhTW_text: 亞庫托瓦爾特大人，我也要上了。

jaJP_text: 성상이시여, 길을 트는 일은 소생에게 맡겨 주십시오.
enUS_text: Your Highness, allow me to clear the way for you.
zhTW_text: 聖上，由在下負責打頭陣吧。

jaJP_text:
좋네, 좋네.
두 사람 다 엄청 즐거워 보인데이!
enUS_text: Oh man, those two look like they're having so much fun!
zhTW_text:
真好、真好。
她們兩個看起來都好開心喔！

enUS_text: There's lotsa them here. Wonder if I can sniff out more...
zhTW_text:
有很多喔。
很好，來挖挖吧。

jaJP_text: 그대들, 그토록 이것을 손에 넣고 싶은 것이냐!
enUS_text: You all really want this that badly?
zhTW_text: 你們就這麼想獲得這個東西嗎！

enUS_text: They're really going at it now. Of all the idiotic...
zhTW_text:
這些傢伙，是認真的……
你們兩個蠢貨#@－－#

enUS_text: Yaaaaaargh!
zhTW_text: 咿咿咿咿咿！？

enUS_text: Yes, ma'am!
zhTW_text: 收到啦！

enUS_text: Oh, I know! Oshtor, how about you and me—
zhTW_text:
啊，對了。
奧修特爾先生。　我們也來#@－－#

jaJP_text:
훈련용 활과 화살이라 해도,
맞으면 상당히 아픕니다.
enUS_text: These might just be practice arrows we're using, but they'll still hurt if you get hit with them.
zhTW_text:
雖說是訓練用的弓箭，
但要是打中，還是相當痛的。

jaJP_text:
그 밖에도 채소나 과일…….
뭐든 맛있게 드셔 주셔서, 만들 보람이 있어요.
enUS_text: He eats lots of fruit and vegetables, too... Seeing him enjoy a meal makes it feel worth the effort of cooking it.
zhTW_text:
其他還有蔬菜水果……
不管是什麼他都能吃得津津有味，所以身為下廚的人看了也很高興。

enUS_text: Shaaah!

jaJP_text: 왜 그래? 그쪽에서 안 올 거면 우리가 간다?
enUS_text: What's the holdup? If you're not gonna make the first move, we will.
zhTW_text: 怎麼啦？　要是你不打過來，就由我們發動攻勢囉？

jaJP_text:
이 숙련도, 다른 나라에도 뒤지지 않는다.
이 정도면 조정의 병사들과도 제대로 맞붙을 수 있겠지.
enUS_text: You're worthy of standing shoulder to shoulder with all the other lands now. You could even take on troops from the capital.
zhTW_text:
這個練度水準，不輸其他國家。
這樣的話，應該也能和朝廷的士兵抗衡吧。

jaJP_text:
도박, 이라는 말이 들려왔습니다만.
설마 해 보고 싶다거나, 그런 생각을 하고 계신 건 아니겠지요.
enUS_text: Did I hear somebody mention gambling? I hope you weren't thinking of doing anything like that yourself.
zhTW_text:
在下聽見了賭博一詞。
您應該不會想著要嘗試看看吧。

enUS_text: You really are amazing, Sister...
zhTW_text: 果然姊姊大人好強啊……

enUS_text: Yeaaaaahhh!
zhTW_text: 喔喔喔喔喔！
咕嚕嚕！　咕嚕嚕嚕！

jaJP_text:
시, 시끄러워!!
그런 짓을 해 놓고도, 어떻게 그런 소릴 지껄일 수가 있지!!
enUS_text: Sh-Shut up! We're not about to fall for your lies, not after what you did!
zhTW_text:
吵、吵、吵死了！
你們幹了那種事，還好意思這麼說！

enUS_text: Heheheh! C'mon, girl, come here and I'll— Gwargh?!
zhTW_text:
呀哈哈！
好啦，小姑娘來這邊#@－－#嗚啊！？

enUS_text: But your legs are shaking, too...
zhTW_text: 不，大哥你的腳也在抖耶……

enUS_text: Hraaaaaagh!
zhTW_text: 唔、唔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔！

jaJP_text:
오우 오우 오우!
제법 보여 주는구만, 어어!?
enUS_text: Heheh, this girl's a real cute one! I want her more than ever now.
zhTW_text:
唷唷唷！
很會勾引人嘛！是不是！？

enUS_text: Don't drag your sister into this.
zhTW_text: 不准把露露緹耶殿下捲進來。

jaJP_text: 어쩔 수 없군요, 적당히 봐주면서 싸우도록 하죠.
enUS_text: We'll have to use force to get them to stop. In moderation, of course.
zhTW_text: 沒辦法了，我們就稍微應付一下吧。

jaJP_text:
아버님.
짐은 이 야마토를 부흥시키고,
투스쿨에 지지 않을 만큼 풍요롭고 강한 나라로 만들어 보이겠습니다.
enUS_text: Father... I'm working hard to restore Yamato to its former glory, so it may become every bit Tuskur's equal.
zhTW_text:
父親大人。
余會復興大和，
讓大和發展為不輸圖斯庫爾的精悍之國。

jaJP_text:
아니. 이 정도는 나 혼자서도 괜찮아.
그보다 루루티에에게 묻고 싶은 게 있는데.
enUS_text: No, it's fine. I can handle this on my own. I just wanted to ask you about something.
zhTW_text:
不。這點程度，我一個人就應付得來。
不說這個，我有事想問露露緹耶你。
咕嚕～<onpu>　咕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: I guess it's the only way...
zhTW_text: 好、好的……

jaJP_text:
그렇습니까.
아니, 실은 도박장에 가 본 적이 있어서요.
enUS_text: Oh, that's too bad. You see, I've actually been to those halls before...
zhTW_text:
這樣啊。
不，其實我有去過賭場……

enUS_text: Splendid, Munechika! Show him what you can do!
zhTW_text:
宗近，加油！
你要加油！

enUS_text: Cocopo, defense!
zhTW_text: 可可啵，保護我……！

jaJP_text:
괜찮은 걸까?
좀 더 빨리 피하지 않으면, 목 위가 날아갈지도.
enUS_text: What's the matter? If you don't dodge faster than that, you really might lose your head.
zhTW_text:
這樣好嗎？
要是不早點避開，可能會保不住腦袋喔。

jaJP_text: 흥. 짐에게 칼을 겨눈 것, 후회하게 해 주마.
enUS_text: Hmph. You will regret turning your swords on me.
zhTW_text: 哼。　余會讓你們為對余刀劍相向一事後悔莫及。

enUS_text: I'm surprised there were this many beasts lying in wait, too.
zhTW_text: 但沒想到這裡潛伏著這麼多頭野獸。

jaJP_text:
므, 무우…….
확실히 무네치카가 저렇게 즐거워하는 얼굴은 좀처럼 볼 수 없기도 하고.
enUS_text: Hmm... I have to admit, it's not often I get to see Munechika enjoy herself like this.
zhTW_text:
唔、唔嗯……
的確，平常幾乎沒機會看見宗近那麼開心的表情。

jaJP_text: 하핫, 그럼 이제 키우루한테 맡기고 난 높은 데서 구경이나 하자고.
enUS_text: Oho. Maybe I'll leave this to Kiwru and just watch from the sidelines, then.
zhTW_text: 哈哈，那麼之後就交給奇羽琉，我就在後面看戲吧。

jaJP_text:
인정하고 싶진 않지만, 인정할 수밖에 없군요.
이 여자는 제가 지금까지 싸워 온 상대 중 가장 강해요……
enUS_text: I hate to admit it, but of all the opponents I've fought, you're definitely the strongest.
zhTW_text:
雖然不情願，但我必須承認……
這個女人是我至今作戰過的對手中最強的人……

jaJP_text:
기척마저 주술로 지워 두었던 걸지도.
야마토의 술자들은 꽤 솜씨가 좋은가 보네.
enUS_text: They must have used magecraft to erase their presences. I guess Yamato mages are good at that kind of sophisticated work.
zhTW_text:
或許連氣息都是用咒法消除的。
大和的術師還挺靈巧的嘛。

jaJP_text:
물러터지기만 한 황자라면,
나라를 짊어지는 순간 무게를 못 이기고 짓눌려 버릴 것 같으니 말이야.
그래도 뭐, 지금의 키우루라면 걱정할 필요는 없겠지.
enUS_text: That's the kind of responsibility that'd crush him if he were just a naive little princeling. Looking at him now though, I don't think we've got anything to worry about.
zhTW_text:
要是一直只是個天真的皇子，
光是擔起國家的瞬間就會被壓垮了吧。
哎不過，現在的奇羽琉應該不必擔心吧。

jaJP_text:
우히히히히, 좋네…… 좋네!
저런 걸 숨기고 있었다니, 너무 치사하데이!
쿠온 씨, 진짜 짓궂네!
enUS_text: Heehee... Ahahaha! I can't believe you kept it hidden for so long. You're amazing, Kuon!
zhTW_text:
嘻嘻嘻，太棒了……太棒了……
你竟然藏著那種東西，太狡猾了！
久遠小姐，你太壞心眼了！

jaJP_text:
과연 형님이십니다.
저였다면 방금 그걸로 품 안까지 파고들어 당장 땅에 나뒹굴었을 겁니다.
enUS_text: He's really something. That blow just now probably would have broken my defenses and knocked me right out.
zhTW_text:
真不愧是兄長大人。
換作是我，早就被攻擊要害倒地了。

enUS_text: Hm-hm-hmm...♪
zhTW_text: 哼哼哼哼～<onpu>

jaJP_text: 두근거리고 있을 때가 아닌 거 아냐?
enUS_text: Don't let your excitement make you careless.
zhTW_text: 現在是興奮的時候嗎？

enUS_text: Seiyah...!
zhTW_text: 哼！

enUS_text: If you're quite done bickering... Here we come!
zhTW_text:
做好覺悟了嗎？
那麼要上了！

enUS_text: Hm, those guys look like they're having fun.
zhTW_text:
哦……
那邊打得還不錯嘛。

jaJP_text:
게다가 노스리 씨도 신나게 적을 쓰러뜨리고 있고 말이제.
우히히, 노스리 씨도 사무 일만 하다 보니 몸이 굳어 있었던 기가?
enUS_text: Besides, you look like you're enjoying taking down our enemies, too. Feels good to get away from all that clerical work, doesn't it?
zhTW_text:
而且，鵟小姐你不也意氣風發地打倒一堆敵人嗎。
嘻嘻嘻，鵟小姐應該因為總在處理文書工作，身體都變遲鈍了吧？

jaJP_text:
생각해 보면 참 멀리까지 왔군.
설마 다시 투스쿨 병사들과 칼을 맞대게 될 줄이야……
enUS_text: Now that I think about it, we have come a long way. I never thought I'd be crossing swords with someone from Tuskur again.
zhTW_text:
這麼一想，不知不覺就來到這麼遠的地方了。
沒想到在下還會再與圖斯庫爾士兵刀劍相向……

jaJP_text: 키우루야, 다음 행선지는 어떻게 되어 있느냐?
enUS_text: Kiwru, where are we heading next?
zhTW_text: 奇羽琉，下個目的地在哪裡？

enUS_text: It's no wonder when you were talking so loud.
zhTW_text: 畢竟都發出那麼大的聲音了。

enUS_text: Yes, sir!
zhTW_text: 是！

jaJP_text: 만일의 때에는 키우루가 지켜 줄 테니까!
enUS_text: You'll just save me if it gets dangerous, right?
zhTW_text: 因為緊急的時候，奇羽琉你會保護我啊！

jaJP_text:
오오…….
과연 무네치카, 저래서는 가까이 다가가 공격하는 것조차 못 하겠구나!
enUS_text: Ooh...! Impressive, Munechika. You've shut down his attempts to attack at close range, too.
zhTW_text:
喔喔……
不愧是宗近，這樣一來對方也無法接近攻擊了！

jaJP_text: 아아, 갑옷으로 몸을 단단히 두르고 있었으니까.
enUS_text: Y-Yeah, thanks to my armor.
zhTW_text: 沒事，因為我全身上下都穿著鎧甲。

enUS_text: Go, Kiwru! Go, Daddy! Do your bestest!
zhTW_text:
奇羽琉、爸爸。
加油、加油。

enUS_text: Nrgh...!
I had a feeling something like this might happen...
zhTW_text: 果然會變成這樣啊……

jaJP_text:
네, 제도에도 있지요.
뭐, 저는 가 본 적이 없습니다만……
enUS_text: Yes. They have them in the capital, too. Not that I've ever been there and seen them for myself...
zhTW_text:
是的，帝都也有對吧。
不過，我沒有去過就是了……

enUS_text: A Boro-Gigiri? There's a huge monster like that out here...?!
zhTW_text:
巨、巨奇利！？
竟然還有這麼大隻的……！

enUS_text: I'll put an end to this.
zhTW_text: 用這擊了結一切吧。

enUS_text: This was inevitable.
zhTW_text: 碰上我算你倒楣呢。

enUS_text: Total domination.
zhTW_text: 不堪一擊。

enUS_text: Another step forward.
zhTW_text: 解決囉。

enUS_text: This arrow will change the course of fate!
zhTW_text: 我要憑這一箭扭轉局勢！

enUS_text: This will end it!
zhTW_text: 靠這擊了結掉吧！

enUS_text: I'll take the enemy general's head!
zhTW_text:
敵將的頭顱，
就由我希絲收下了。

jaJP_text:
이 무네치카,
팔주장의 이름을 걸고 성상을 지켜 드리겠습니다.
enUS_text: On my honor as a Pillar General, I will defend Her Highness.
zhTW_text:
在下宗近，
將賭上八柱將之名守護聖上。

enUS_text: Hmph. An easy victory.
zhTW_text: 嗯……小菜一碟。

enUS_text: Did you expect anything less?
zhTW_text: 這是當然的結果。

enUS_text: I'm not done having fun yet.
zhTW_text: 人家還玩不夠呢～

enUS_text: Barely worth the trouble.
zhTW_text: 根本不值一砍。

enUS_text: I can handle this myself...!
zhTW_text: 這邊請交給我吧！

enUS_text: Onward! Follow me to victory!
zhTW_text: 跟上我吧，一口氣擊潰敵人！

jaJP_text:
모든 것은 주인님을 위해.
무엇이든 저희에게 맡겨 주십시오.
enUS_text: Anything for you, Master. Leave this to us.
zhTW_text:
一切為了主人。
請把一切都交給我們。

enUS_text: This attack will end it!
zhTW_text: 就用這個攻擊畫下句點！

enUS_text: Oh, are we done already? How disappointing.
zhTW_text:
怎麼？
已經結束啦？
意外地弱呢……

jaJP_text:
네놈의 그 각오,
만 번 죽음으로 증명해 보아라!
enUS_text: Show me you're prepared to put your life on the line!
zhTW_text:
你的那份覺悟，
就用你那條命來證明吧！

jaJP_text: 오라버니의 방해는 못 하게 할 거예요!
enUS_text: You will not harm my brother!
zhTW_text: 絕不讓你們妨礙兄長！

enUS_text: Behold - this is my true power!
zhTW_text:
好好接下……
余的真本事吧！

enUS_text: Good. Victory is ours.
zhTW_text: 很好，是我們贏了！

enUS_text: Time for me to go all out!
zhTW_text: 一口氣解決吧！

enUS_text: Ka-kaw!
zhTW_text: 咕嘎嘎……！

enUS_text: Perfection!
zhTW_text: 太完美啦！

enUS_text: A good woman cannot lose. Just watch!
zhTW_text:
看吧！
好女人一定會獲勝！

enUS_text: Leave this to me.
zhTW_text: 這邊就交給我吧。

enUS_text: "Mission accomplished," one might say!
zhTW_text: 成功了。

enUS_text: Hello...? Are you all right?
zhTW_text: 那個～你還好嗎？

enUS_text: I will remain by your side, Highness.
zhTW_text: 在下的武藝都為聖上而存。

enUS_text: That wasn't too bad.
zhTW_text: 差不多就這樣吧。

enUS_text: Allow me to finish this!
zhTW_text: 請讓我就此結束吧！

jaJP_text:
나코쿠의 힘,
얕보지 말아 주셨으면 합니다!
enUS_text: Don't underestimate Nakoku!
zhTW_text:
請別小看
納克庫的力量了！

enUS_text: Maro hath yet a few tricks up his sleeve.
zhTW_text: 可別小看麻呂我了。

enUS_text: What's the situation?
zhTW_text: 報告戰況吧。

enUS_text: Hmph. That was no challenge.
zhTW_text: 哼，真是無趣。

enUS_text: Time for me to get serious...
zhTW_text: 好了，我要動真本事了……

enUS_text: Anywhere, anytime, Nakoku will not fall behind.
zhTW_text:
無論身處何種戰場，
納克庫都不會落於人後！

jaJP_text:
자세한 사정까지 모두 알겠습니다.
주인님의 종으로서 당연한 결과입니다.
enUS_text: Understood. A simple matter for your servants, Master.
zhTW_text:
悉聽尊便。
作為主人的僕從，這是理所當然的成果。

enUS_text: Heheh, how's that?
zhTW_text: 哼哼，怎麼樣呢<onpu>

jaJP_text:
어머나 어머나, 괜찮으세요?
너무 무리하지는 말아 주세요?
enUS_text: Oh my, are you all right? Don't push yourselves, all right?
zhTW_text:
哎呀哎呀，你還好嗎？
請別太勉強自己喔？

jaJP_text:
내일부터 진심 낸다……
라고 할 수는 없겠지……
enUS_text: I'll give it my all... starting tomorrow.
zhTW_text:
明天再開始認真……
應該不能這樣吧……

enUS_text: Prepare to die.
zhTW_text: 認清事實吧，這裡就是你的葬身之地。
咕嚕～咕嚕嚕、嚕嚕嚕～

enUS_text: Have I done some good here today?
zhTW_text: 見識到鄙人的武藝了嗎……？

jaJP_text:
주인님의 명에 따라,
방해하는 자를 배제하겠습니다.
enUS_text: We will carry out our orders and eliminate you.
zhTW_text:
我們將聽從主人之令，
除掉礙事之徒。

jaJP_text:
이 이상의 전투는 무의미해…,
끝내도록 하지.
enUS_text: It would be meaningless to continue this battle. I'll end it here and now.
zhTW_text:
繼續戰鬥也毫無意義……
讓在下就此了結吧。

enUS_text: This will end it all!
zhTW_text: 我要在這一擊裡賭上一切！

enUS_text: All right!
zhTW_text: 好！

enUS_text: Hmph... Not bad, I suppose!
zhTW_text:
嗯……
還不錯！

jaJP_text: 다음엔 봐줄 수 없을 것 같네!
enUS_text: I can't hold myself back anymore!
zhTW_text: 下次可沒辦法手下留情了！

enUS_text: Think you can keep up with my spear?
zhTW_text: 你看得清我的長槍嗎？

enUS_text: Remain vigilant and press on!
zhTW_text: 下次也別掉以輕心！

enUS_text: Okay, I think that went well.
zhTW_text: 很好……滿順利的吧。
咕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: Let's keep going.
zhTW_text: 好了，趕快上吧。

enUS_text: I'm not stopping for anyone!
zhTW_text: 繼續向前衝刺吧！

enUS_text: No problem for me!
zhTW_text: 不過如此，輕輕鬆鬆。

enUS_text: Ahahaha! This is so much fun...!
zhTW_text:
啊哈哈哈！
好開心……真開心啊！！

enUS_text: Hm. Not bad.
zhTW_text: 呼……還不賴。

jaJP_text:
때가 무르익었다!
짐의 쾌진격이 막을 올리는도다!!
enUS_text: The time has come! My era begins now!
zhTW_text:
時機已到！
余要開始快速進擊了！

enUS_text: Heh. Is that all?
zhTW_text: 呼……就這點程度而已！

enUS_text: Experience my strength firsthand!
zhTW_text: 切身感受鄙人的武藝吧。

enUS_text: I'll make this power my own!
zhTW_text: 我會徹底發揮這份力量！

jaJP_text:
아끼다간 후회할 것 같으니,
진심으로 가겠다!!
enUS_text: I'll only regret it if I hold back. I'm giving it my all!
zhTW_text:
要是藏招感覺會後悔，
所以人家要認真起來囉！

enUS_text: How's that? Have you fallen for my charms?
zhTW_text: 怎麼樣！著迷了吧？

enUS_text: Nekone, did you see me?
zhTW_text: 貓音小姐，你有看到嗎？

enUS_text: That should do it.
zhTW_text: 哎，這樣就算解決了吧？

enUS_text: All right, I did it!
zhTW_text: 很好～成功囉。

enUS_text: I suppose that's it, then.
zhTW_text: 嗯，差不多就這樣吧。

enUS_text: Phew... Come, we must keep going.
zhTW_text: 呼……快點前進吧。

jaJP_text:
선을 넘어 버렸어…,
이제 와서 물러설 순 없다고…?
enUS_text: You've got me all fired up... There's no turning back now.
zhTW_text:
你害我動了真本事……
這下你沒有退路囉……？

enUS_text: Himukami, grant Maro thy blessing!
zhTW_text: 這就是火神的加護！

jaJP_text:
좋은 여자란,
결코 자기 말을 거짓으로 만들지 않는 법이다!!
enUS_text: A good woman never lets herself be proven wrong!
zhTW_text:
所謂的好女人，
絕對說到做到！

enUS_text: Leave this to me!
zhTW_text: 這邊請交給我吧！

enUS_text: This is where things get interesting!
zhTW_text: 好了，接下來才是戰鬥的精髓喔？

enUS_text: Guess I'll just have to finish it here!
zhTW_text:
就趁現在，
一口氣收拾掉吧……！

enUS_text: Dear sister, may I leave this to you?
zhTW_text: 大姊，這邊能交給我嗎？

enUS_text: You did a fine job, Your Highness.
zhTW_text: 您辛苦了，聖上。

jaJP_text:
주인님의 방해가 되는 자는,
가차 없이 배제하겠습니다.
enUS_text: Obstacles to our master's success must be eliminated.
zhTW_text:
若有人意圖妨礙主人，
我們絕不放過。

jaJP_text:
그 정도로 나를 잡겠다니…,
웃기지도 않는군!
enUS_text: You think this is enough to slow me down? Don't make me laugh!
zhTW_text:
才這點程度就想擊敗我……
少笑掉人大牙了！

enUS_text: Was I any help...?
zhTW_text: 我派上……用場了嗎？

enUS_text: All right, on to our next objective.
zhTW_text: 很好，朝下個目標前進吧。

enUS_text: Huh. I learned a lot from this.
zhTW_text: 呼……真是受益良多。

enUS_text: Heh. Nice going, dear sister.
zhTW_text: ……呵呵，不愧是大姊。

enUS_text: I'm ending this here and now!
zhTW_text: 抱歉，我要用這擊了結你！

jaJP_text:
성상께 해를 끼치는 어리석은 자는,
여기서 처단하겠다!
각오하라!!
enUS_text: This is the fate of all who oppose Her Highness. Prepare yourself!
zhTW_text:
膽敢反抗聖上的愚昧之徒，
都由在下就此了結！
做好覺悟吧！

jaJP_text:
음! 맡기마 오우기!!
확 가 버려라!!
enUS_text: Go ahead, Ougi! I can handle this!
zhTW_text:
嗯！　交給你了，扇！
儘管大顯身手吧！

enUS_text: I guess that's it.
zhTW_text: 嗯，就這點程度啊。

enUS_text: Well, it seems we're finally done.
zhTW_text:
呼……
總算結束了。

enUS_text: Phew... What a relief.
zhTW_text: 呼……真是好險……

jaJP_text:
흥…
전혀 상대가 안 되는 놈이군.
enUS_text: Ha. Didn't even break a sweat.
zhTW_text:
哼……
真是不中用的傢伙。

enUS_text: This is all for Her Highness!
zhTW_text: 為報聖上之恩，鄙人要上了。

enUS_text: No more of your mischief, now.
zhTW_text: 真是的，不可以惡作劇喔？

enUS_text: They never stood a chance.
zhTW_text: 碰上我算你倒楣。

enUS_text: Guess I should show everyone what I can do.
zhTW_text: 還是得稍微回應期待才行啊。

enUS_text: Sorry, but I'm ending this now!
zhTW_text: 抱歉，我要一口氣了結了！
