enUS_text: As you wish, Master. Anything for you.
zhTW_text:
一心一意。
我們會侍奉主人。

enUS_text: It's time to end this!
zhTW_text: 好了，用這擊了結吧！

enUS_text: Watch thou closely, for Maro shall show thee his best!
zhTW_text:
好好見識
麻呂我的絕招吧～！

enUS_text: I hope you're ready for me. Here I come!
zhTW_text: 我要上了，請做好覺悟吧！

enUS_text: Good work, everyone.
zhTW_text: 各位，辛苦了。

enUS_text: No slowing down now!
zhTW_text: 勇往直前。

enUS_text: You're not done yet, are you?
zhTW_text: 你們應該還行吧？

enUS_text: Get a good look at Kujyuri's power!
zhTW_text: 儘管欣賞九重里的戰鬥方式吧。

enUS_text: I'll do whatever I can!
zhTW_text: 我會想辦法解決的！

enUS_text: I was hoping for more of a challenge.
zhTW_text: 這點程度小事一樁。

enUS_text: Doth my progress please thee?
zhTW_text: 怎麼了？

enUS_text: We can't afford to stand around.
zhTW_text: 可不能就此停下腳步。

jaJP_text:
후훗…, 여러분.
여기는 저에게 맡겨 주세요!
enUS_text: Heehee... Leave this to me, everyone!
zhTW_text:
呵呵……各位。
這邊請交給我吧！

enUS_text: Nekone, now!
zhTW_text: 貓音！　就是現在！

enUS_text: Allow us to crush those hopes and remove all doubt!
zhTW_text:
就由我們……
來粉碎你的希望吧！

jaJP_text:
그게 아니야… 그게 아니에요……
저는 여러분과 함께 가고 싶어요,
그것뿐이에요……
enUS_text: No... No, of course not... I just want to stay with my friends, that's all.
zhTW_text:
不是……不是的……
我想和大家一起走，
就只是這樣……

enUS_text: That's more like it. Show me what you're made of, Oshtor!
zhTW_text:
很好！　儘管放馬過來……
奧修特爾！

jaJP_text:
모두, 두려워하지 마라!
이 싸움이야말로, 이번 대전을 결정지을 일전이라 명심하라!
enUS_text: Stay strong, everyone! This is what our whole campaign has been leading up to!
zhTW_text:
各位，不要害怕！
你們必須知道，這次戰鬥正是左右這場戰爭的關鍵！

jaJP_text: 후미뤼르는 이 나라에 남을 생각인 건가?
enUS_text: Are you going to stay here in this country, Fumirul?
zhTW_text: 芙米露露你打算留在這個國家嗎？

enUS_text: All right, we're going all the way to the top!
zhTW_text: 好了，一口氣衝上去吧！

enUS_text: We can't let him call in reinforcements. We have to hurry!
zhTW_text:
要是他們叫了增援，會很麻煩……
我們動作快點吧！

enUS_text: I'm looking forward to a good match, Sir Ougi.
zhTW_text: 扇大人，請多指教了。

jaJP_text:
서둘러 처치해라!
마로로 님의 명령대로 움직이고 있으면 문제없다!
enUS_text: Strike now and finish them off! So long as we follow Lord Maroro's orders, we can't lose!
zhTW_text:
快點收拾掉！
只要依照麻呂呂大人的命令行動，就沒有問題！

enUS_text: I'll be your opponent, Lord Mikazuchi!
zhTW_text: 御雷大人，由在下當您的對手。

jaJP_text: 언니가 이런 걸 바랄 리가 없어요…!
enUS_text: I know this isn't what Kuon would want...!
zhTW_text: 姊姊大人她不可能會期望這種事發生！

jaJP_text:
아직도 모르시겠습니까?
저항하는 것 자체가 무의미하다는 걸……
enUS_text: Haven't you realized just how futile it is to resist us?
zhTW_text:
你們還不明白嗎？
抵抗這個行為本身就沒有意義……

enUS_text: Something's wrong... This thing isn't natural...
zhTW_text:
這種事情……
實在太過分了……

enUS_text: You better not screw around with me!
zhTW_text: 開什麼玩笑啊！

jaJP_text:
적의 정체도 파악할 수 없어…,
모두, 방심하지 말아 줘!
enUS_text: But we still don't know what our enemy can do... Everyone, keep your guard up!
zhTW_text:
也無法掌握敵人的來歷……
各位，注意別掉以輕心了！

jaJP_text:
이대로 가만히,
불타 죽을 수는 없습니다!
enUS_text: I'm not about to stand by and let the flames take me!
zhTW_text:
我可不能就這麼默不作聲
活活被燒死！

enUS_text: Lord Tokifusa, it's hopeless...
zhTW_text: 時櫻大人，已經撐不下去了……

enUS_text: Ooogee-gee!
zhTW_text: 唔哦哦──！

enUS_text: Incomprehensible.
zhTW_text: 無法理解。

jaJP_text:
훗, 우리를 얕보면 곤란하지.
그 목, 받아 가겠다!
enUS_text: I can't have you looking down on me, monster. Your head is mine!
zhTW_text:
哼，別太小看我們了。
你的腦袋，我收下了！

jaJP_text:
그분을 잃은 슬픔은 저희도 압니다……
하지만 언제까지나 슬픔에 잠겨 있다간 당신이……
enUS_text: I know how much it must have hurt you to lose him; I feel the same. But you have to let go of this pain...
zhTW_text:
我們能明白你失去那位大人有多麼心痛……
但要是一直傷心下去，你……

enUS_text: You okay, Little Lady?
zhTW_text: 小姐，沒事吧？

enUS_text: You seem to have gotten used to using that metal fan.
zhTW_text: 你好像也漸漸習慣鐵扇的用法了。

enUS_text: I WILL complete this duty and I WILL earn Brother and Haku's trust...
zhTW_text: 我一定會成功完成這個任務！

enUS_text: I'm gonna go all out, too.
zhTW_text: 我要認真上了喔？

enUS_text: GRAAAAWR!
zhTW_text: 嗷嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚嗚！

jaJP_text: 마로로 님… 제발 정신을 차려 주세요……
enUS_text: Sir Maroro... Please come back to us...
zhTW_text: 麻呂呂大人……請清醒過來吧……

enUS_text: Surrounded on all sides.
zhTW_text: 四面楚歌。

enUS_text: Time to show you what I can really do! This is gonna be fun!
zhTW_text: 好，現在開始才是關鍵時刻，人家已經等不及了啦！

jaJP_text:
무한히 싸우는 것이 이루어질 수 없다면……
나의 모든 것을 남김없이 멸해 버리는 것도 나쁘지 않다!!
enUS_text: If I cannot fight forever, fighting until I'm completely annihilated is the next best thing!
zhTW_text:
既然無法永遠戰鬥……
將自身一切全都毀滅殆盡倒也不壞！

enUS_text: Hraaaaaagh...!
zhTW_text: 唔、嘎啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

jaJP_text: 이곳은 소생이 끝까지 지켜 내 보이겠다…!
enUS_text: I'll protect you from any and all harm!
zhTW_text: 在下將會死守這裡！

jaJP_text:
너무 오래 머물다간,
새카맣게 타 버릴 것 같네요……
enUS_text: If we take too long, the fire will get us before the enemy does...
zhTW_text:
要是待太久，
感覺會被燒焦呢……

jaJP_text:
이것이 지금 네놈들의 힘인가……
크큭…… 재밌군!
enUS_text: So this is the level you've reached... Heheh, now I'm having fun!
zhTW_text:
這就是你們現在的力量啊……
呵呵……有趣！

enUS_text: I'll remove the annoying pests first!
zhTW_text: 先解決礙事的傢伙吧！

jaJP_text: 괜찮데이, 무리 같은 건 안 할끼다?
enUS_text: I'll be fine. I know my limits, and I'm not even close to 'em yet.
zhTW_text: 沒事啦，人家不會亂來的喔。

jaJP_text:
으~~……
저 기분 나쁜 괴물은 대체 뭔가요……
enUS_text: Urk... What is that disgusting monster?
zhTW_text:
嗚……
那個噁心的怪物是怎麼回事……

enUS_text: Must you all be so stubborn...?
zhTW_text: 真是群難纏的人……

enUS_text: Urk... How could I lose...?!
zhTW_text: 唔……鄙人太大意了……

jaJP_text:
응…, 고마워 후미뤼르.
마음만 고맙게 받아 둘게.
enUS_text: Uh... Thanks, Fumirul. I appreciate the sentiment.
zhTW_text:
嗯……謝謝你，芙米露露。
你的好意我心領了。

enUS_text: Everyone is awaiting your return, Kuon.
zhTW_text: 久遠小姐，大家都在等你喔。

jaJP_text:
이젠 셀 수도 없을 만큼,
몇 번이고 그 녀석과 검을 맞댄 내가 틀릴 리 없다……
enUS_text: I've crossed blades with Oshtor more times than I can count. I'd know his fighting style anywhere.
zhTW_text:
我已經和那傢伙交手好幾次了，
不可能會搞錯的……

jaJP_text:
브라이여!
온갖 어리석은 짓을 저지른 네놈에게…, 짐이 이 자리에서 심판을 내리겠다!
각오하거라!!
enUS_text: Vurai, the time has come for you to be punished for your foolishness. Prepare yourself!
zhTW_text:
武賴啊！
你犯下種種愚行……就讓余於此制裁你吧！
做好覺悟吧！

jaJP_text:
찌질하게 끈질기기도 하네요!
빨리 뒈져 버리시라는 것입니다!!
enUS_text: Urgh, you're so stubborn! Accept your defeat already!
zhTW_text:
囉哩囉嗦的真是煩人！
快點給我去死吧！

jaJP_text: 그렇게 얇게 입고 있는 네가 잘못인 것 같네…
enUS_text: Probably because your clothes are so thin...
zhTW_text: 是因為穿太薄了嗎……

enUS_text: Sounds good to me. Let's go!
zhTW_text:
好吧……
我們上吧！

jaJP_text:
누구든 황도에 맞서 길을 가로막는다면,
여기서 베어 쓰러뜨릴 뿐!
enUS_text: Anyone who opposes Yamato's rightful ruler must be cut down!
zhTW_text:
無論是誰，膽敢阻礙帝皇的道路
就只有死路一條！

jaJP_text: 하지만 정면 돌격이라니, 너무 단순하지 않나?
enUS_text: Doesn't a full frontal charge seem kind of... basic, though?
zhTW_text: 可是，從正前方發動突擊不會太直接了嗎？

jaJP_text: 성상께는 손가락 하나도 대지 못하게 하겠다!!
enUS_text: I won't let anyone lay a finger on Her Highness!
zhTW_text: 在下不會讓你碰聖上一根指頭！

jaJP_text: 마로로 씨, 부탁이니 병사들을 물려 주세요!!
enUS_text: Maroro, please! Tell your soldiers to stand down!
zhTW_text: 麻呂呂先生，拜託你撤兵吧！

jaJP_text:
그리고 아버님의 후계자가 되기 위해,
짐은 이 땅으로 다시 돌아왔다!
enUS_text: And to prove my worth as my father's daughter... That is why I stand here today!
zhTW_text:
然後，為了繼承父親大人的皇位，
余重回這個地方了！

jaJP_text: 무슨 일이 있더라도, 결코 독단으로 움직이지 않겠다고.
enUS_text: Whatever else might happen, promise me you won't try to do anything alone.
zhTW_text: 無論發生什麼事，希望您絕不要獨斷行動。

jaJP_text:
성상께는 손가락 하나도 대지 못하게 하겠다……
간다!!
enUS_text: I won't let you lay a finger on Her Highness. Let's do this!
zhTW_text:
我不會讓你碰聖上一根指頭……
要上了！

enUS_text: Sir Jachdwalt, are you injured?
zhTW_text:
亞庫托瓦爾特先生，
請問你有受傷嗎……

enUS_text: Dear sister, may I leave this to you?
zhTW_text: 大姊，這邊能交給我嗎？

jaJP_text: 이 앞은 지나가게 할 수 없습니다.
enUS_text: You're not getting past me.
zhTW_text: 我無法讓你們通過這裡。

enUS_text: I have a bad feeling about this.
zhTW_text: 我有種不祥的預感……

jaJP_text:
훈련이라고 해서 방심할 순 없지.
내가 하쿠라는 걸 들키지 않게 해야 하는데……
enUS_text: Just because this is training, doesn't mean I can hold back. I can't let them find out I'm really Haku...
zhTW_text:
雖說是訓練，但也不能鬆懈。
得小心不能被發現我是哈克才行……

enUS_text: Thank you, Lady Fumirul!
zhTW_text: 芙米露露大人，抱歉，要麻煩您了！

enUS_text: Nosuri... Your skills really are amazing...
zhTW_text:
鵟小姐……
實力果然高強……

jaJP_text:
나를 얕본 것,
후회하게 해 주마!
enUS_text: You'll rue the day you underestimated me!
zhTW_text:
我會讓你後悔
自己曾經小看我！

jaJP_text: 진정해, 등을 보이면 덮쳐 올 거야.
enUS_text: Stay calm and stand firm. Turning your back on it will only provoke it.
zhTW_text: 冷靜點，要是背對牠，馬上就會被襲擊。

enUS_text: Ougi, we're charging right through!
zhTW_text: 扇，一口氣了結吧！
咕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: Certain doom.
zhTW_text: 走投無路。

enUS_text: Please, just let me through!
zhTW_text: 拜託，讓我過去吧！

enUS_text: By Lord Maroro's orders, you must die!
zhTW_text: 這是麻呂呂大人的命令，去死吧！

jaJP_text: 점점 말투까지 꼭 닮아 가고 있잖아.
enUS_text: You're even starting to talk like the real thing now.
zhTW_text: 連語氣都漸漸地變得跟主人一模一樣了啊。

jaJP_text:
이 새로운 모습에 상처를 내다니,
헛된 짓입니다.
enUS_text: It's useless trying to harm us in these new forms.
zhTW_text:
就算傷及這副新的姿態，
也毫無意義。

jaJP_text:
이 자들의 기척……
모두, 방심하지 마시옵소서……
enUS_text: This aura they're giving off... Keep your guards up, everyone.
zhTW_text:
這些人散發的氣息……
各位，別大意了……

jaJP_text:
부탁이니까……
두고 가지만은 말아 줬으면 해요……!
enUS_text: So please, don't leave me behind!
zhTW_text:
所以拜託……
不要丟下我……！

jaJP_text:
설마 이길 수 있다고,
희망을 품고 있는 건 아니겠지요?
enUS_text: You don't seriously think you have any hope of winning, do you?
zhTW_text:
你不會真的產生希望，
以為自己有勝算了吧？

jaJP_text:
오라버니가…, 오라버니가 돌아와 주신 거예요……
오라버니, 기다려 주셨으면 해요…!
enUS_text: My brother returned to us... Now we just have to get my dear sister back too!
zhTW_text:
兄長……兄長他回來了……
姊姊大人，請再等一下吧！

enUS_text: Hahaha! I'm not about to let that happen!
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻，人家可不允許喔！

jaJP_text:
항복하지 않고,
아직도 성상께 원한을 품고 있다는 것이냐, 토키후사……
enUS_text: Tokifusa... It seems you're determined to keep opposing Her Highness.
zhTW_text:
不只不投降，
甚至還要繼續反抗聖上嗎，時櫻……

enUS_text: Here we go, Cocopo. Let's give it our all!
zhTW_text:
可可啵，開始囉。
一起加油吧！

jaJP_text:
네놈…, 성상을 우롱한 죄는 만 번 죽어도 모자라다.
각오하라!!
enUS_text: You deserve to die a thousand deaths for disrespecting Her Highness... Prepare yourself!
zhTW_text:
混帳……竟敢愚弄聖上，罪該萬死。
做好覺悟吧！

enUS_text: Haaah!
zhTW_text: 喝啊啊啊啊啊！

jaJP_text:
브라이……
네놈, 대체 어디까지 타락해야 속이 시원하겠느냐……!!
enUS_text: Vurai... Just how far will you fall before you're satisfied?!
zhTW_text:
武賴……
你究竟要墮落到什麼程度！

jaJP_text:
그대들에게는 볼일 없다!
쿠온을 만나게 하여라!!
enUS_text: I have no business with the likes of you! Let me see Kuon!
zhTW_text:
這跟你們無關！
讓余見久遠！

jaJP_text:
그럼 분명히 해 두도록 하죠.
당신들의 힘이, 저보다 더 어울리는지 어떤지를요.
enUS_text: Yes, let's settle it here. Prove that you're a more suitable successor, if you can.
zhTW_text:
那就讓你們認清事實吧。
你們究竟是否比我更有資格，獲得萬能鑰匙。

jaJP_text:
진정하시옵소서, 성상이시여.
격정에 휩쓸려 움직이면 빈틈을 찔릴 것입니다.
enUS_text: Try to remain calm, Your Majesty. Getting too emotional can make you careless.
zhTW_text:
請冷靜，聖上。
太過激動會被敵人趁虛而入的。

enUS_text: Whoops, looks like I let my guard down.
zhTW_text: 哎呀，我好像不小心鬆懈了。

jaJP_text:
좋아! 내 승리다!
이걸로 또 한 걸음, 좋은 여자에 가까워지고 말았군!
enUS_text: Yeah, I won! I'm one step closer to being the perfect woman!
zhTW_text:
好！　是我贏了！
如此一來，又向好女人更進一步了！

jaJP_text:
흠……. 그렇다는 것은,
키마마우의 우두머리를 찾아 쓰러뜨리면 된다는 것이구나.
enUS_text: In that case, we just have to find the leader and take it down, right?
zhTW_text:
唔……　意思是說，
只要找出奇瑪瑪之首再打倒就行了吧。

jaJP_text:
놈들에게는 도망칠 곳이 없다,
독 안의 쥐다… 해볼 만해!
enUS_text: They've got nowhere to run, like rats in a trap... We can win this!
zhTW_text:
那些傢伙無處可逃，
已經是甕中之鱉了……這樣行得通！

jaJP_text: 이제 슬슬 세금 바칠 때다, 각오해라!
enUS_text: All your wrongdoings are about to come back and bite you!
zhTW_text: 這筆賬現在就要跟你算清楚，做好覺悟吧！

enUS_text: Nosuri, can you take care of this for me?
zhTW_text: 鵟，這裡就拜託你了！

enUS_text: What's going on? My head feels fuzzy...
zhTW_text:
怎麼回事？
感覺意識漸漸模糊……

enUS_text: Let's finish this together, Master.
zhTW_text: 主人，請配合我們。

enUS_text: Naturally.
zhTW_text: 那是當然的。

enUS_text: Uh... W-Well..
Grrr...!
zhTW_text: 呼嚕嚕嚕……！

enUS_text: Graaaaaah!
zhTW_text: 嗚啊──！

enUS_text: Oh boy, I get to take out a general!
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻，大將也由人家順便收下囉！

jaJP_text:
마로로……
그래도 끝내 내 말을 들으려 하지 않는 건가……
enUS_text: Maroro... You're really not going to listen to us, are you?
zhTW_text:
麻呂呂……
不管怎樣，你都聽不進我們說的話嗎……

jaJP_text:
후훗…,
누님이라면 그렇게 말씀하실 줄 알고 있었습니다.
enUS_text: Heheh... I had a feeling you'd say that.
zhTW_text:
呵呵……
我就知道大姊你會這麼說。

enUS_text: Now, stand aside! This is an order from the rightful Mikado!
zhTW_text:
把路讓開！
此乃聖旨！

jaJP_text:
어디까지나 훈련이지만, 대충 해서는 의미가 없다……
봐주는 건 없다!
enUS_text: Of course not. There's no point in training unless we both go all out.
zhTW_text:
雖然只是訓練，但要是放水就沒意義了……
不必手下留情！

enUS_text: Finally ready to face me yourself?
zhTW_text: 你總算肯認真起來了嗎……？

enUS_text: Ugh...! I'm sorry...
zhTW_text:
唔……
對不起……

jaJP_text:
후훗…,
아직 이 아이들과 있고 싶은 거구나……
enUS_text: Heheh... You want to stay with these kids a little longer, huh...?
zhTW_text:
呵呵……
你還想和這些孩子待在一起啊……

enUS_text: We really should finish this soon.
zhTW_text: 差不多該做個了斷了。

jaJP_text:
이 기괴한 괴물…,
타타리와는 다른 건가…?
enUS_text: This monster... It doesn't seem like a regular Tatari.
zhTW_text:
這個異形怪物……
跟祟不同嗎？

enUS_text: (Just a little more...)
zhTW_text: （就差一點……）

enUS_text: Are you sure you can afford to only fight me?
zhTW_text:
哎呀，光顧著對付我，
真的好嗎？

enUS_text: Hmm... Something's wrong here.
zhTW_text: 唔～總感覺好奇怪……

jaJP_text:
완전히 깨어나 버리기 전에,
끝장을 내 드리겠어요.
enUS_text: In that case, I'll finish this before you get the chance.
zhTW_text:
我要在她完全醒來之前，
了結這件事情。

enUS_text: Which means we don't have to hold back!
zhTW_text: 看來不須手下留情。

enUS_text: Remember to pay attention to the battle, okay Ku?
zhTW_text: 小久，你不能大意喔？

enUS_text: Just a scratch... This isn't enough to defeat me!
zhTW_text:
還、還沒完！
這點程度的傷……

jaJP_text:
우~, 상처 치료를
너무 소홀히 해 버린 것입니다…
enUS_text: Nrgh... I neglected to treat my wounds properly...
zhTW_text:
嗚～我傷口處理得
太馬虎了……

jaJP_text:
오슈토르 님의 분위기……
예전과 비교하면 조금 달라지신 듯한……
enUS_text: Oshtor, something about you seems different than before...
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾大人給人的感覺……
跟以前相比好像變了一些……

enUS_text: Urk... Gwaaaaaaaaargh!
zhTW_text: 唔！喝啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

jaJP_text: 여긴 신중하게 전술 지휘를 할 필요가 있겠군……
enUS_text: We'll need a proper strategy if we're going to have any chance of winning this...
zhTW_text: 看來這時得慎重進行戰術指揮……

enUS_text: It's been a while, Lord Oshtor. I'm glad you made it out of the capital.
zhTW_text: 許久不見了……自帝都以來都不曾見面吧，奧修特爾大人。

jaJP_text:
전언은 취소하겠소……
마로가 직접, 모조리 죽여 버리겠소이다.
enUS_text: Let me retract my prior words... Maro requireth no one's aid to send you to an early grave.
zhTW_text:
那麻呂我就撤回前言……
由麻呂我親自把你們通通殺光吧。

enUS_text: But now I want to see your REAL power, Oshtor!
zhTW_text: 讓我看看你的真本事啊，奧修特爾！

jaJP_text:
그, 그런가?
그렇게 말하니 긴장되지 않느냐……
enUS_text: I-Is that so? Somehow that only makes me more nervous...
zhTW_text:
是、是這樣嗎？
被你這麼一說，害得余都緊張起來了……

enUS_text: Things have really gotten serious, huh?
zhTW_text: 接下來才是緊要時刻呢！

enUS_text: The path's open! Now's our chance!
zhTW_text: 殺出一條路了！　趁現在！

enUS_text: Yes, Sir Oshtor...
zhTW_text: 是，奧修特爾大人……

jaJP_text:
오슈토르에게 다른 적을
절대로 접근시키지 마라!!
enUS_text: We have to keep the other enemies away from Oshtor, no matter what!
zhTW_text:
那就是絕不讓其他敵人
接近奧修特爾！

enUS_text: Skreee!
zhTW_text: 嘰嘰！

enUS_text: We can't lose this battle...!
zhTW_text: 我們不能輸……！

enUS_text: Giving up at the final hurdle is hardly my style.
zhTW_text: 呵！直到最後都不能放棄……

enUS_text: Y-Yes... Cocopo protected me from the worst of it.
zhTW_text:
是、是的……
是可可啵保護了我。

enUS_text: Take Oshtor's head!
zhTW_text: 拿下奧修特爾的首級！

enUS_text: Time for the real star to take the field!
zhTW_text: 看來最強的一批出場了吧？

jaJP_text:
움직이는 저를 맞히다니…,
후훗… 키우루 씨, 실력이 늘었네요.
enUS_text: You actually hit me while I was moving. Heh, you've improved, Kiwru.
zhTW_text:
竟然能射中移動中的我……
呵呵……奇羽琉殿下，你身手又更好了呢。

enUS_text: Don't you think so too, Oshtor?!
zhTW_text:
汝不那麼認為嗎？
奧修特爾！

enUS_text: Tch. Hitting me from that distance is the act of a coward!
zhTW_text:
可惡……
竟敢從射程外攻擊，太卑鄙了！

enUS_text: Rulutieh...
zhTW_text: 露露緹耶……？

jaJP_text: 오슈토르 따위, 내 기책 앞에서는 상대도 되지 않는다!
enUS_text: Even the great Lord Oshtor is nothing in the face of my strategic brilliance!
zhTW_text: 區區奧修特爾，根本敵不過我的奇策！

jaJP_text: 워시스 님께서 세우실 새로운 세상을 위하여……
enUS_text: All is for Lord Woshis' new world...
zhTW_text: 為了沃西斯大人構築的全新世界……
咕嚕嚕～<onpu>

enUS_text: Mikazuchi...
zhTW_text: 御雷……

enUS_text: Help...
zhTW_text: 救救……我……

jaJP_text:
워시스에게 변화가…?
큭… 이런 때에 오슈토르 공을 도울 수조차 없다니……
enUS_text: Woshis transformed? Urgh, it's so frustrating not to be able to support Oshtor at a time like this...!
zhTW_text:
沃西斯出現變化了？
唔……這種時候竟沒辦法為奧修特爾大人助陣……

enUS_text: Munechika!
zhTW_text: 宗近！

jaJP_text:
공주 전하!?
그 모습은…… 어찌하여 이런 곳에……
enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

enUS_text: Ooogee!
zhTW_text: 嗚嘰嘰！

enUS_text: Do not stand in my way!
zhTW_text: 別來攪局！

enUS_text: Big Brother... It looks like you're enjoying this.
zhTW_text:
兄長……
總感覺看起來很開心。

jaJP_text:
이대로 가면,
점점 증원을 불러 모을 것 같네요……
enUS_text: At this rate, they'll just keep calling in more reinforcements...
zhTW_text:
再這樣下去，
對方會一直呼叫增援的……

jaJP_text: 과연, 어느 쪽이 루루티에에게 더 어울린다고 생각하십니까?
enUS_text: Try to think about what's really best for Rulutieh in this situation.
zhTW_text: 你究竟認為哪一邊才更適合露露緹耶呢？
咕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: We'll follow you to the very end.
zhTW_text: 我們會追隨您直至天涯海角。

enUS_text: I'm not done yet!
zhTW_text: 還差得遠呢！

enUS_text: Hang around too long, and we'll get washed away.
zhTW_text: 一直拖拖拉拉的會被沖走的喔。

enUS_text: That's what makes you worth killing!
zhTW_text: 這樣人家打起來才有勁啊！

jaJP_text:
정말 당신과 있으면 지루할 틈이 없군요,
오슈토르 씨.
enUS_text: Being around you is certainly never boring, Oshtor.
zhTW_text:
跟你待在一起真的不會無聊呢，
奧修特爾先生。

jaJP_text: 저런 사람한테 빼앗기게 둘 수는 없으니까…!
enUS_text: We can't allow the key to fall into the hands of someone like that!
zhTW_text: 絕對不能被那種人奪走……！

jaJP_text:
형님이 돌아오셨으니…,
쿠온 씨는 반드시 구해 내고 말겠어!!
enUS_text: Oshtor is back with us... We'll definitely save you now, Kuon!
zhTW_text:
兄長大人已經歸來了……
我一定要救出久遠小姐！

enUS_text: My liege, perhaps we should retreat.
zhTW_text: 聖上。請您先退下。

jaJP_text:
우히히…! 쿠온 씨,
금방 정신 차리게 해 줄게!!
enUS_text: Don't you worry, Kuon. We'll have you back to your old self in no time!
zhTW_text:
嘻嘻嘻！　久遠小姐，
人家這就讓你醒過來喔！

jaJP_text: 저희에게도 할 수 있는 일은 분명 있을 거예요…
enUS_text: There has to be something we can do to help.
zhTW_text: 我們應該也有自己能做的事……

enUS_text: These three really are stubborn.
zhTW_text: 真是的，真是群纏人的傢伙……

jaJP_text:
그, 그럴 수가…,
워시스 님…… 부디 용서…해 주십시오……
enUS_text: I... lost? Lord Woshis... Forgive me...
zhTW_text:
怎、怎麼會……
沃西斯大人……請……原諒……

enUS_text: Y-Yeah. I think so too.
zhTW_text: 唔、唔嗯，還請你手下留情。

enUS_text: Well, so be it.
zhTW_text: 算了……

jaJP_text:
큭…! 이만한 병력이 있어도 이길 수 없다니……
마로로 님, 죄송합니다……
enUS_text: Urk...! Even with our superior numbers, we couldn't win... I'm sorry, Lord Maroro...!
zhTW_text:
唔……　都有這麼多兵力了，還是贏不了嗎……
麻呂呂大人，實在萬分抱歉……

jaJP_text:
신기한 힘이군……
하지만… 이 힘이라면
쿠온을 구할 수 있을 것 같군.
enUS_text: I don't quite understand what this power is... But I think I can use it to save you.
zhTW_text:
真是不可思議的力量……
但……只要有這份力量，
應該就救得了久遠。

enUS_text: This doesn't feel half bad.
zhTW_text: 我喜歡這種感覺呢。

jaJP_text:
형님을 받드는 것, 그것이야말로
제 역할이니까요…!
enUS_text: As your sworn brother, it's my job to support you!
zhTW_text:
因為扶持兄長大人，
正是我的職責啊……！

jaJP_text: 마로로, 그만두는 것입니다… 오라버니의 말을 듣는 것입니다!
enUS_text: Stop this, Maroro... Please, just listen to Oshtor!
zhTW_text: 麻呂呂，快住手……快聽兄長說的話啊！

enUS_text: Dear sister...
zhTW_text: 姊姊大人……

enUS_text: Complications.
zhTW_text: 棘手。

jaJP_text:
계속 여기 있으면 위험해……
어서 강가로 올라가야 해……
enUS_text: We can't afford to hang around. We have to make our way across.
zhTW_text:
在這裡久留很不妙……
得早點上岸才行……

jaJP_text:
두 번째 놈이 있을 줄이야…,
이건 예상 밖이었군……
enUS_text: I definitely wasn't expecting a second one to show up...
zhTW_text:
沒想到還有第二隻……
真是出乎意料……

jaJP_text:
키우냥~?
그런 데서 숨어 있으면 인기 없데이?
enUS_text: Oh, Kiwiii...! You're not going to get any girls moping like that, y'know.
zhTW_text:
小奇羽琉～
這種程度就垂頭喪氣，是不會受歡迎的喔？

enUS_text: Oho? What's the matter Kiwi, you get stung by Kurarin or something?
zhTW_text:
哎呀呀？
小奇羽琉的箭，射中克拉琳啦？

enUS_text: They just keep coming... These guys are relentless.
zhTW_text: 一個接著一個沒完沒了……

jaJP_text:
코코포, 진정해……
무섭지 않아, 무섭지 않아…… 알겠지?
enUS_text: C-Calm down, Cocopo. Don't be scared, I'm with you.
zhTW_text:
可可啵，冷靜點……
不可怕喔、不可怕喔……好嗎？

jaJP_text:
누님… 여러분…,
방심한 탓에 당해 버렸습니다……
enUS_text: My apologies, everyone, dear sister... I was careless...
zhTW_text:
大姊……大家……
我太大意了……

jaJP_text:
소생의 가면을 써도
이 저주는 다 막아 내지 못하는가….
틈을 노려 근원을 쳐야 한다.
enUS_text: Even with my akuruka, I can't block out the curse completely... We need to find the source and stop it, quick.
zhTW_text:
即使有在下的假面，
依然無法防下這個詛咒嗎……
得看準破綻、剷除根源才行。

jaJP_text:
오슈토르, 저건 어머님의 소중한 추억이야…,
헛되이해 주지 않았으면 하겠네……
enUS_text: Oshtor, my mother considered that a precious memento... Please don't let it go to waste.
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾，那是母親重要的回憶……
希望你別讓那個白費才好……

enUS_text: Then you're going to have to prove it! Show me your true power.
zhTW_text:
那就展現
你們那份力量吧！

jaJP_text:
쿠온 씨, 기다려 주세요…!
반드시 구하겠습니다!
enUS_text: Stay strong just a little longer, Kuon! We're going to save you!
zhTW_text:
久遠小姐，請再等一下吧！
我們一定會救你的！

enUS_text: We're just getting started...
zhTW_text: 還沒完呢……

jaJP_text:
오슈토르, 너무 한심한 모습을 보이지 마라.
그러지 않으면… 여기서 모조리 끝장내 주겠다!
enUS_text: You'd better not fall behind, Oshtor. I just might end up killing you by accident if you do!
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾，別再暴露醜態了。
否則……我會就此替你做個了斷！

jaJP_text: 우선은 다른 적들을 막는 것이 급선무입니다.
enUS_text: We should prioritize taking out the other enemies for now.
zhTW_text: 必須先阻止其他的敵人。

enUS_text: It can't be... Ku...
zhTW_text:
騙人的吧……
小久……

enUS_text: You'll never defeat me like that!
zhTW_text: 簡直不痛不癢！

jaJP_text: 우히히, 드디어 마음껏 날뛸 수 있겠네!
enUS_text: Oh boy, now I really get to cut loose!
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻，看來總算能大鬧一場啦！

jaJP_text:
큭큭큭…, 그런 걱정은 할 필요 없다.
금방 편하게 해 주겠다!
enUS_text: Heheh... Don't worry about that. I'm about to end it all right here!
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵……不必擔憂此事。
我這就讓你解脫！

enUS_text: Leave this to me!
zhTW_text: 就交給我吧！

enUS_text: Pillar General Tokifusa... The hour of your judgement has come.
zhTW_text:
八柱將時櫻……
在下要就此了結你。

enUS_text: Aw, thank you.
zhTW_text: 非常感謝<onpu>

enUS_text: Out of my way!
zhTW_text: 別來攪局！

enUS_text: You ready to do this, Boss?
zhTW_text: 老爺，辦得到嗎？

jaJP_text:
시간이… 없다……
조금만… 더다, 버텨 다오… 부탁한다……!
enUS_text: My time is running out... Just... Just a little more...!
zhTW_text:
沒……時間了……
就差一點……了，拜託……要撐住……

enUS_text: Ku... I don't know what I should do.
zhTW_text:
小久……
究竟該怎麼做……

enUS_text: Kiwru... Right. Let's do it!
zhTW_text:
奇羽琉……
……是，沒問題！

jaJP_text: 하지만 쓰러뜨리자고 해도 다른 키마마우들에게 둘러싸여 있으니 말이야.
enUS_text: Just one problem - there's so many smaller kimamau we can't even get close to it.
zhTW_text: 說是這麼說，但其他的奇瑪瑪都包圍著牠。

jaJP_text:
아버님의 후계자가 되기 위해,
짐은 이 땅으로 다시 돌아왔다!
enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

jaJP_text:
오슈토르, 혹시 모르니 말해 두겠는데.
다음에 네코네를 울릴 만한 짓을 하면,
가만두지 않겠네.
enUS_text: Oshtor, I'm sure you know this already, but if you make Nekone cry again, there will be consequences.
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾，以防萬一我先說在前頭。
你要是又做會害貓音哭泣的事情，
我絕不饒你。

enUS_text: Everyone, just let me know if you need healing!
zhTW_text:
各位，若需要治療，
請儘管說吧<onpu>

jaJP_text:
(아버님, 지켜봐 주셨으면 하옵니다.
　짐은…… 짐은 이제 누구에게도 지지 않을 것이옵니다.)
enUS_text: (Watch over me, Father. I... I won't lose again. Not to anyone!)
zhTW_text:
（父親大人，請好好看著。
　余……余再也不會輸給任何人了。）

jaJP_text:
키우루, 너무 힘이 들어갔다!
좀 더 어깨의 힘을 빼야,
좋은 남자가 될 수 있다!
enUS_text: Kiwru, you're too stiff! You have to relax your shoulders more, or you'll never be a great man!
zhTW_text:
奇羽琉，你太緊繃了！
肩膀要是不再放鬆點，
是成不了好男人的！

enUS_text: Nice! You're better than I thought, Rulie!
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻，小露露也比人家想像得還厲害嘛！

enUS_text: If I look shaken up, it's because you attacked me, Atuy!
zhTW_text: ……都是因為被阿圖依小姐你攻擊了啊！

jaJP_text:
각오해라.
너까지 함께 이 나라, 되찾아 주겠다!
enUS_text: This is it, Maroro. I'm taking you back, along with this country!
zhTW_text:
做好覺悟吧。
鄙人要連同你一起，奪回這個國家！

jaJP_text:
건너오는 순간을 베어 버리면 된다!
그것뿐이다!
enUS_text: Don't worry if they make it across. We just have to cut them down before they can fight back!
zhTW_text:
只要在他們過來時砍殺就行了！
僅此而已！

enUS_text: We'll get you out of there... I promise!
zhTW_text:
絕對……
我絕對會救出小久你的！

jaJP_text:
언제까지 멍하니 서 있을 셈입니까?
자, 일어나세요!
enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

enUS_text: Are you going to be all right, Ku?
zhTW_text: 小久，你沒事嗎……

enUS_text: We'll get you back, Miss Kuon... I promise.
zhTW_text: 一定要把久遠大人帶回來，一定要……

jaJP_text:
흉흉하고, 무서운 얼굴……
전의 화장이 더 나았다고 생각하는데.
enUS_text: Your face looks so cruel and twisted... I preferred your makeup the way it was before.
zhTW_text:
充滿不祥之氣又恐怖的臉……
我覺得之前化的妝比較好呢。

jaJP_text:
자, 어찌한 것이오?
아직 마로는 팔팔하오이다.
enUS_text: Surely you're not faltering now? My will to war still burneth hot.
zhTW_text:
好啦，怎麼了？
麻呂我還生龍活虎的喔。

jaJP_text:
하지만 강운도 거기까지다.
오랜 세월 이어진 인연에 종지부를 찍어 주겠습니다!
enUS_text: But your string of good luck ends here. It's time to end our long-standing feud, Oshtor!
zhTW_text:
但你的好運也到此為止了……
為我們之間長年以來的因緣做個了斷吧！

enUS_text: It's most curious...
zhTW_text: 所以感覺很不可思議……

jaJP_text: 여기서 남자다운 모습을 보여서 네코네 씨에게…!
enUS_text: Today I'll show you what I'm really made of, Nekone...!
zhTW_text: 我要在這裡向貓音小姐展現男子氣概……！

jaJP_text:
제일 먼저 저쪽에 닿으면 적을 독차지다!
힘내라~ 우히힛!!
enUS_text: Heehee, let's do this! First one across gets the enemy all to themselves!
zhTW_text:
只要率先抵達另一邊就能獨占所有敵人了！
人家會加油的～嘻嘻嘻！

enUS_text: Geegeegee!
zhTW_text: 吱吱吱吱！

jaJP_text:
(이 힘을 계속 쓰면 몸이 버티지 못해……
　그런 말을 하고 있을 상대는 아니지만……)
enUS_text: (Using this power gradually eats away at my being... But I can't hold back against an opponent like this.)
zhTW_text:
（一直使用這份力量，身體會撐不住……
　雖然面對這個對手，我也沒有餘力顧慮了……）

jaJP_text:
확실히, 짐은 오슈토르에게만 의지해 왔다.
많은 이들의 지극한 정성과 헌신이 없었다면 여기까지 올 수 없었을 것이니라.
enUS_text: It's true that I've relied on Oshtor all this time. I would never have made it this far without the bravery and loyalty of my many allies.
zhTW_text:
的確，余太依賴奧修特爾了。
若沒有眾人的忠誠和奉獻，余是無法走到這步的。

enUS_text: HRAAAGH!
zhTW_text: 唔喔喔喔喔喔！

enUS_text: Big Sister...
zhTW_text: 姊姊大人……

enUS_text: You're up, girls!
zhTW_text: 輪到你們兩個出場了！

jaJP_text:
무네치카 님,
지금이야말로, 마음껏 힘을 휘둘러 주십시오.
enUS_text: Miss Munechika, now is the time to exercise your power to its utmost.
zhTW_text:
宗近大人，
現在，正是您盡情施展力量之時。

enUS_text: O-Of course, I'd be glad to!
zhTW_text: 呃，嗯，正合我意！

enUS_text: The rest is up to you, Nosuri...
zhTW_text: 鵟，之後就拜託你了……

enUS_text: Hroaaaaaaaaah!
zhTW_text: 哦喔喔喔喔────！

jaJP_text:
적이 아직 무슨 계책을 숨기고 있을지도 몰라……
모두, 방심하지 말고 싸워 줘!
enUS_text: Seems like the enemy still have some tricks up their sleeves... Stay sharp, everyone!
zhTW_text:
敵人或許還有什麼計策……
各位，小心應戰吧！

enUS_text: Whoops... Looks like I went a little too wild...
zhTW_text:
哎呀呀……
不小心嗨過頭了……

jaJP_text: 역시, 저는 여러분에 비하면 아직 한참 멀었어…
enUS_text: I'm still not good enough to support all of you...
zhTW_text: 果然我和大家相比，還是遠遠不成氣候……

enUS_text: It seems this is a beast that won't be easily tamed.
zhTW_text: 看來牠似乎沒有被馴化啊。

jaJP_text:
우히힛,
오라버니가 있으면 안심하고 전력을 낼 수 있겠네!!
enUS_text: Heehee. Now that you're here, I can really put my heart into this!
zhTW_text:
嘻嘻嘻，
既然有小哥在，感覺人家就能放心使出全力了！

jaJP_text:
키우루!
손을 멈추지 말고 계속하는 것입니다!
enUS_text: Less talk, Kiwru! Keep firing!
zhTW_text:
奇羽琉！
不要停手，繼續攻擊！

enUS_text: Guess we'd better step up and do our part, too.
zhTW_text: 所以得由人家振作才行。

enUS_text: I hope you're ready for me.
zhTW_text: 要動手了，沒問題吧？

jaJP_text: 가, 간만 좀 봐 줬으면 좋겠네……
enUS_text: Anything but that...
zhTW_text: 拜、拜託放過我吧……

enUS_text: From Denebokshiri...
zhTW_text: 來自地獄……

enUS_text: The path up the hill is a narrow one.
zhTW_text: 去高地的路途相當狹窄。
咕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: Likewise, I'll hit you with all the power I have!
zhTW_text: 好好嚐嚐我這份力量吧！

jaJP_text:
처음부터 이게 목적이었던 건가……
지쳐 있는 틈을 노리지 못하게 조심해…!
enUS_text: Is this what you were aiming for from the start...? Don't let them tire you out, everyone!
zhTW_text:
他的目的打從一開始就是這個嗎……
小心不要在心神消耗時被盯上了！

jaJP_text:
크크크…, 과연 나의 숙적.
그렇게 쉽게는 안 되는 모양이군……
enUS_text: Heheheh... Well played, my old rival. Should've known you wouldn't make this easy for me...
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵……不愧是我的宿敵。
看來並沒有那麼好對付……

jaJP_text: 오슈토르, 함께 싸워 온 동료들의 힘을 믿어라!
enUS_text: Oshtor, put your trust in those who've chosen to fight with you!
zhTW_text: 奧修特爾，相信一路上並肩作戰的夥伴們的力量吧！

enUS_text: Got it!
zhTW_text: 嗯，這我知道！

jaJP_text:
토키후사!
아버님을 속인 죄, 여기서 사죄하라!!
enUS_text: Tokifusa! Now that I have you, you're going to apologize for what you did to my father.
zhTW_text:
時櫻！
快點為欺騙了父親大人一事謝罪！

enUS_text: Gwugh... I'm sorry, Lady Shis...
zhTW_text:
唔嗚……
希絲大人……實在非常抱歉……

enUS_text: Oshtor... *sob* Why...?
zhTW_text:
奧修……特爾……
啊……啊……為什麼……

jaJP_text:
하쿠 님께서 돌아오셨습니다.
쿠온 님도 반드시 구해 내고 말겠습니다…!
enUS_text: Sir Haku has returned. We won't fail to rescue Miss Kuon now!
zhTW_text:
哈克大人歸來了。
我也一定要把久遠大人救出來！

enUS_text: Hraaaaaargh!
zhTW_text: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

enUS_text: Take care of Ku for me...
zhTW_text: 久就拜託你了。

enUS_text: Heheh... You're welcome to try.
zhTW_text: 呵呵……那好吧……

jaJP_text:
황녀님…… 잘 말씀하셨습니다.
그렇다면 저 또한, 이 길을 끝까지 관철할 뿐.
enUS_text: Well said, my liege... I'd be honored to help clear the way for you.
zhTW_text:
公主殿下……您所言甚是。
那麼鄙人也將貫徹此道。

enUS_text: You really are ugly little creatures...
zhTW_text: 真是礙眼……

jaJP_text:
말 안 해도……, 그럴 생각이다!
전신전령을 다해, 너를 쓰러뜨리겠다!!
enUS_text: That was always my intention... I'll hit you with everything I've got!
zhTW_text:
不用你說……鄙人也是這麼打算的！
鄙人將會賭上全力，收拾掉你！

enUS_text: Oh? Looks like I caught up to you two.
zhTW_text:
咦？
不小心逼到絕境了呢。

jaJP_text: 코코포, 오슈토르 님께 힘이 되어 드려……
enUS_text: Cocopo, lend Sir Oshtor your strength...
zhTW_text: 可可啵，請幫幫奧修特爾大人吧……

jaJP_text:
마로로 씨,
대체 왜 이러시는 건가요……!
enUS_text: Maroro, what's happened to you...?!
zhTW_text:
麻呂呂先生，
你究竟是怎麼了……！

enUS_text: As you wish, Master.
zhTW_text: 一切如您所願……

enUS_text: Hey... Just who the heck are you?!
zhTW_text: 你……你是誰……？

enUS_text: I'm way ahead of you.
zhTW_text: 遵命！

enUS_text: Is that all you've got? I'm not satisfied yet!
zhTW_text:
你的力量……
就這點程度嗎！

jaJP_text:
큭… 이대로는 승기를 잡을 수 없어…!
우선 저 측근을 어떻게든 하지 않으면 안 되겠군……
enUS_text: Nrgh... We're never going to win like this! We'll have to do something about his aide first.
zhTW_text:
唔……再這樣下去是沒有勝算的！
首先得解決那個侍衛吧……

jaJP_text:
응……?
저 커다란 키마마우에게 다른 키마마우들이 모여들고 있지 않아?
enUS_text: Hm...? Doesn't it seem like they're all gathered around that one big kimamau?
zhTW_text:
嗯……？
不覺得其他奇瑪瑪好像都聚在那隻大隻的奇瑪瑪附近嗎？

enUS_text: That's more like it! Bwahahaha!
zhTW_text:
沒錯，就是要這樣！
呵哈哈哈哈哈！

jaJP_text:
정신 차리렴…… 루루티에……
부탁이니까 언니 말 좀 들어 줘……
enUS_text: Please, Rulutieh. I need you to be realistic and do as I say.
zhTW_text:
快點清醒吧……露露緹耶……
拜託你，聽姊姊的話……
咕嚕嚕……？

jaJP_text:
주인님을 여기서 죽게 둘 수는 없습니다.
전력을 다해 나서겠습니다.
enUS_text: No holding back. We won't allow you to die here, Master.
zhTW_text:
不能讓主人死在這裡。
我們會全力以赴。

jaJP_text:
이건 화장이 아니오.
억누를 수 없는 마음의 끓어오름이 드러난 것이오이다.
enUS_text: My visage is but a reflection of such wrath as seeth'th in my heart. Cosmetics have naught to do with it!
zhTW_text:
這並非化妝。
而是內心無可壓抑的沸騰之情顯現出來的模樣是也。

enUS_text: It seems you managed to regroup after all.
zhTW_text: 已經會合了嗎。

jaJP_text:
오슈토르 씨,
싸움 중에 한눈팔면 안 된다 아이가?
enUS_text: Oshtor, you have to keep your head in the game, you know?
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾先生，
比試中不可以東張西望喔？

jaJP_text:
요새를 공격하러 왔다기엔,
병사 수가 적은 것 같은 것입니다.
enUS_text: Considering they're trying to conquer a fortress, the enemy force seems rather small.
zhTW_text:
以攻打堡壘來說，
士兵的數量有點太少了。

jaJP_text: 이 일격에 모든 것을 건다! 간다, 미카즈치!!
enUS_text: This attack will end it all! Here I come, Mikazuchi!
zhTW_text: 我要在這一擊賭上一切！　要上了，御雷！

jaJP_text:
뭘 그렇게 빤히 보고 있는 겁니까?
훈련에 집중하지 않으면 큰 부상으로는 안 끝나는 것입니다……
enUS_text: What are you staring at? You could get hurt if you get distracted during training, you know.
zhTW_text:
你在盯什麼？
訓練時若不集中精神，可不只有受重傷那麼簡單……

enUS_text: Ngigyaaagh!
zhTW_text: 嗯吱咿呀啊啊啊啊嘰啊啊啊！

jaJP_text:
이 광기와도 같은 고양감,
내 목숨조차 하찮은 것으로 여겨지는구나.
enUS_text: This dizzying high verges on insanity... My own life seems trivial in comparison.
zhTW_text:
這種近似於瘋狂的振奮感，
讓我連自己的性命都感覺微不足道。

jaJP_text: 자, 어디까지 해낼 수 있을지 보여 드리도록 하죠…!
enUS_text: In that case, allow us to show you!
zhTW_text: 好了，我就看看你們能掙扎到什麼程度吧！

jaJP_text:
기다려, 쿠쨩……
이제 오슈토르 님이 와 주셨으니까……
enUS_text: Wait for us, Ku... Now Sir Oshtor is back, we won't lose.
zhTW_text:
再等一下喔小久，
奧修特爾大人都來了……

enUS_text: Please...stop...
zhTW_text: 拜託……停手……

enUS_text: Uh... Like this?
zhTW_text: 呃……是這樣嗎？

jaJP_text:
그누누, 아직이다!
나는 아직 지지 않았어!!
enUS_text: Grrr... It's not over! I haven't lost yet!
zhTW_text:
可惡，還沒完！
我還沒有輸！

jaJP_text:
네코냥.
뭐고, 안색이 안 좋은데 무슨 일이고?
괜찮나?
enUS_text: You're lookin' kind of pale there, Neko. You feeling all right?
zhTW_text:
小貓音。
感覺你臉色不太好，怎麼了嗎？
還好嗎？

jaJP_text:
효호.
그리 노려보지 말아 주셨으면 하오이다……
enUS_text: Nyohoh. Pray, do not glare at me with such ferocity...
zhTW_text:
唷呵呵。
請別那樣瞪麻呂我……

enUS_text: I'm afraid I must retire...
zhTW_text: 我就先去休息了……

jaJP_text:
가면을 잃었다고 해도, 실력까지 떨어졌다고는 생각지 않는다.
간다!!
enUS_text: I may have lost my akuruka, but I can still fight! Prepare yourself!
zhTW_text:
就算失去假面，在下的身手也不會因此退步。
要上了！

jaJP_text: 어떻게든 저 키마마우만 이쪽으로 유인할 수 있으면 좋겠는데.
enUS_text: If only we had a way to lure the leader over to us without attracting the others...
zhTW_text: 要是有辦法能只把那隻奇瑪瑪吸引過來就好了。

enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

enUS_text: Y-Yes. I'm well aware...
zhTW_text: 嗯，我明白……

jaJP_text:
정말 당신과 있으면 지루할 틈이 없군요,
오슈토르 씨.
enUS_text: I have to hand it to you, Oshtor. Being around you is never boring.
zhTW_text:
跟你待在一起真的不會無聊呢，
奧修特爾先生。

jaJP_text:
(이 검에 맹세하노니, 긍지를…,
　그리고 야마토를 되찾는 것이니라…!!)
enUS_text: (I swear on this sword... I'll take back the pride we've lost. I'll take back Yamato!)
zhTW_text:
（在這把劍上賭上榮譽、賭上驕傲……
　接著奪回大和……！）

jaJP_text: 우리 활로 꿰뚫지 못할 자는 없다!!
enUS_text: Nobody can avoid our arrows!
zhTW_text: 沒有我們的弓箭射不穿的敵人！

jaJP_text: 네놈의 그것은, 결코 그 녀석의 칼솜씨가 아니다……
enUS_text: You do a passable imitation, but you can't fool me. You're not him.
zhTW_text: 你剛剛那一招根本不是那傢伙的刀法……

enUS_text: No... The way things are going, everyone's going to...
zhTW_text:
再這樣下去……
大家……大家都會……

enUS_text: AAAAAH...
zhTW_text: 啊啊啊啊……

jaJP_text:
성문이 열렸다!!
서둘러 성 안을 제압하라!!
enUS_text: The gate is open! Troops, charge in and conquer the fort!
zhTW_text:
城門敞開了！
快點鎮壓城內！

enUS_text: Now... Bring it on, Oshtor!
zhTW_text: 好了，來吧……奧修特爾！

jaJP_text:
적은 소수다, 일제히 덤벼라!!
적에게 쉴 틈을 주지 마라!!
enUS_text: The enemy are on the ropes! Finish the rest of them before they can recover!
zhTW_text:
敵人以寡敵眾，大夥一起上！
不要讓敵人有機會休息！

enUS_text: Imminent danger.
zhTW_text: 危險。
咕嚕嚕！

enUS_text: This is the power of the Imperial Guard of the Right... Not bad at all!
zhTW_text:
不愧是右近衛大將……
果真名不虛傳……！

enUS_text: Charge in and mow them all down!
zhTW_text: 趁著這股氣勢一口氣擊潰對方吧！

enUS_text: Nyoh? No change hath wrought itself 'pon Maro.
zhTW_text:
唷呵？
麻呂我並沒有怎麼樣啊。

jaJP_text: 여기서 무슨 일이 있어도 막아 내 보이겠다.
enUS_text: I'll stop you here and now, whatever it takes.
zhTW_text: 無論如何都要在這裡阻止他們。

jaJP_text:
부탁이야, 죽지 마……
무사히 돌아와 줘……, 하쿠……
enUS_text: Don't die... You have to come back to us... Haku.
zhTW_text:
拜託，不要死……
你要平安回來……哈克……

enUS_text: We need to hurry and cross to the opposite shore.
zhTW_text: 必須早點抵達對岸才行呢。

enUS_text: No way... Is this really how it ends?
zhTW_text:
怎、怎麼這樣……
遺憾……

enUS_text: I know, I know... Just give me some space.
zhTW_text:
我知道了啦……
別黏得這麼緊！

enUS_text: All right, let's do this!
zhTW_text: 好了，要上囉！

enUS_text: Th-The barrier is going down...
zhTW_text: 結、結界要消……失了……

enUS_text: I'll be making the first move this time, Oshtor!
zhTW_text:
先從我開始吧！
奧修特爾！

jaJP_text:
후, 후하하하하하하…!
이 판국에 무슨 말을 하나 했더니 또 옛날이야기를……
enUS_text: Heh... Hahahaha! Of all the things to bring up at a time like this... My supplanting your father is ancient history!
zhTW_text:
呵、呵哈哈哈哈哈哈！
都這種時候了，還以為你要說什麼，結果卻是老調重彈……

jaJP_text:
대단한 힘의 사용법……
모두, 너무 뭉쳐 있지 않도록 주의해!!
enUS_text: He sure knows how to wield that power... Everyone, don't let yourselves get overwhelmed!
zhTW_text:
好驚人的力量使用方式……
各位，注意不要太集中於一地了！

jaJP_text: 아아… 막연하지만 소생도 알 것 같다……
enUS_text: Yes, I think I know what you mean.
zhTW_text: 是啊……鄙人也能隱約察覺……

jaJP_text:
그 위에 매복도 많다……
어떻게 하지……?
enUS_text: There's lots of places for the enemy to ambush us, too... What do I do now?
zhTW_text:
而且還有很多伏兵……
要怎麼辦……

enUS_text: I don't care who we're up against. I'll take them on anywhere, anytime!
zhTW_text:
不管對手是誰都無所謂。
一起放馬過來吧！

enUS_text: I'll do whatever I can!
zhTW_text: 我會想辦法解決的！

jaJP_text:
그렇기에, 짐은 아버님의 유지를 잇#@－－#
그래야만 한다.
enUS_text: But that is all the more reason to carry on my father's legacy. That is my duty!
zhTW_text:
正因如此，余更要繼承父親大人的遺志#@－－#
余非得這麼做不可。

enUS_text: This... is the end, Woshis!
zhTW_text:
這就是……最後一擊了……
沃西斯！

jaJP_text:
오슈토르 씨는 늘 우리한텐 엄격하면서,
정작 자기는 의외로 성미가 급하다 아이가.
enUS_text: Sheesh, Oshtor... You're always telling us to be more disciplined, and there you go charging in on your own.
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾先生，明明平常都對我們很嚴格，
自己卻意外地急性子啊。

jaJP_text:
저희가 여황을…,
쿠온 님을 지키는 것입니다!
enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

jaJP_text:
그것만은 무슨 일이 있어도,
막아 내지 않으면 안 된다…!
enUS_text: We have to do whatever it takes to prevent that!
zhTW_text:
我無論如何，
都必須阻止這種事情發生！

enUS_text: In the end, it was nothing to fear.
zhTW_text: 什麼啊，真是群無聊的傢伙……

jaJP_text:
이런 공격으로,
저걸 쓰러뜨릴 수 있을까요……
enUS_text: Will attacks like this even work on a monster like that?
zhTW_text:
這點程度的攻擊，
真能打倒那個嗎……

jaJP_text:
짐도 더는 참을 수 없느니라!
저자를 혼내 주지 않고서는 속이 풀리지 않겠느니라!!
enUS_text: I've had enough! I won't rest until these miscreants have been punished!
zhTW_text:
余也忍無可忍了！
要是不嚴懲那些傢伙，余不會善罷干休！

jaJP_text:
기세를 몰아 이쪽 전력을 단숨에 깎아낼 생각이겠지.
우리가 뒤로 물러설 수 없는 사정도 알아차리고 있을 것이다.
enUS_text: They're probably planning to wear us down through sheer brute force. I'd guess they know we can't give up any ground here, too.
zhTW_text:
他們是打算憑著氣勢一口氣削弱我方的戰力吧。
對方似乎也察覺到了我方沒有辦法撤退的理由。

jaJP_text:
이런, 나리.
한 수 부탁드리고 싶구려!
enUS_text: Hey Boss. How about a quick match to get our blood pumping?
zhTW_text:
哎呀，老爺。
跟我交個手吧！

jaJP_text:
이런 이런…… 가운지라니……
성가신 비장의 수를 남겨 두고 갔군.
enUS_text: A gaunji now, huh? Who'd've thought they had a trick like that up their sleeve?
zhTW_text:
烈獸還真是的……
竟然留了那麼棘手的殺手鐧。

enUS_text: All right, I'll handle it! Now go and get some rest.
zhTW_text:
我知道，
你儘管放心交給我吧！

jaJP_text:
이번 싸움…,
더 이상 길어지게 둘 수는 없겠군요.
enUS_text: We can't let this battle become drawn out. We have to end it.
zhTW_text:
不能再讓這場戰鬥……
繼續拖延下去了。

jaJP_text: 가운지는 그 누구에게도 따르지 않는 야생 짐승인 것입니다……
enUS_text: Gaunjis are notorious for their stubborn independent spirit.
zhTW_text: 因為烈獸是不會跟隨任何人的野獸……

jaJP_text: 내 공격을, 네놈이 간파할 수 있을 거라 생각하느냐?
enUS_text: Think you can keep up with my next attack?
zhTW_text: 你當真以為就憑你也能看穿我的攻擊？

jaJP_text:
으음, 졸려 오기 시작하는구나……
하지만 그렇다고 그럴 형편도 아니구나……
enUS_text: Mnh, I'm still sleepy... But I suppose we have bigger concerns right now.
zhTW_text:
唔～嗯，有點想睡了……
但現況可不允許余睡覺……

jaJP_text:
오슈토르 씨가 상대라면,
저도 여러 가지를 배울 수 있을 것 같네요.
enUS_text: I'm sure sparring against you will be very instructive.
zhTW_text:
若對手是奧修特爾先生，
我應該也能學到不少呢。

jaJP_text:
하지만 악연이라니… 대체 무슨 말이지?
보코이난테와는 그다지 접점이 없었던 것 같은데…?
enUS_text: "Our...feud?" What are you talking about? So far as I'm aware, you and I have...no particular relationship.
zhTW_text:
但他說的因緣……究竟是指什麼？
我跟波科伊南特應該沒什麼接觸才對啊……？

enUS_text: Ngwagiiiaaagh!
zhTW_text: 嘰啊嘰啊啊啊咿咿咿啊啊啊啊！

jaJP_text:
큭, 정체를 알 수 없는 이상,
함부로 가까이 갈 수는 없습니다…!
enUS_text: We shouldn't go charging in until we know more about it.
zhTW_text:
可惡，畢竟我們對牠們一無所知，
也不能貿然接近……！
咕嚕嚕！

jaJP_text:
그럼 가 볼까.
적이 이쪽에 물고 늘어지려 한다면,
오히려 그 목을 물어뜯어 버릴 때까지!
enUS_text: Get ready, everyone. We'll weather the enemy's attack and wait for our chance to turn this battle around!
zhTW_text:
那麼就上吧。
既然敵人向吾等露出獠牙，
就反過頭去咬破他們的喉嚨！

jaJP_text: 절대로… 절대로 못 가게 하겠다, 쿠온!
enUS_text: You can't go and leave us all behind, Kuon... I won't allow it!
zhTW_text: 余是絕不會……絕不會放你走的，久遠！

jaJP_text:
명을 받들겠습니다!
마로로여, 이번 싸움, 결판을 내겠다.
enUS_text: Yes, my liege! Maroro, this battle is where we'll finally settle things.
zhTW_text:
遵命！
麻呂呂，就在這場戰鬥中做個了斷吧。

jaJP_text:
호호호…… 확실히 그럴듯한 말투이오이다.
하지만 아무것도 달라지지 않소이다.
enUS_text: Hoh hoh hoh... I suspected thou wouldst say something like that. But this changes nothing.
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵……說起話來確實是有模有樣呢。
但這樣也改變不了任何事。

enUS_text: Heeheehee...! This is giving me chills!
zhTW_text:
唔嘻嘻嘻嘻<onpu>
真叫人興奮難耐……！

jaJP_text:
시스 공, 루루티에는 스스로 둥지를 떠나기로 결심한 것이다.
시스 공의 상냥함은 그런 루루티에를 약하게 만들 뿐이다.
enUS_text: Lady Shis, Rulutieh has already made her decision. Forcing her to go back on it won't help her now.
zhTW_text:
希絲殿下，露露緹耶是自己決定要離家的。
希絲殿下的這份溫柔，會令露露緹耶變得軟弱。

enUS_text: We're with you, Master.
zhTW_text: 主人，一起。

enUS_text: Is that all you've got, Oshtor?
zhTW_text: 你只有這點程度嗎，奧修特爾！

jaJP_text:
여러 일이 있었느니라! 짐은…… 짐은……
에잇, 뭘 어떻게 말해야 좋단 말이냐……
enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

jaJP_text:
제인 짐이,
신하 뒤에 숨어 있을 수는 없다!
짐도 나가겠다!!
enUS_text: A true ruler doesn't hide behind her retainers. She takes the field with them!
zhTW_text:
余貴為帝，
可不能一直躲在臣下身後！
余也要出陣！

enUS_text: Don't get in my way...
zhTW_text: 真希望你們別來礙事……

enUS_text: You're the one who's in our way, fool!
zhTW_text: 攪局的到底是誰啊！

enUS_text: Don't go too wild, okay Cocopo?
zhTW_text: 可可啵，你可別太魯莽喔？

jaJP_text:
또 이 느낌인가.
마로에게 대체 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는 거지?
enUS_text: Sooner or later, he always ends up like this... Just what's happened to Maro?
zhTW_text:
又是這種感覺啊。
麻呂的身上到底發生了什麼事？

jaJP_text:
아직이다, 아직……
이런 형태로는… 끝낼 수는 없다……
enUS_text: No... Not yet... It can't end like this...
zhTW_text:
還沒完、還沒……
我可不能用這種方式……結束……

enUS_text: Prepare to charge, Mukkuru!
zhTW_text: 穆庫爾，要上了！

enUS_text: Forgive me. I wish I could do more...
zhTW_text: 請原諒在下的無力……

enUS_text: Hold on, Kuon!
zhTW_text: 你等著吧，久遠！

enUS_text: I'm with you!
zhTW_text: 遵命！

enUS_text: Please... save them...
zhTW_text: 救救……大家……

jaJP_text:
……후훗, 이렇게 기쁜 일이 또 있을까요.
그렇지, 코코포.
enUS_text: Heehee, looks like the tide is turning in our favor. Right, Cocopo?
zhTW_text:
……呵呵，世上還有比這更令人高興的事嗎？
對吧？可可啵。

jaJP_text:
정말이지, 단순한 생물이네요.
어째서 워시스 님의 생각을
이해하지 못하는 걸까요……
enUS_text: Such simple organisms. You could never understand Lord Woshis' true brilliance.
zhTW_text:
你們真是群單純的生物。
為什麼就是無法明白
沃西斯大人的用意呢……

enUS_text: Yes, that's it... This is how it should end...
zhTW_text: 沒……錯……就是要這樣……

enUS_text: Rulutieh! Are you all right?
zhTW_text: 露露緹耶！　你沒事吧？

enUS_text: Th-Thank you!
zhTW_text: 謝、謝謝你的誇獎！

enUS_text: Observe and adapt.
zhTW_text: 適材適用。

jaJP_text:
그러니까, 언니!
응원해 줬으면 하는 것입니다!!
enUS_text: Please, Big Sister! I don't want to do this without your support!
zhTW_text:
所以，姊姊大人！
希望你能為我加油打氣！

jaJP_text:
왜 그러시죠?
당신의 상대는 한 명이 아닌데요?
enUS_text: What's the matter? There's more than one of us, you know.
zhTW_text:
怎麼了？
你的對手可不只一人喔？

enUS_text: Yeah. Let's finish this!
zhTW_text: 好吧，那就在這邊做個了結！

enUS_text: I hope you're prepared to face the consequences of your actions.
zhTW_text: 做好覺悟了嗎？

jaJP_text:
크크크, 과연 나의 숙적……
이래야 재미있지!
enUS_text: Heheh, that's more like the rival I know... I'd hate for this to get boring!
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵，不愧是我的宿敵……
還是得這樣才有趣啊！

jaJP_text:
간신배 놈들을 처치하라…!
이번 싸움… 절대로 져서는 안 된다!!
enUS_text: Eliminate these rebels once and for all! We cannot lose this battle!
zhTW_text:
解決那些奸賊！
絕對不能……輸掉這場戰鬥！

jaJP_text:
오, 오우……
그렇게 큰 소리를
내지 않아도 되잖아……
enUS_text: Okay, cool. And you don't gotta yell like that, you know.
zhTW_text:
喔、喔……
不用這麼大聲
也沒關係吧……

jaJP_text:
후미뤼르라고 했나,
쿠온의 벗이라면 곧 짐의 벗이나 다름없느니라.
그리 격식을 차리지 않아도 좋다.
enUS_text: Fumirul, was it? I bid you welcome. Any friend of Kuon's is a friend of mine.
zhTW_text:
那個叫芙米露露的人，
既然是久遠的朋友，那當然也是余的朋友。
別這麼拘謹。

jaJP_text:
저희도 시스 님과 함께 싸우겠습니다!
시스 님을 화나게 한 것, 후회하게 해 드리겠습니다!
enUS_text: We'll fight alongside Lady Shis. You're going to regret making her angry!
zhTW_text:
我等也要與希絲大人一同戰鬥！
我等會讓你因激怒希絲大人感到後悔！

enUS_text: I'll ask again. Who the hell ARE you?!
zhTW_text: 你是……什麼人！

jaJP_text:
기습이 성공했다고 해서,
너무 우쭐대는 것 아니오이까?
enUS_text: Thy petty sneak attack availed, and yet, 'tis far too soon for thou to claim advantage.
zhTW_text:
不過就是奇襲成功了，
你們是不是太得意忘形啦？

enUS_text: Heheheh... Is that all you've got?
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵呵……
就這點程度嗎？

enUS_text: You're better than I thought... not that I had planned on holding back anyway...
zhTW_text:
我不覺得自己有留一手，
但你挺行的嘛……

jaJP_text:
전력을 다 꺼내기 전에,
승부를 끝내게 해 줬으면 좋겠네!
enUS_text: Personally, I'd rather finish this battle before you can go all out.
zhTW_text:
希望能在對方使出全力之前
做個了結呢！

jaJP_text:
이번 싸움, 우리에게 패배란 없다!
나아가라! 전진만이 있을 뿐이다!!
enUS_text: Failure is not an option! Keep moving forward at all costs!
zhTW_text:
這場戰爭，我們不可能會輸！
前進！　只管繼續前進！

enUS_text: Oshtor... You really came back...
zhTW_text: 兄長大人……兄長大人都趕來了……

enUS_text: Right back at you. Try to keep up!
zhTW_text: 你才是，動作太慢會被我丟下的喔！

enUS_text: At this rate, our destruction is assured.
zhTW_text: 再這樣下去，會走投無路。

enUS_text: The real fun is yet to come.
zhTW_text: 扮家家酒就到此為止了。

jaJP_text:
늦어서 죄송합니다……
오슈토르 님, 쿠온 님.
enUS_text: Sorry we're late... Sir Oshtor, Lady Kuon! We're ready to fight!
zhTW_text:
抱歉，我來遲了……
奧修特爾大人、久遠大人。

jaJP_text: 뭐고, 아직 더 할 수 있을 것 같기도 한데……
enUS_text: Darn it, I wasn't done yet...
zhTW_text: 什麼啊？人家覺得還能繼續啊……

jaJP_text:
끄윽!?
…우히힛, 방금 건 잘 들었데이!
이건 기대해도 되겠는걸…!!
enUS_text: Hrgh...! Yeah, felt that one, didn't ya? This is gonna work!
zhTW_text:
唔嗚！？
嘻嘻嘻，剛才的很有效喔！
看來值得期待啊……

enUS_text: I won't; you can count on it!
zhTW_text: 嗯，我明白！

enUS_text: You think you have what it takes to protect her?
zhTW_text: 你們保護得了她嗎！

jaJP_text:
숨어 있었던 게 아니라……, 아니
에에!?
enUS_text: I wasn't mopi— Wait, what?!
zhTW_text:
我並沒有垂頭喪氣……呃，
咦！？

enUS_text: Huh...?
zhTW_text: 咦！

jaJP_text:
하하하하!!
아들이 이 정도로는,
겐호우우도 속 끓일 일이 끝이 없겠구나?
enUS_text: Hahahaha! Poor Genho. How tragic that his son fails to even live up to the low standard he set!
zhTW_text:
哈哈哈哈！
兒子只有這點本事，
想必彥峰也操了不少心吧？
吼嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕嚕！

jaJP_text:
자, 울 것 같은 얼굴 하지 마.
정신 차리게만 해 줄 테니까…!
enUS_text: Hey, don't look so sad. We're just going to knock some sense into him.
zhTW_text:
好了，別一副要哭不哭的表情。
只是要讓他清醒一下而已……！

jaJP_text:
적 속에 주승병이 섞여 있습니다.
주인님, 주의해 주세요.
enUS_text: Master, the enemy have Cursed Warrior Monks with them. Don't let your guard down.
zhTW_text:
敵陣中混有咒僧兵。
主人，請留意。

enUS_text: But our objective remains the same!
zhTW_text: 不過……

enUS_text: Hoo boy... No chance of us getting an easy win for our final battle, huh?
zhTW_text:
……要我說的話，
是希望他差不多該停手了。

jaJP_text:
형님은 한계를 넘어서 싸우고 계셔…,
더 이상 쓸데없는 부담을 드릴 수는 없어…!
enUS_text: Oshtor's fighting well beyond his limit... We can't let him take all the burden on himself!
zhTW_text:
兄長大人正超越極限作戰著……
我不能再讓他承受更多負擔了！

jaJP_text:
이 몸이 부서진다 해도,
이곳은 소생이 목숨 걸고 지켜 보이겠다…!
enUS_text: Even if my body is broken, I will defend you all to the very last!
zhTW_text:
即使要粉碎己身，
在下也會死守這裡！

enUS_text: Carelessness costs lives.
zhTW_text: 不可輕敵。

jaJP_text:
그러고 보니 키마마우는 무리의 우두머리가 있어서,
그걸 쓰러뜨리면 다른 키마마우들도 물러난다고 들은 적이 있습니다.
enUS_text: You know, I've heard that if you defeat the leader of a kimamau pack, the rest will scatter.
zhTW_text:
這麼說來，我聽說奇瑪瑪有族群的首領，
只要打倒首領，其他的奇瑪瑪也會跟著離開。

enUS_text: What's the matter? We're not even close to being done yet.
zhTW_text:
怎麼了？
好戲現在才要開始喔……

jaJP_text:
워시스!
누가 마스터 키를 손에 넣을 자격이 있는지,
여기서 보여 주마!
enUS_text: Woshis! It's time to decide once and for all which of us is worthy of the Master Key!
zhTW_text:
沃西斯！
就在此一決勝負……
看看誰才有資格得到萬能鑰匙！

jaJP_text:
젠장…… 이 힘은……
점점 진형이 무너지고 있어……
enUS_text: Th-This power... The sigil is coming apart...
zhTW_text:
可惡……這份力量是……
陣形逐漸崩毀……

jaJP_text:
배우는 다 모였다…!
쿠온 구출을 서두르자…!!
enUS_text: Everyone's in place. All that's left is to rescue Kuon!
zhTW_text:
該來的都到齊了！
趕緊救出久遠吧！

jaJP_text: 지금까지 본색을 드러내지 않았던 상대다, 조심해라.
enUS_text: And we know so little about our opponent's true strength... We have to remain cautious.
zhTW_text: 還請留意至今為止都沒有顯露真本事的對手。

enUS_text: STaY...
zhTW_text: 等等……

jaJP_text:
이건……
써 버리신 거군요, 오슈토르 님……
enUS_text: Sir Oshtor... So you used it after all...
zhTW_text:
這是……
奧修特爾大人……您真的用了啊……
咕嚕！

jaJP_text:
노스리 씨는 오늘도 기운이 넘치는 것입니다.
저도 본받아야 하는 것입니다…….
enUS_text: Nosuri is always so full of energy. I have to do my best to learn from her example.
zhTW_text:
鵟小姐今天也很有精神。
我也得向她看齊才行……

enUS_text: Urk... Not bad...

jaJP_text:
결착의 때다, 오슈토르!
네놈은, 이 정도가 아닐 터…,
힘을 아끼지 마라!
enUS_text: It's time to finish this, Oshtor! Don't you dare hold back... I know you're stronger than this!
zhTW_text:
決戰之時已到，奧修特爾！
你並不只這點程度
別再藏招了！

jaJP_text:
너한텐 볼일 없다……
비켜라… 방해를…… 하지 마라!!
enUS_text: I have no use for you... Out of my way... Don't interfere!
zhTW_text:
與你無關……
滾開……不准……妨礙吾！

jaJP_text:
또 오슈토르 씨만
좋은 장면을 독차지할 생각이가?
enUS_text: Didn't think you keep all the fun opponents for yourself, did you, Oshtor?
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾先生，
你又想自己出風頭了？

enUS_text: Heeheehee... Man, now that's some power!
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻，真驚人……壓倒性的力量啊！

jaJP_text:
엄청 위험한 힘……
휘말리면 무사하진 못하겠네……
enUS_text: What incredible power... It'll all be over if we get caught up in it.
zhTW_text:
好危險的力量……
要是被波及，後果不堪設想……

jaJP_text:
마, 말도 안 돼……
대체, 어떻게 된 거지……!?
enUS_text: I-Impossible...! How could they be so strong?
zhTW_text:
怎、怎麼可能……
這究竟，是怎麼回事……！？

jaJP_text:
네코네는……,
네코네는 오라버니와 아직도 더 많이 하고 싶은 말이 있는 것입니다……
enUS_text: I... I still have so much I want to tell you, dear brother...
zhTW_text:
貓音我……
貓音我還有很多話想跟兄長說……

enUS_text: Heehee, I'm honored.
zhTW_text: 呵呵呵，那可真是光榮。

enUS_text: Kuon is your responsibility now...
zhTW_text:
久遠就
拜託你了喔……！

enUS_text: You're still determined to resist? Then we must respond in kind...!
zhTW_text:
你們還想抵抗啊……
那我們也要認真起來了！

enUS_text: Allow us to make the first move.
zhTW_text: 好了，我們這邊也要上了喔？

enUS_text: Uru, Sara! I've got you now!
zhTW_text: 小烏露、小薩拉，逮到你們啦！

enUS_text: Oo-keeeeee?!

jaJP_text:
모처럼 마주한 거다…,
사양하고 있으면 목이 날아간다?
enUS_text: We don't get many chances to go all out. Don't go holding back and getting yourself killed.
zhTW_text:
難得見上一面……
要是太客氣，小心頭顱不保喔？

jaJP_text:
역시 불길한 예감은 맞아떨어졌군……
만일의 사태도 상정해 두지 않으면 안 되겠어……
enUS_text: I knew something here wasn't right. We'd better prepare ourselves for the worst.
zhTW_text:
果然，不好的預感成真了嗎……
必須事先設想好最糟糕的事態才行……

enUS_text: We're going to save Kuon!
zhTW_text: 救出久遠！

jaJP_text:
오슈토르는 목숨을 걸고 이 싸움에 임하고 있다.
그렇다면, 우리에게 할 수 있는 일은 단 하나뿐이야……!
enUS_text: Oshtor's putting his life on the line to finish this battle. There's only one thing we can do for him.
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾把性命賭在這場戰鬥上。
那麼我們能做的事就只有一件……！

jaJP_text:
다들 힘내고 있는데,
약한 소리 따위 하고 있을 수 있겠어!
enUS_text: Everyone's fighting so hard... This is no time to back down!
zhTW_text:
大家都在努力奮戰，
我怎麼能說喪氣話！

jaJP_text:
자 그럼…… 저쪽도 더는 못 기다리겠나 본데,
여기서 끝장을 내 버릴까
enUS_text: And now, it'd be rude for us to let our pursuers wait too long. Let's clean this mess up!
zhTW_text:
接下來……看那些傢伙似乎等不及了，
我們差不多來收拾一下吧。

enUS_text: Return to the dust, Vurai!
zhTW_text: 化為塵土吧，武賴！

enUS_text: I'm relieved to see you've returned to Yamato safely, too.
zhTW_text: 原來你平安回到大和了啊。

jaJP_text:
젠장…, 라이코우 가면의 힘이 너무 강대해……
자기도 모르게 두려움을 품고, 뜻대로 움직이지 못하는 자들도 있는 모양이다.
enUS_text: Unbelievable... I never thought Raiko and his akuruka could be this strong. Some of the troops are even frozen in fear.
zhTW_text:
可惡……雷光的假面之力太強大了……
似乎也有人因為對其不甚了解而心生畏懼，無法行動自如。

enUS_text: Hiyah!
zhTW_text: 看我的！

enUS_text: I know that...! Follow your own advice, Fumirul!
zhTW_text:
我明白的！
芙米露露你也小心點……！

jaJP_text:
가까이서 보니 크긴 크네……
다들 간격에 충분히 주의하면서 싸워 줘!
enUS_text: It looks even bigger up close... Everyone, keep your distance and don't let it overwhelm you!
zhTW_text:
近看才發現，還真大隻……
各位，戰鬥時記得留意距離！

jaJP_text: 루루티에 공, 너무 무리는 하지 마시오.
enUS_text: Be careful not to overdo it, Lady Rulutieh.
zhTW_text: 露露緹耶殿下，別太逞強。

enUS_text: We will stamp out this resistance. Prepare yourselves.
zhTW_text:
這裡由我等來壓制。
……上陣。

jaJP_text:
여러분의 연계가 흐트러지고 있는 것입니다…….
이 힘은…… 언니…….
enUS_text: Our sense of coordination is being disrupted. Dear sister... Could this power be...?
zhTW_text:
大家的配合度都被打亂了……
這個力量是……　姊姊大人……

enUS_text: We're going all out.
zhTW_text: 我就以全力對付你們吧。
嘎喔喔喔喔喔喔！

jaJP_text:
여기는 맡겨 주세요…,
어떻게든 해내 보이겠습니다!
enUS_text: Leave this to me... I'm sure I'll figure something out!
zhTW_text:
這裡就請交給我吧……
我會想辦法解決的！

enUS_text: Non-human opponent.
zhTW_text: 非人之物。

enUS_text: Now then, let's begin.
zhTW_text: 好了，開始吧。

enUS_text: Be careful, Big Brother... Something's wrong here; I can feel it.
zhTW_text:
有種不祥的預感……
兄長……

jaJP_text:
그런데, 이게 뭐지…?
뭔가 지금까지와는 다른 느낌이 들어……
enUS_text: What IS this thing? It's really not like the ones we've fought before...
zhTW_text:
但是，這究竟是……
總感覺跟至今為止不太一樣……

enUS_text: We're up against a fearsome opponent this time.
zhTW_text: 竄出了麻煩的對手呢。

jaJP_text:
자, 뭘 하고 있는 것이오?
어서, 오슈토르의 목을 베는 것이오!
enUS_text: Come, come, wherefore this delay? Bring me Oshtor's head forthwith!
zhTW_text:
好了，你們在做什麼？
還不快拿下奧修特爾的頭顱！

enUS_text: We've got no choice but to charge right through! Let's do this, Ougi!
zhTW_text:
只能從正面突破了！
要上了，扇！

jaJP_text:
뭘 뭘…,
아직 잔치는 이제 막 시작된 것 아니겠소?
enUS_text: Ready and willing, dear lady. This banquet of blood is just beginning!
zhTW_text:
說什麼呢……
宴會才剛開始吧？

jaJP_text:
오슈토르 나리!
같은 편이라고 해서 사양은 없는 걸로 하면 되겠소?
enUS_text: You ready, Oshtor? Don't think I'll go easy on you just because we're allies.
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾老爺！
不必因為彼此是同伴就手下留情吧？

jaJP_text: 냉정함을 잃으면 키우루도 당해 버리는 것입니다……
enUS_text: Kiwru losing his cool is nothing new.
zhTW_text: 要是不冷靜下來，連奇羽琉都會被幹掉的……

enUS_text: Urk... You're getting pretty good at this, Kiwru.
zhTW_text:
唉……
奇羽琉也變得挺厲害的嘛……

enUS_text: We'll help out, too.
zhTW_text: 我們也來幫忙吧。

enUS_text: I won't let Rulutieh take one step outside this castle!
zhTW_text: 我絕不讓露露緹耶去城外！

enUS_text: Oh, that's a big one.
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻，來了大隻的啊。

enUS_text: I don't have time to waste on you!
zhTW_text: 這跟你無關！

enUS_text: Hroooooorgh! Mikazuchiiiiiiiii!
zhTW_text:
御雷──！
唔喔喔──！

enUS_text: Here we gooo!
zhTW_text: 去吧！

enUS_text: Gwargh! L-Long live Lord Raiko...!
zhTW_text:
唔啊！
雷光大人……萬……歲……！

enUS_text: Skrrrrch...
zhTW_text: 嘰吱吱吱吱吱……

jaJP_text: 좋은 여자에게는 쉬운 일이다, 맡겨 두거라!!
enUS_text: Of course! It's a trivial task for a good woman!
zhTW_text: 這對好女人來說簡直輕而易舉，交給我吧！

jaJP_text:
아투이, 정신 차려…!
다들 정신 바짝 차려…!!
enUS_text: Get a hold of yourself, Atuy! Everyone, don't let it get to you!
zhTW_text:
阿圖依，振作一點！
大家也不要被迷惑了……！

enUS_text: We're almost there.
zhTW_text: 就差一點。

jaJP_text:
쿠온 씨에게까지 다가가는 건,
쉽지 않은 모양이네요……
enUS_text: It's not going to be easy to reach Kuon like this.
zhTW_text:
看來要接近久遠小姐，
並不容易呢……

enUS_text: Ooh yeah! I'm just getting started!
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻嘻，人家還沒鬧夠呢！

enUS_text: Hmph. You're all so annoying... Get out of my sight!
zhTW_text:
哼……
愛耍小聰明的傢伙……滾吧！

jaJP_text:
빨리 막아야 해…,
힘이 점점 증폭하고 있어요……
enUS_text: His power just keeps growing... We have to stop him before it's too late.
zhTW_text:
得快點阻止他才行……
他的力量正不斷增強……

enUS_text: Looks like it still has plenty of energy.
zhTW_text: 感覺牠還能繼續打……

enUS_text: We'll have to be careful not to let them snipe us.
zhTW_text: 請小心不要被盯上。

jaJP_text:
이대로라면 휩쓸려 버려,
빨리 빠져나가야 해.
enUS_text: We'll get washed away if we stay here. We'd better move on.
zhTW_text:
再這樣下去會被沖走的。
得快點逃出去才行。

enUS_text: Just tough it out a little longer, okay?
zhTW_text: 再努力一下就好……好嗎？

enUS_text: Ooogee?!
zhTW_text: 嗚嘰！

jaJP_text:
아야~, 두 사람 눈앞이 갑자기 밝아져서,
순간 클라린 친구가 온 줄 알았데이~.
enUS_text: You two have a real nice look in your eyes all of a sudden. I feel like Kurarin's got herself some new friends.
zhTW_text:
哎呀～兩人的眼前忽然變亮了，
人家一瞬間還以為是克拉琳的朋友來了呢～

jaJP_text:
마로로 님…!
하쿠 님은 이런 일을 바라지 않으셨습니다!
enUS_text: Sir Maroro, please...! This isn't what Sir Haku would want!
zhTW_text:
麻呂呂大人……
哈克大人並不期望這種事發生！

jaJP_text:
우~, 아픈 것입니다……
그래도 봐줄 필요는 없는 것입니다…!
enUS_text: Urgh, it hurts... But I'll manage! Don't go easy on me!
zhTW_text:
唔～好痛……
但不必手下留情……！

jaJP_text:
아아, 하쿠의 유품인 만큼,
빨리 내 것으로 익혀야겠다고 생각해서 말이지……
enUS_text: Yes. Haku entrusted me with it, so I want to honor his memory.
zhTW_text:
是啊，畢竟是哈克的遺物，
所以我想應該要早點習慣……

jaJP_text:
정말 당신이라는 사람은,
언제나 사람을 놀라게 하는군요……
enUS_text: I swear, you really are full of surprises.
zhTW_text:
你這個人，
總讓人大吃一驚……

jaJP_text:
저주 같은 종류인가… 공기가 묘하게 무겁고 답답하네.
기합 좀 넣지 않으면, 우리 사기도 계속 떨어질 뿐이잖아.
enUS_text: Must be some kind of curse... The air feels heavy now, too. If we aren't careful, it'll sap our will to fight just like that.
zhTW_text:
是詛咒之類的嗎……總感覺空氣異常沉重。
要是不振作點，連我們的士氣都會一直下降的。

enUS_text: Looks like this is where the true test of our strength begins...
zhTW_text: 接下來才是重頭戲吧……

jaJP_text:
아무래도 진짜 공포라는 걸
알고 싶은 모양이군요……
enUS_text: It seems you've yet to experience real fear...
zhTW_text:
看來你想知道
何謂真正的恐懼呢……

enUS_text: I will use this power to crush you!
zhTW_text: 我就以這份力量，將一切破壞殆盡吧！
咕嚕嚕……

enUS_text: The pleasure is mine. Let's take the measure of each other.
zhTW_text:
彼此彼此……
要麻煩你和我交手了。

jaJP_text:
이것은 내 벗을 위한 송화다!
성대하게 타올라라, 이오!!
enUS_text: These fires shall light my dear friend's way to the otherworld... And all of you shall burn!
zhTW_text:
這是麻呂我獻給好友的送魂火！
盡情燃燒吧！

jaJP_text:
저 성벽은 어지간한 힘으로는 파괴가 불가능할 터……
대체 무슨 일이 있었던 거지……
enUS_text: No ordinary power could destroy these fortress walls. What is the enemy hiding...?
zhTW_text:
光憑一般的力量，應該是無法摧毀那座城牆的……
究竟是發生什麼事了……

enUS_text: The moment we strike one down, another takes its place...
zhTW_text: 就算打倒，也會接二連三出現啊……

jaJP_text:
흥…, 나와 보니,
뒤처진 병사들뿐인가.
기합 빠진 것들 같으니……
enUS_text: Hmph... Some soldiers. You're falling behind already, slackers.
zhTW_text:
哼……出來一看，
結果全是拖後腿的士兵啊。
一群窩囊廢……

enUS_text: I... I have to get back to the others...
zhTW_text:
得回到……
大家身邊才行……

jaJP_text: 나리, 딴생각하다간 다치는 걸로 안 끝난다?
enUS_text: If you get distracted, you could end up seriously hurt, you know?
zhTW_text: 老爺，要是分心可不只有受傷這麼簡單喔？

jaJP_text:
흥…, 어디 갔나 했더니……
오슈토르와 동행하고 있었던 건가.
enUS_text: Hmph. I was wondering where you were all this time... You decided to ally yourself with Oshtor, huh?
zhTW_text:
呵呵……還以為是跑去哪了……
你跟奧修特爾一起來的啊。

jaJP_text:
왜 가 버리는 거야?
언니가 싫어진 거야……?
enUS_text: Why do you want to leave so badly? Do you hate me that much?
zhTW_text:
為什麼要走呢？
你討厭姊姊了嗎……？

enUS_text: Urgh... S-Something like that.
zhTW_text: 唔……算、算是吧……

jaJP_text:
너와 놀아 줄 시간은 없다…, 거기서 비켜라!!
비키지 않는다면, 힘으로라도 밀고 지나가겠다!!
enUS_text: I don't have time to play around with you. Get out of my way or I'll force my way through!
zhTW_text:
我沒空和你鬧著玩了……給我讓開！
若你不肯讓開，我就要憑蠻力請你讓路了！

jaJP_text:
그래……
그래야만 야마토의 역사를 잇는 자들이지.
enUS_text: Yes... That's the determination worthy of those who would write a new chapter in Yamato's history.
zhTW_text:
沒錯……
這才稱得上是延續大和歷史的人們。

jaJP_text:
왜지? 어째서 이만한 계책을 꾸며도 굴복하지 않는 거지……
나는 팔주장이다! 이런 곳에서 끝날 수는 없다!!
enUS_text: Impossible... All my plans, all my strategies, defeated? I am a Pillar General! This can't be how my career ends...!
zhTW_text:
為何？　為何明明我施了無數計策，依然不肯屈服……
我可是八柱將啊！　怎能在這種時候被擊敗！

enUS_text: Tch...
zhTW_text: 可惡……

enUS_text: Of course. I am meant to be taking care of you, after all.
zhTW_text:
是的，那當然<onpu>
我可是負責照料小久你的人啊。

enUS_text: Brother, you have to win!
zhTW_text:
兄長大人！
請一定要獲勝！

enUS_text: Nrrrgh... They'd better hurry...!
zhTW_text: 唔唔唔……快點、快點啊……

jaJP_text:
오슈토르 님 혼자만 싸우게 두지는 않겠습니다……
저희도 싸우겠습니다…!
enUS_text: I won't let Sir Oshtor shoulder this burden alone... I'll fight, too!
zhTW_text:
我們不會讓奧修特爾大人獨自戰鬥……
我們也要作戰！

jaJP_text:
언니, 조금만 더…,
조금만 더 참고 버텨 주셨으면 하는 것입니다!!
enUS_text: I know it's been hard for you, dear sister... Just hold out a little longer!
zhTW_text:
姊姊大人，請再撐一下……
請再撐一下就好！

jaJP_text:
좋다. 여기서 꼬리를 말고 물러난다면,
언제까지고 아버님의 뒤를 이을 수는 없느니라.
enUS_text: No. If I turn back now, I will lose my chance to succeed my father forever.
zhTW_text:
無妨。要是余在此垂頭喪氣地退下，
不論再過多久都無法成為父親大人的繼承者。

jaJP_text:
하지만 저 성벽이,
이렇게나 허무하게 부서지다니……
enUS_text: I can't believe they broke through those walls so easily...
zhTW_text:
但沒想到那座城牆，
竟然會這麼輕易就被摧毀……

enUS_text: O-Oshtor, at the rate this battle's going...
zhTW_text: 兄、兄長大人，再這樣下去……

enUS_text: Understood, Sister.
zhTW_text: 我知道了，大姊。

jaJP_text:
역시 코코포는 평범한 호로론 새가 아니군.
…재밌어!
enUS_text: You're no ordinary hororon, are you, Cocopo? I like that about you!
zhTW_text:
果然可可啵不是一般的赫蘿蘿恩鳥啊。
真有趣！

enUS_text: Yeah! I think that's a new record.
zhTW_text: 嘻嘻，好像能打破紀錄呢！

jaJP_text:
오슈토르 씨,
혼자만 먼저 치고 나가는 건 안 된다 아이가!
enUS_text: Don't go after all the glory yourself, Oshtor!
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾先生，
你可別自己偷跑囉！

enUS_text: Please... Somebody...
zhTW_text: 拜託了……誰快來……

enUS_text: I'm not about to give up, either.
zhTW_text: 現在還不能放棄……

jaJP_text:
설마 부화해 버리다니……
이건 좋지 않은 전개네요……
enUS_text: To think he'd build a cocoon around himself... I didn't see this coming.
zhTW_text:
沒想到竟然孵化了……
這個發展很不妙呢……

jaJP_text:
성상이시여……
한 가지만 약속해 주셨으면 합니다.
enUS_text: Your Highness, please promise me something.
zhTW_text:
聖上……
唯有一點，希望您能答應鄙人。

enUS_text: Nyohohohoh! Is that the extent of thy power? Surely you jest!
zhTW_text:
喔呵呵呵呵呵！
竟然只有這點程度，真是笑掉人大牙了……

jaJP_text:
후훗, 그렇네요.
지금이라면 누가 상대라도 질 것 같지는 않네요.
enUS_text: Heehee. Yeah, I don't feel like we're going to lose to anyone.
zhTW_text:
呵呵，就是說啊。
感覺現在不會輸給任何對手呢。

enUS_text: Sure, Ougi. Go ahead and go wild!
zhTW_text:
嗯！　儘管動手吧！
扇！

jaJP_text:
후하하하하하하하하하핫!
아무것도 못 하는 어린 계집이…, 우쭐대지 마라!!
enUS_text: Bwahahaha! Don't get ahead of yourself, girl. A child like you can't do anything!
zhTW_text:
呵哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！
毫無本事的小丫頭……少囂張了！

enUS_text: Foul villains... This is where your rebellion ends!
zhTW_text: 可恨的奸賊們……我要收拾你們！

jaJP_text:
반드시 모두가 있는 곳으로 돌아가겠다고 약속했다……
질 수는 없다!
enUS_text: I promised I'd find my way back to them... I can't lose here!
zhTW_text:
我跟大家約好了，一定會回到他們身邊……
我可不能就此戰敗！

enUS_text: Wha?!
zhTW_text: 什！

enUS_text: Wow, it sure is cold here, huh Ku?
zhTW_text:
嗯～好冷啊，
小久。

jaJP_text:
이렇게 되어 버린 이상,
봐드릴 수는 없으니……
각오해 주시길…!
enUS_text: At this point, I don't think I can hold myself back anymore... I hope you're ready!
zhTW_text:
既然如此，
我也無法手下留情了……
請做好覺悟吧！

jaJP_text:
제 뜻을 관철하고 싶다면,
이 몸을 힘으로 눌러 보아라!
enUS_text: If you want to prove justice is on your side, you'll have to beat the fight out of me first!
zhTW_text:
若是想要貫徹自己的理念，
就先把我打倒再說！

jaJP_text:
후훗…,
나중에 제 품에서 울어도 괜찮답니다?
enUS_text: Heehee. You can nuzzle into me and cry when we're done, if you like.
zhTW_text:
呵呵……
晚點到我的懷裡哭也沒問題喔？

enUS_text: We've got no more need for words now.
zhTW_text: 那麼也毋需多言了。

enUS_text: Nrgh... Shut up, Woshis! Hraaaaaaaaagh!
zhTW_text:
唔……沃西斯……快住口！
嗚喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔！

jaJP_text:
엄청난 싸움이 되어 가고 있구나……
어서 승기를 잡고 싶구려…!
enUS_text: You've dragged us into something really crazy this time... If we don't find a way to win soon, we're done for.
zhTW_text:
戰況變得好激烈……
真想早點掌握戰勝的機會啊！

jaJP_text:
이런… 큰일 날 뻔했네,
그만 열이 올라 버렸잖아……
enUS_text: Oho... Things are finally getting interesting.
zhTW_text:
哎呀……這可不行，
害我不小心熱血過頭了……

jaJP_text:
정말이지…,
별것도 아니로군!!
자들아, 소인을 따르라!!
enUS_text: You see? They're nothing special. Follow me to victory, soldiers!
zhTW_text:
真是的……
根本沒什麼大不了啊！
小的們，跟敝人一起上！

jaJP_text:
모든 것은 나코쿠를 위해,
한시라도 빨리 이 상황을 수습해 보이겠다!
enUS_text: We have to turn this battle around as soon as we can. For Nakoku!
zhTW_text:
一切都是為了納克庫，
必須盡早解決這個狀況才行！

enUS_text: Miss Atuy, don't charge in on your own!
zhTW_text:
阿圖依小姐，
一個人衝出去太危險了！

enUS_text: Everyone...
zhTW_text: 各位……

enUS_text: Thank you for giving me this opportunity!
zhTW_text: 真的非常感謝各位和我交手！

enUS_text: Oh yeah! That felt good!
zhTW_text:
呼啊～<onpu>
實在太棒啦……！

enUS_text: Geegeegee...!
zhTW_text: 嘰嘰嘰嘰嘰……

jaJP_text:
성상이시여, 조심하십시오.
방금 전까지의 상대와는 다릅니다.
enUS_text: Be careful, Your Highness. He's not like the opponents we've faced before.
zhTW_text:
聖上，請小心。
這跟先前為止的對手不同。

jaJP_text:
우오…!?
결국, 이렇게 될 운명이었던 건가……
enUS_text: Wha...?! Why does it always end up like this...
zhTW_text:
嗚哦……！？
到頭來還是註定變成這樣啊……

jaJP_text:
야마토의 병사들이여…,
모처럼 출전할 기회를 주었노라.
enUS_text: Soldiers of Yamato... Pray, waste not this chance I grant thee.
zhTW_text:
大和的士兵們啊……
難得麻呂我都給你們出場機會了。

enUS_text: Then let's do this, together! Ready, Kiwru?
zhTW_text: 知道啦，這就來！　奇羽琉！

enUS_text: Sorry, everyone...
zhTW_text: 抱歉，大家……

enUS_text: Ooogee!
zhTW_text: 嗚吱──！

enUS_text: I'm on it!
zhTW_text: 交給我吧！

enUS_text: We shall all go together.
zhTW_text: 好了，我們一起上吧。

jaJP_text:
이제 남은 유예는 없다.
네놈의 모든 것을 나에게 먹여라!!
enUS_text: We can't put off this confrontation. I'll tear you apart until nothing is left!
zhTW_text:
已經沒剩多少時間了。
快點對我使出你的全力！

jaJP_text:
주인님을 위해서라면,
저희가 망설일 일은 없습니다.
enUS_text: If it's for our master, we can act without fear.
zhTW_text:
若是為了主人，
我們不會心生猶豫。

enUS_text: It's time we finished this, Maroro.
zhTW_text: 做個了斷吧……麻呂呂。

jaJP_text:
마로로, 아직도 싸우겠다는 것입니까……
어째서 오라버니 말씀을 들어 주지 않는 것입니까?
enUS_text: Maroro, you're still determined to fight? Why won't you just listen to my brother...?
zhTW_text:
麻呂呂，你還要戰鬥嗎……
為什麼你就是不肯聽兄長說的話？

jaJP_text:
네놈들, 뭘 하고 있는 거냐!
어서 놈들을 토벌해라!!
enUS_text: What are you all waiting for? Finish them off at once!
zhTW_text:
你們這些傢伙，在做什麼！
還不快點收拾那傢伙！

enUS_text: Now you're speaking my language!
zhTW_text: 這樣才對！

enUS_text: Oshtor, that thing... That's what did that to everyone...!
zhTW_text:
兄長大人……
就是那傢伙……那傢伙把大家都！

enUS_text: No more second chances. This is the end.
zhTW_text: 沒有下次了，事情到此為止。

jaJP_text:
이, 이럴 리가…!?
너, 너무 강해……
enUS_text: This can't be happening! They're too strong for us...
zhTW_text:
不、不該這樣的啊……！？
太、太強了……

jaJP_text: 지금의 우리라면 반드시 해낼 수 있다!
enUS_text: We're stronger than we were before... We're going to win!
zhTW_text: 現在的我們一定辦得到！

enUS_text: I couldn't agree more... This place will be your grave!
zhTW_text: 正合我意……這裡就是你的葬身之處了！

jaJP_text:
여기서 무슨 일이 있어도 놈을 쓰러뜨린다!
간다!!
enUS_text: We have to put a stop to that thing. Let's do this!
zhTW_text:
無論如何都要在此收拾掉牠！
要上了！

enUS_text: You're just the same as always...
zhTW_text: 還是老樣子啊……

jaJP_text:
후훗……
예전에 하쿠 님께도 똑같은 말씀을 들었던가요……
enUS_text: Heheh... Haku told me that once, too.
zhTW_text:
呵……
以前哈克大人似乎也說過類似的話……

enUS_text: Let's go, Rulutieh!
zhTW_text: 露露緹耶，要上了！

enUS_text: Woshis...
zhTW_text: 沃西斯……

enUS_text: You're right... We have to get her out of there!
zhTW_text: 我絕對會……救出小久的！

enUS_text: All who oppose must be eliminated!
zhTW_text: 礙事的傢伙，唯有抹殺一途！

enUS_text: This should be far enough...
zhTW_text: 很好，只要引到這邊……

enUS_text: It seems you have... some skill.
zhTW_text: 剛才那招，可圈可點……

jaJP_text:
오라버니…,
여기서 미카즈치 님과 싸우면 안 되는 것입니다……
enUS_text: Oshtor... This isn't right. You can't fight Mikazuchi...
zhTW_text:
兄長……
不能在這裡和御雷大人交戰……

enUS_text: And now an orke, too?!
zhTW_text: 怎麼會，連獒切都……！

jaJP_text:
그만두는 것입니다! 마로로!
부탁이니 저희 말을……
오라버니 말씀에 귀를 기울여 주세요……
enUS_text: Stop this, Maroro! Oshtor can explain. You just have to listen!
zhTW_text:
快停手！　麻呂呂！
拜託，請聽我們說的話……
請聽兄長說的話吧……

enUS_text: Today is the day I change all that!
zhTW_text: 今天敝人一定要做個了斷！

jaJP_text:
하지만, 그대답지 않군.
이런 상대에게 뭘 그리 애를 먹고 있나?
enUS_text: Are you struggling against an opponent of this caliber? That's not like you.
zhTW_text:
不過，這還真不像你。
對付這樣的對手，哪裡需要如此費力？

jaJP_text:
공주 전하, 떨어지면 살아나기 어렵사오니,
부디 주의하십시오……
enUS_text: Watch your step, Your Highness. If you do fall, I probably won't be able to save you.
zhTW_text:
公主殿下，要是掉下去是不可能獲救的，
請多加留意……

jaJP_text:
수, 수가 너무 많아……!
야쿠토와루토 씨, 전위를 부탁드립니다!
enUS_text: There's too many of them...! Jachdwalt, can you handle the ones in front?
zhTW_text:
唔，數量太龐大了……！
亞庫托瓦爾特先生，麻煩你負責前衛了！

jaJP_text: 멈춰 있으면 노려 달라고 하는 거나 마찬가지다!
enUS_text: Standing still is just asking to get hit!
zhTW_text: 停下動作，跟叫對方抓住自己沒兩樣！

jaJP_text:
저는 망설이지 않습니다…,
쿠쨩은 반드시 구해 내겠습니다…!
enUS_text: I know what I have to do now... I'll save Ku no matter what it takes!
zhTW_text:
我沒有任何迷惘……
我一定要救出小久！

enUS_text: We've been captured...
zhTW_text: 被抓住了。

enUS_text: This battle ends now!
zhTW_text: 靠這招了結啦！

jaJP_text: 티끌들이 아무리 쌓인다 한들, 결국은 티끌일 뿐이다!!
enUS_text: Bring as many weaklings as you want. It won't make any difference!
zhTW_text: 無論塵埃怎麼聚集，終究只是塵埃！

jaJP_text: 잘은 모르겠지만, 서로 죽이 잘 맞았던 거 아닐까…?
enUS_text: I don't get it, either. Maybe they feel some kind of kinship with it?
zhTW_text: 雖然我不太清楚，但可能是剛好合得來吧……？

jaJP_text:
수비를 굳히고, 적을 가까이 오지 못하게 해라!
보조를 흐트러뜨리면 파고들 틈을 준다!
enUS_text: Tighten our defenses and keep them from getting too close. If we fall out of step, we're done for!
zhTW_text:
穩固防守，不要讓敵人靠近！
亂了步調是會被敵人抓到破綻的！

jaJP_text:
짐도 힘이 닿는 데까지 다하겠다.
오슈토르도 저자를 두들겨 패 버리거라!!
enUS_text: I will exercise all the power I have at my disposal. Oshtor, defeat any who stand in our way!
zhTW_text:
余也會盡己所能。
奧修特爾也要把那傢伙痛扁一頓！

enUS_text: Hmph. I know, I know!
zhTW_text: 唔……我明白的！

jaJP_text:
이제 더는 물러설 곳이 없다!
덤벼라, 모두들!!
enUS_text: Their backs are against the wall. Stand strong and take 'em out!
zhTW_text:
已經沒退路了！
都給我放馬過來吧！

jaJP_text:
많은 희생을 낳은 대가를 치르게 하겠다.
……각오해라!!
enUS_text: Prepare yourself. It's time you atoned for all the lives you've sacrificed!
zhTW_text:
你造成了龐大的犧牲，我要你付出代價。
……做好覺悟吧！

jaJP_text:
어머?
그만 힘이 좀 들어가 버린 모양이네요……
다친 데는 없으세요?
enUS_text: It seems I put a little too much power into that attack. I hope I didn't injure you.
zhTW_text:
咦？
我好像不小心太大力了……
請問你有沒有受傷？

enUS_text: Th-This is nothing!
zhTW_text: 這點程度不算什麼！

enUS_text: I can see why Lord Oshtor put so much stock in you, Lord Haku.
zhTW_text: 真不愧是奧修特爾大人認同的男子漢。

enUS_text: I forbid you to run from this, Kuon.
zhTW_text: 久遠啊，余可不允許你逃跑！

jaJP_text:
죄 없는 이들에게 희생을 강요하다니……
용서 못 한다!!
enUS_text: Seizing power by sacrificing innocent people... I won't allow it!
zhTW_text:
竟然犧牲無辜之人……
不可原諒！

jaJP_text: 어, 어째서… 이길… 수 없는…… 건가요……?
enUS_text: W-Why couldn't I win...?
zhTW_text: 為、為何……無法……戰勝……？

jaJP_text:
지금이야말로 단련한 실력을 보여 줄 때다!
간다 오우기!
enUS_text: The time has come to show our power, Ougi!
zhTW_text:
現在正是展示苦練成果的時候！
上吧，扇！

jaJP_text: 정말이지, 골치 아픈 일이 되어 가고 있잖아……
enUS_text: Damn, things are really going off the rails now...
zhTW_text: 真是的，事情越來越麻煩了……

enUS_text: (This isn't going to blow my cover, is it...?)
zhTW_text: （我的真面目，應該沒曝光……吧……？）

enUS_text: I guess there's no chance of you surrendering peacefully?
zhTW_text: ……看樣子你似乎不打算投降呢。

jaJP_text: 이 곧은 소년을 속이는 건, 역시 마음이 아프군……
enUS_text:
It doesn't sit right with me to pull the wool over
this kid's eyes. He's just doing his best.
zhTW_text: 要欺騙如此正直的少年，果然很讓人心痛……

jaJP_text:
그럴 수가……
우루 어머님……
카뮤 언니까지……
enUS_text: Mother... Sister... Not you, too...
zhTW_text:
怎麼……
烏爾母親大人……
連卡繆姊姊大人都……

jaJP_text:
미카즈치, 어찌 된 것이냐?
움직임이 둔해졌구나!
enUS_text: You're slowing down, Mikazuchi! Don't tell me you're tired out already?
zhTW_text:
御雷，你怎麼了？
動作都變遲鈍了！

jaJP_text:
아무것도 모르고 있어……
그러니까, 언니는 못 가게 하겠어……
enUS_text: You don't understand any of that. I can't allow you to go through with this.
zhTW_text:
你什麼都不懂……
所以，姊姊是不會讓你去的……

enUS_text: Easier said than done.
zhTW_text: 但要怎麼找？

enUS_text: I don't like it here.
zhTW_text: 我討厭這個地方……

enUS_text: Here I go, Mikazuchi! This will end it all!
zhTW_text:
我要上了，御雷！
就此了結吧！

jaJP_text: 자, 티끌이 될 때까지 싸워 보자, 오슈토르!!
enUS_text: Oshtor! This time I will pound you into dust!
zhTW_text: 好了，奧修特爾，讓我們戰到化為灰燼吧！

enUS_text: Oh-geee! Ooogeegee!
zhTW_text: 嗚嘰！　嗚嘰嘰嘰嘰！

jaJP_text:
나는 무네치카!
야마토를 수호하는 팔주장 중 하나,
진수의 무네치카다!!
enUS_text: I am Munechika, Guardian Deity of Yamato's Eight Pillar Generals!
zhTW_text:
在下乃宗近！
為守護大和的八柱將之一，
鎮守之宗近！

jaJP_text:
주인님이 쿠온 씨에게 다가가실 수 있도록,
저희가 길을 열겠습니다…!
enUS_text: We'll clear a path so you can reach Kuon, Master...!
zhTW_text:
為了讓主人能順利接近久遠小姐，
由我們來開路！

enUS_text: We'll have to think of a way to deal with them.
zhTW_text: 必須擬定對策。

enUS_text: Hold on a little longer, Kuon!
zhTW_text: 你等著吧，久遠……！

enUS_text: It's time for the grand finale!
zhTW_text: 就此拉下終幕吧！

enUS_text: Cocopo, don't push yourself, all right?
zhTW_text: 可可啵，你可別太勉強自己喔？

enUS_text: We'll have to be careful not to lose our footing here.
zhTW_text: 要小心別被絆到了……喔！

jaJP_text: 부상자들은 한 번 뒤로 물러나 주세요!
enUS_text: Anyone who's injured, fall back and recover!
zhTW_text: 負傷人員請暫時退下！

jaJP_text: 어떻게 해도 제 말을 들을 생각이 없다면, 봐줄 수는 없을 것 같네…
enUS_text: We've tried to make you see sense. This is our only choice now.
zhTW_text: 既然他不打算聽，那我們也不能手下留情了……

enUS_text: Father, everyone... I'm so sorry...
zhTW_text:
父親大人……大家……
抱歉……

jaJP_text:
이런 짓을 해서,
하쿠가 기뻐할 거라고 생각하는 거야?
enUS_text: Do you really believe this would make Haku happy?
zhTW_text:
你以為做這種事，
哈克真的會高興嗎？

enUS_text: Ahaha! You're a real harsh one, Neko.
zhTW_text:
啊哈哈！
小貓音，真壞心眼……

enUS_text: Kiwru, are you all right?
zhTW_text: 奇羽琉殿下，還好嗎？

enUS_text: Are you doing all right, Ku?
zhTW_text: 小久，你沒事吧？

enUS_text: It's sapping our spirit.
zhTW_text: 士氣低落。

enUS_text: Hey, you're not too bad...!
zhTW_text: 哦，挺厲害的嘛！

enUS_text: Right! Rakusharai, prepare to charge!
zhTW_text: 好的！　準備應對騎兵隊的突擊！

jaJP_text: 본래의 힘을 낼 수 있도록 힘을 비축해 두세요.
enUS_text: You'll need time before you can wield your true power effectively.
zhTW_text: 請儲備精力，以發揮真正的力量。

jaJP_text:
크크크……
오자마자 제법 유쾌한 상황이 벌어지고 있는 모양이군……
enUS_text: Heheh... The battle's barely started, and it's already getting good.
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵……
我這才剛來，就已經發展成了相當令人愉悅的局面了嘛……

jaJP_text: 불완전한 생물 주제에 왜 저항하는 것이죠…?
enUS_text: Why do you imperfect lifeforms insist on struggling like this?
zhTW_text: 區區不完美的生物，為何要抵抗？

jaJP_text:
물론이니라!
짐의 곁에는, 그대가 함께하고 있으니.
enUS_text: Naturally! You shall always be by my side, after all.
zhTW_text:
那當然！
畢竟余身邊有你啊。
咕嚕……？

jaJP_text:
우리 나라를 침공한 것,
후회하게 해 주겠다!
각오해라!!
enUS_text: This is it! I'll teach you what happens to those who attack my homeland!
zhTW_text:
我會讓你為攻打我國家一事
感到後悔！
做好覺悟吧！

jaJP_text:
오슈토르, 심각한 얼굴을 하고 있는데…,
뭔가 신경 쓰이는 거라도 있나?
enUS_text: Is something wrong, Oshtor? You look like there's something on your mind.
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾，看你面有難色……
有什麼事情讓你很在意嗎？

jaJP_text: 치료는 저에게 맡겨 주세요, 오슈토르 님!
enUS_text: Leave the healing to me, Sir Oshtor!
zhTW_text: 治療的方面就交給我吧，奧修特爾大人！

jaJP_text:
하지만 등을 돌리지 않아도 별 차이는 없는 것 같던데요?
아무래도 저 두 사람만으로는 부족했던 모양이니까요.
enUS_text: It'll attack us even if we don't! Those two won't be able to hold it back on their own.
zhTW_text:
不過，就算不背對牠好像也沒什麼差別喔。
看來光是那兩個人無法打倒牠。

enUS_text: Hraaaaaaaaagh! Now it's my turn!
zhTW_text:
喔────！
接下來輪到我了！

enUS_text: You're finished, Tokifusa! Surrender now and come quietly!
zhTW_text:
做好覺悟吧！　時櫻！
乖乖束手就擒吧！

enUS_text: Honestly, Cocopo...
zhTW_text: 真是的，可可啵……

jaJP_text:
(아마 이게 마지막이겠지……
　조금만 더다… 버텨 다오, 내 몸이여…!!)
enUS_text: (This will probably be the final blow... Please, body, just hold out a little longer...!)
zhTW_text:
（這恐怕就是最後了吧……
　再一下就好……鄙人的身體，再撐一下……！）

jaJP_text:
흥, 나리가 돌아오다니……
이제는 질 수 없게 돼 버렸잖아…!
enUS_text: Boss... You came back to us. Guess we really can't lose this now, huh?
zhTW_text:
嘿，老爺都回來了……
那我們當然也不能輸！

enUS_text: I'll be fine. I'll finish this soon enough.
zhTW_text: 不必擔心，很快就會結束了。

enUS_text: You're not holding out on me, are you, Oshtor?
zhTW_text: 奧修特爾，你不必手下留情喔？

enUS_text: M-Magnificent work. Well done.
zhTW_text: 你的動作不錯，辛苦了。

enUS_text: F-Fumirul! Wh-Wh-What are you doing...?!
zhTW_text:
芙、芙米露露！
等……哇～哇～哇～！

jaJP_text: 이런 건 절대로 이상한 것입니다! 오라버니……
enUS_text: Big Brother, something's wrong...!
zhTW_text: 這樣實在太奇怪了！　兄長……

enUS_text: V-Very well. Let's do this!
zhTW_text: 請、請多指教！

enUS_text: Wh-Where are my reinforcements?!
zhTW_text: 增援呢？增援還不來嗎！

jaJP_text:
그래, 적의 기세는 좋지만 이걸 버텨 낸다면,
보조가 흐트러지는 건 저쪽이다.
enUS_text: Yes. They may have numbers, but if we withstand their charge, they'll be the ones who'll fall apart.
zhTW_text:
是啊，敵人氣勢雖強，但只要能擋住這波攻擊的話，
反而是對方會亂了步調。

enUS_text: Please, stop... You have to get out of here...
zhTW_text: 拜託，住手……放我……出去……

enUS_text: Allow us to show you what true strength looks like!
zhTW_text: 我就讓你見識真正的力量吧！

jaJP_text:
워시스 놈…, 움직이기 시작했나……
이놈… 여기까지 야마토를 마음대로 휘두르다니……
enUS_text: Is this your next move, Woshis? Haven't you toyed with my beloved Yamato enough already?
zhTW_text:
沃西斯那傢伙……開始行動了嗎……
混帳……竟敢對大和肆意妄為到這種程度……

jaJP_text:
바보처럼 정면에서 돌격해 온다면,
이쪽도 여유롭게 상대할 수 있잖아.
enUS_text: With a formation like that, ain't it just as easy for us to take them out?
zhTW_text:
他們如果能不知變通地從正面衝過來，
我們也可以從容應對吧。

jaJP_text:
방해다!
쿠온 공을 생각한다면 없애 버려라!!
enUS_text: Out of my way! You're no match for our feelings for Lady Kuon!
zhTW_text:
礙事！
若你們為久遠大人著想，就快點消失吧！

jaJP_text:
닥쳐라, 너는 죽어 갈 자…,
결판을 내 주마…!!
enUS_text: Be quiet! You're going to die here! I... I have to finish this...!
zhTW_text:
閉嘴，你很快就會死了……
讓我做個……了斷吧！

jaJP_text: 크하핫, 여기서 네놈의 목을 베어 가겠다!!
enUS_text: Heheh. This time, I'll take you down for good!
zhTW_text: 哈哈哈，我要就此拿下你的頭顱！

jaJP_text:
이번 싸움…,
절대로 질 수 없어!
enUS_text: We cannot lose this battle...!
zhTW_text:
絕對不能……
輸掉這場戰鬥！

enUS_text: Let's finish this, Vurai!
zhTW_text: 做個了斷吧，武賴！

jaJP_text:
오슈토르가 말했느니라.
이 싸움에서는 눈을 돌려선 안 된다, 결코 도망쳐선 안 된다고.
enUS_text: It's exactly as Oshtor said. I can't run from this. I have to face reality head on.
zhTW_text:
奧修特爾曾經這麼說過。
不可移開視線，更不可逃避這場戰爭。

enUS_text: How are you holding up, Cocopo?
zhTW_text: 可可啵，你是不是累了……？

enUS_text: Geegeegee!
zhTW_text: 嗚吱吱吱！

enUS_text: You must have hit your head.
zhTW_text: 似乎還不小心撞到頭了。

jaJP_text:
효호호……
나비들이 파닥파닥 시끄러워지기 시작했구려.
유쾌하구려, 유쾌해.
enUS_text: Nyoh hoh hoh... Like moths to the flame. Splendid, splendid.
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵……
蝴蝶的振翅聲都開始吵個不停了。
有趣、太有趣了。
咕嚕嚕嚕嚕──！

enUS_text: Yes. We'll show them what our combined powers can do!
zhTW_text: 嗯！　一起作戰吧！

enUS_text: Oshtor, I'm ready!
zhTW_text: 兄長大人！　我辦得到！

jaJP_text:
무네치카에게 질 수는 없느니라!
짐도 나가겠다!!
enUS_text: I can't let Munechika outdo me. I'll fight, too!
zhTW_text:
余也不能輸給宗近！
余也要出陣！

jaJP_text:
이번 싸움, 질 수는 없어…,
간다!!
enUS_text: I swear, I will not lose this battle... Let's do this!
zhTW_text:
絕不能輸掉這場戰鬥……
準備上了！

enUS_text: (Ngh... Such power...)
zhTW_text: （可惡……好強的……力量……）

enUS_text: You're wasting your time... Death awaits you!
zhTW_text:
這只是浪費時間……
快點消失吧！

enUS_text: I've had enough of your impudence. It's time for you to face judgement!
zhTW_text:
老在那邊自說自話……
看余解決你！

enUS_text: Hold on, Kuon! We're coming!
zhTW_text:
久遠，你等著！
我這就去救你！

jaJP_text:
이 느낌…, 매우 위험합니다.
주인님, 방심하지 말아 주세요.
enUS_text: Whatever this thing is, it's dangerous. I recommend caution, Master.
zhTW_text:
這個感覺……非常危險。
主人，請別掉以輕心。

jaJP_text:
아니, 그런 약한 소리는 지금 안 돼!
하쿠 씨와 형님의 신뢰에 보답하기 위해……
enUS_text: Ugh. I can't afford to go down that line of thinking right now.
zhTW_text:
不，現在不能說這種喪氣話！
為了回應哈克先生和兄長大人的期待……

enUS_text: Watch over me, old friend... I shall avenge thee!
zhTW_text:
希望你能好好看看……
我的好友啊……

enUS_text: Can't you dial it back a little bit...?
zhTW_text: 我倒是希望你客氣點……

enUS_text: Right!
zhTW_text: 嗯！

enUS_text: Thanks. I'm counting on you!
zhTW_text: 這個任務就交給我吧！

jaJP_text:
모두들, 미안하다……
이해해 달라고는 하지 않겠다……
enUS_text: I'm sorry, everyone... I don't expect you to accept this decision...
zhTW_text:
各位，抱歉……
我不會要求你明白……

enUS_text: R-Right! I'm sorry!
zhTW_text:
是、是的！
非常抱歉！

jaJP_text:
벗의 위기를 구하지 않고서야, 무슨 좋은 여자란 말인가…!
간다!!
enUS_text: I could never call myself a good woman if I ignored a friend in need... Here I go!
zhTW_text:
無法解救摯友的危機，又算什麼好女人！
要上了！

enUS_text: (Even you, Jachdwalt...?)
zhTW_text: （亞庫托瓦爾特……連你也是啊……）

jaJP_text:
크크크크…,
좋다…… 전부 산산이 부숴 주마!!
enUS_text: Heheheh, sounds good. I'll hit you with everything I've got!
zhTW_text:
呵呵呵呵……
不賴嘛……由我通通擊碎！

jaJP_text:
그 거창한 활을 마구 휘두르면 곤란하거든.
여기서 발을 묶어 두겠어.
enUS_text: Sorry, but I'm gonna have to stop you right here. Can't let you start firing off that giant bow of yours.
zhTW_text:
你一直亂揮那把大弓會讓人很傷腦筋的。
我要在此擋下你的腳步了。
嘎喔喔喔喔喔喔！

enUS_text: I have a reason to fight now, too!
zhTW_text: 對我來說，我也有戰鬥的理由！

enUS_text: As you wish, Big Brother!
zhTW_text: 了解，兄長！

enUS_text: I'll just take 'em all out together!
zhTW_text: 人家來一口氣把牠們通通打倒！

jaJP_text:
그렇다면, 야쿠토와루토 씨가 약한
산술로 공격해도 괜찮겠지요?
enUS_text: Perhaps you'd prefer if I attacked you with math problems instead?
zhTW_text:
那麼，用亞庫托瓦爾特先生不擅長的
算學發動攻勢也行喔？

enUS_text: Here they come!
zhTW_text: 要來了！

enUS_text: Why do I feel a ferocious killing intent all of a sudden...?
zhTW_text:
怎麼了？
總感覺殺氣騰騰的……

jaJP_text:
이 싸움이 끝나면,
무슨 일이 있어도 제 이야기를 들어 주셔야 합니다!
enUS_text: When this battle is over, you're going to listen to me. I'll make you see the truth!
zhTW_text:
這場戰鬥結束後，
無論如何都要讓你聽聽鄙人說的話！

jaJP_text: 가면의 힘, 지금의 주인님보다도 더 강한 힘입니다.
enUS_text: His akuruka's power surpasses yours, Master.
zhTW_text: 假面之力，比現在的主人還要更強。

jaJP_text:
순순히 지나가게 해 줄 생각은 없어 보이는군……
역시, 워시스는 살아 있는 건가……
enUS_text: They're not going to just stand aside and let us go... Woshis really must still be alive.
zhTW_text:
看來事情沒那麼順利……
沃西斯他果然還活著嗎……

enUS_text: Ah, I see you have some measure of skill...
zhTW_text: 哦，還算是有點本事嘛……

jaJP_text:
아쉽지만 시간 초과입니다,
편하게 보내 드리죠!
enUS_text: I regret to inform you that your time is up. Do not worry, I'll make this quick.
zhTW_text:
很遺憾，時間到了。
我就讓你解脫吧！

enUS_text: I must protect my daughter...
zhTW_text: 我也要守護女兒……

enUS_text: I will grant you eternal rest at the feet of the Uitsualnemetia...
zhTW_text:
在維茨亞奈米迪亞面前，
永遠安眠吧……

enUS_text: This isn't your average monster.
zhTW_text: 跟至今為止的傢伙顯然不同……

enUS_text: Together.
zhTW_text: 一起。

jaJP_text:
아주 많이 배운 것입니다.
다음에도 또 부탁드리고 싶은 것입니다!
enUS_text: Most instructive. Let's do this again!
zhTW_text:
我實在獲益良多。
希望下次能再一決勝負！

enUS_text: Master, please pay attention to the enemy's attack range!
zhTW_text: 請留意對方的攻擊範圍。

enUS_text: You don't stand a chance against my real power!
zhTW_text: 好戲現在才要開始，做好覺悟吧！

jaJP_text:
네놈, 가만히 듣고만 있었더니……!
오슈토르가 그런 짓을 할 리가 없느니라!!
enUS_text: Silence! Everyone, listen to me. Oshtor would never do anything like that!
zhTW_text:
你這傢伙，余無法再默默地聽下去了……
奧修特爾不可能做出那種事情！

jaJP_text:
그런가…,
그렇다면 힘으로라도 사죄하게 해 주겠다!
각오해라!!
enUS_text: I see... In that case, I'll force you to atone! Prepare yourself!
zhTW_text:
這樣啊……
那我要憑蠻力讓你謝罪了！
做好覺悟吧！

enUS_text: We're almost at the gate! Keep going!
zhTW_text:
大正門就在眼前！
憑這股氣勢衝過去吧！

enUS_text: This time, I will take your head!
zhTW_text: 你的腦袋，我收下了！

jaJP_text: 나의 벗이여… 마로에게 힘을 빌려 주시구려!
enUS_text: Lend me thy strength, old friend...!
zhTW_text: 好友啊……請把力量借給麻呂我吧！

jaJP_text:
공주 전하, 잠시만 더 참아 주십시오.
이 싸움… 곧 끝내겠습니다.
enUS_text: Your Highness, please be patient a little longer. I'll bring this battle to an end!
zhTW_text:
公主殿下，還請您稍作忍耐。
馬上結束……這場戰爭吧。

enUS_text: (He's strong... If I don't do something soon, we're going to lose.)
zhTW_text: （果然很強……再這樣下去會被幹掉……）

jaJP_text:
모든 것은 워시스 님을 위해,
여기서 방해꾼들은 모조리 묻어 버리겠습니다.
enUS_text: We'll eliminate anyone who stands in the way of Lord Woshis' plans!
zhTW_text:
一切都是為了沃西斯大人，
我要於此置所有礙事的傢伙於死地。

enUS_text: I'll send you all the way to Denebokshiri!
zhTW_text:
我要請你們
陪我到地獄了！

enUS_text: Heheh... So long as I'm still on my feet, I'll keep fighting.
zhTW_text:
嘻嘻……
人家還沒倒下喔……

jaJP_text:
하지만 선봉에 선 건 저 미카즈치 씨인 것 같습니다.
그것만으로도 꽤 힘들 것 같네요.
enUS_text: Maybe, but they're being led by Mikazuchi. It takes a lot of strength and stamina just to keep up with him.
zhTW_text:
但是，打頭陣的似乎是那個御雷先生。
光是這樣就相當難應付了。
咕嚕嚕──！

enUS_text: Then that's the one we have to defeat?
zhTW_text: 那只要打倒牠就行了嗎？

jaJP_text:
목숨 받아 가겠다!
마로로 님께 손가락 하나도 대지 못하게 하겠다!
enUS_text: I have my orders. You won't lay a finger on Lord Maroro!
zhTW_text:
我就收下你的命了！
絕不讓你們碰到麻呂呂大人一根手指！

enUS_text: Ku... Why?
zhTW_text: 小久……為什麼……

enUS_text: ※翻訳不要
zhTW_text: ※翻訳不要

jaJP_text:
우히히, 이야기는 잘 모르겠는데,
